[p.63] en: The Local Emergency Management Authority (LEMA) (or National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), as the government’s lead disaster response agency, should be well versed in the need for and deployment of national resources (including USAR) to disasters of any sort within its sovereign boundary.
zh: 地方应急管理机构（LEMA）或国家灾害 管理机构（NDMA），作为政府的主要救灾机构，应熟悉国家资源（包括城市搜 索与救援）的需求和部署，应对其管辖范围内的各种类型的灾害。

[p.63] en: Commonly included within the legal framework of each country, there is the utilisation of a national command and control centre, often referred to as an Emergency Operations Centre (EOC) within the LEMA structure.
zh: 通常，在每个国家的法律框架内，可以利用国家指挥和控制中心[ 通常称为 紧急行动中心（EOC），属于地方应急管理架构] 作为中央指挥和控制机构，紧 急行动中心全天候运作，负责贯彻应急准备原则，并在紧急情况下执行战略层面

[p.64] en: An EOC is responsible for the strategic overview, or "big picture", of the disaster, and does not normally directly control field assets, instead making operational decisions and leaving tactical decisions to lower commands.
zh: 紧急行动中心负责灾害救援的战略统筹或“全局”把握，通常不直接控制现 场资源，而是将制定行动决策和进行策略决定的权力交给下级指挥部。

[p.64] en: The common functions of all EOCs is to collect, gather and analyse data; make decisions that protect life and property, maintain continuity of the country, within the scope of applicable laws; and disseminate those decisions to all concerned agencies and individuals.
zh: 所有紧急 行动中心的共同职能包括：收集、整理和分析数据；

[p.64] en: In most EOCs there is one individual in charge of the facility, the LEMA Emergency Manager.
zh: 大多数紧急行动中心都设立了一名负责人员，即地方应急管理机构 的应急管理人。

[p.64] en: Additionally, from a perspective of developing new USAR capacity, the INSARAG Response Framework provides a basis for the sequence of this development process, that is:  To develop a robust national emergency management framework based on an assessment of risk.
zh: 根据风险评估，制定高效的国家应急管理框架。

[p.64] en:  To develop the management and administration infrastructure and consider the alternative response options.
zh: 开发救灾管理和行政基础设施，考虑不同的响应方案。

[p.64] en: The alternative response options are: o Develop community-based first responder networks. o Develop elements of these networks into a specialised level. o If required, develop USAR capacity from those resources. o Undertake an assessment of their response capacity. o Review lessons learned from the assessment and continue to maintain and develop capacity.
zh: 其他不同的 响应选项包括：①发展基于社区的第一响应人网络；

[p.64] en: For those engaged in search and rescue, either at national or international levels, there is a need to undertake a continuous process of capacity building.
zh: 对于那些在国家或国际层面从事搜救的队伍来说，需要进行持续的能力建设。

[p.64] en: This capacity building manual was developed to assist those that have just started developing resources, those who have already established resources, as well as those that support each resource.
zh: 编写这份能力建设手册，旨在帮助刚开始发展救援能力的队伍、已经具备救援能 力的队伍以及支持各类救援队伍的机构。

[p.64] en: This manual will attempt to differentiate between the usual actions taken by organised first responders and how they can expand their capacity to develop technical rescue capacity (Chapter 2: Building Local Capacity).
zh: 在本手册中，将尝试区分有组织的第一响应人采取常规行动的能力，及其发 展能力后获得的技术救援能力（本卷2 章――地方救援能力建设）。

[p.64] en: Chapter 3: Building National Capacity will focus on the formation of USAR capabilities that can be designated as national capabilities.
zh: 本卷3 章―― 国家救援能力建设，将重点关注城市搜索与救援能力的形成，这种能力可以作为 国家救援能力。

[p.64] en: A complicating factor in this work is the term “USAR” which is often misunderstood or improperly applied.
zh: 这项工作中的一个复杂因素，是术语“城市搜索与救援”经常被误解或不当 应用。

[p.64] en: In the last decades USAR has often been used to describe any type of rescue operation, be it a road traffic accident, hiker lost in the wilderness, water related events, as well as a climber stuck on a rock ledge.
zh: 在过去的几十年里，城市搜索与救援经常被用来描述各种类型的救援行动， 无论是道路交通事故、徒步旅行者在荒野中迷路、水源相关突发事件，还是登山 者被困在岩架上。

[p.65] en: These emergencies are grouped into a category of rescue called technical rescue.
zh: 针对这些紧急情况的救 援类别，称为技术救援。

[p.65] en: Technical rescue incidents are often complex, requiring specially trained personnel and special equipment to complete the mission.
zh: 实施技术救援的事故往往较为复杂，需要经过专门培训的人员和专用装备才 能完成救援任务。

[p.65] en: Natural forces such as earth tremors, precipitation, extreme temperatures and swift water currents often complicate technical rescue incidents.
zh: 地震、降水、极端气温和湍急水流等自然力量，经常导致技术 救援事件变得复杂。

[p.65] en: The presence of flammable vapours and toxic chemicals can also increase the level of risk.
zh: 现场的可燃气体和有毒化学品，也会增加风险水平。

[p.65] en: The safety of teams conducting technical rescue operations is of a special concern.
zh: 对于开展技术救援行动的队伍，人员安全需要特别关注。

[p.65] en: First responders throughout the world perform technical rescues on a daily basis.
zh: 在世界各地，第一 响应人每天都会进行技术救援。

[p.65] en: Some complex technical rescue incidents may last many hours or even days as rescue personnel carefully assess the situation, obtain and set up the appropriate rescue equipment, monitor scene safety, and remove hazards before they can finally reach, stabilise, and extricate the victims.
zh: 某些复杂的技术救援事件可能会持续数小时甚至 数天，救援人员需要仔细评估情况，获取并使用适当的救援装备，监控现场安全 并消除危险因素，最终到达受困人员的受困位置，援助并解救受困人员。

[p.65] en: The presence of hazardous substances or elements such as flammable vapours or dust often forces rescuers to take additional precautions and time to ensure that operations are conducted safely.
zh: 由于现场存在危险品或危险因素（如易燃气体或粉尘），救援人员通常必须 采取额外的预防措施，并花费更多时间来确保救援行动的安全。

[p.65] en: Experience has shown that hasty rescue operations can endanger the lives of both rescuers and victims.
zh: 经验表明，如果 采取仓促的救援行动，则可能会危及救援人员和受困人员的生命。

[p.65] en: At the same time, rescuers know that a victim’s survival chances are often dependent on quick extrication and transportation to a hospital.
zh: 另外，救援人 员知道，受困人员的生存机会往往取决于是否进行了快速施救并运送到医院。

[p.65] en: Some organisations are better prepared than others to perform technical rescue operations.
zh: 在 执行技术救援行动方面，有些组织比其他组织准备得更充分。

[p.66] en: To deal with complicated rescue operations, many organisations have created special technical rescue teams.
zh: 51 第二卷 准备和响应 下的救援行动，许多组织成立了专门的技术救援队。

[p.66] en: A technical rescue team is a specialised group of personnel having advanced training and specialised equipment to safely and efficiently conduct complicated rescue operations.
zh: 技术救援队是受过高级培训、 拥有专业装备的专业队伍，能够安全、高效地实施复杂情况下的救援行动。

[p.66] en: Considering the mandate, the specialties and capabilities of individual teams vary greatly, depending on their level of training, number of trained personnel, and availability of specialised rescue tools and equipment.
zh: 由于任务的不同，各支队伍的专业和能力差异很大，具体取决于他们的培训 水平、受训人员数量以及专业救援工具和装备的配置情况。

[p.66] en: For example, some organisations have the training and equipment to perform rescues at collapsed structures by cutting through concrete and removing heavy debris, while other teams are limited to working with picks and shovels to remove debris.
zh: 例如，某些组织拥有 切割混凝土和清除重型废墟的装备，并经过相应的培训，可以在倒塌建筑物中进 行救援，而其他队伍仅具备使用镐和铲子来清理废墟的能力。

[p.66] en: Many organisations have single-discipline rescue teams such as a water rescue team.
zh: 许多组织都只是单一专业的救援队，如水域救援队。

[p.66] en: These teams are trained and equipped to handle one type of rescue.
zh: 这些队伍经过培训和装 备配置，可以处理一种灾害类型的救援。

[p.66] en: Others have multi-discipline teams that are prepared to perform more than one type of rescue operation.
zh: 而其他组织则拥有多专业队伍，能够执 行不止一种灾害类型的救援行动。

[p.66] en: The formation of a functional and safe technical rescue team, whether single- or multi-discipline, requires careful planning, a large time commitment from the team members, equipment research and acquisition, risk analysis, training, and sustained annual funding.
zh: 如果想要组建一支能力充分并能够确保安全的技术救援队伍，那么无论是单 专业还是多专业，都需要进行周密的规划，队员需要投入大量的时间，研究和采 购装备，开展风险分析和培训，且每年持续投入资金。

[p.66] en: This manual provides guidance on how to form a technical rescue team, which often starts with the formation of the Community First Responder that serves as the foundation for other capacity development, including USAR.
zh: 本手册提供了组建技术救援队方法的指导，这样的队伍通常从社区第一响 应人的组建开始，作为其他能力建设（包括城市搜索与救援）的基础。

[p.66] en: It discusses many of the considerations that must be made before forming a team such as:  Do we need a team for our community?  What type of team does our community need?  How do we conduct a risk assessment to identify rescue hazards?
zh: 本手册讨 论了组建救援队之前必须考虑的诸多因素，如：①社区救援队的必要性；

[p.66] en:  How do we start a team?  What training is necessary for team members?  What dangers are involved in technical rescue?  How can we fund the team?  What type of personnel will we need on the team?  What laws and standards pertain to rescue?  What equipment will the team need?
zh: ⑧队伍所需的人员类型；

[p.66] en: The roadmap to illustrate the stages of developments and requirements from a single responder to a national level USAR capacity is attached as Annex A: Roadmap for USAR National Capacity.
zh: 从第一响应人到国家级城市搜索与救援能力，通过路线图说明了不同阶段的 发展和要求，参见“附件A 城市搜索与救援国家能力建设路线图”。

[p.66] en: 2.1 First Responder The formation of the Community First Responder is usually the first step taken by any community or organisation to equip and train itself to respond to an emergency.
zh: 1 第一响应人队伍 社区第一响应人队伍的组建，通常是各个社区或组织装备和培训自己队伍所 采取的第一步，准备应对今后可能发生的紧急情况。

[p.66] en: This formation comes in various shapes, sizes and capabilities and is determined largely by the types of risks or hazards that the community is facing.
zh: 第一响应人队伍存在各种形 态、规模和能力，这些方面很大程度上取决于社区面临的风险或危险的类型。

[p.66] en: Most, if not all, are formed based on voluntary basis.
zh: 所 有或大多数第一响应人队伍，都是在自愿的基础上组建的。

[p.66] en: In the other hand, first responders can be officially recognised as an organised response typically provided by fire services, EMS personnel, civil defence units, police, and others.
zh: 另外，第一响应人队伍可以正式被认作有组织的响应队伍，通常由消防部门 的人员、紧急医疗救助人员、民防机构人员、警察和其他人员组成。

[p.67] en: 2.2 Technical Rescue Capabilities The First Responder (community or organisation) that is mandated to perform rescue operations will be more often presented with a unique or complex rescue situation requiring special skills and equipment to safely resolve.
zh: 52 2.2 技术救援能力 在执行救援行动时，具体社区或组织的第一响应人，经常会遇到特殊或复杂 的救援情况，需要特殊技能和装备才能安全应对。

[p.67] en: Some organisations are prepared to handle such events, but in many cases, the skills and equipment needed for these events exceed the capabilities of the responding organisation.
zh: 某些组织已经做好了准备，有 能力处理此类事件，但在许多情况下，这些事件所需的技能和装备超出了应急响 应组织的能力。

[p.67] en: From this, many organisations have formed or considered forming technical rescue teams to address these complex situations.
zh: 由此，许多组织已经组建或考虑组建技术救援队，以应对这些复 杂的情况。

[p.67] en: Most newly formed teams begin by training members in a single discipline, such as rope rescue or water rescue.
zh: 大多数新组建的队伍，首先对成员进行单一救援技能的培训，如绳索救援或 水域救援。

[p.67] en: Once this capacity is developed, it may expand into other areas of rescue so that it is a multi- discipline team which can handle several types of advanced rescue.
zh: 当单一救援技能培养起来之后，就可以扩展到其他救援领域，将队伍 发展成为一支能够应对多种灾害类型的多专业高级救援队伍。

[p.67] en: An organisation may also choose to establish different teams with individual capabilities.
zh: 相关组织还可以选 择建立具有特定能力的不同队伍。

[p.67] en: Various rescue disciplines exist.
zh: 现在已经有各种救援专业。

[p.67] en: The rescue disciplines discussed in this manual include:  Confined space rescue: A confined space is an enclosed area with limited entry or egress, which has an internal configuration not designed for human occupancy such that an entrant could become trapped or asphyxiated.
zh: 本手册中讨论的救援专业包括以下八个方面： （1） 密闭空间救援：密闭空间是指入口或出口受到限制的封闭区域，其内 部构造不是为人类居住而设计的，因此可能会造成进入者被困或窒息。

[p.67] en: It may have inwardly converging walls or a floor that slopes downward and tapers to a smaller cross section.
zh: 这类空间可能具有向内收缩的壁部结构或是向下倾斜并逐渐收窄横截 面的底部结构。

[p.67] en: These spaces include sewers, vats, caves, tanks, and other areas.
zh: 这些空间包括下水道、大桶、洞穴、储罐和其他区域。

[p.67] en: Rescues from such spaces are dangerous, especially if the interior environment is toxic or oxygen deficient.  Water and ice rescue: Rescues from lakes, swamps, flooded areas, swift or calm water bodies, and the ocean fit into this category.
zh: 在此类空间中进行救援是危险的，特别是在其内部环境有毒或缺氧的 情况下。

[p.67] en: There are several different specialties within water rescue including swift water, calm water, underwater, surf, and ice rescue.
zh: 水域救援有几个不同的 专业，包括急流救援、静水救援、水下救援、冲浪救援和冰域救援。

[p.67] en: Each of these requires specialist training.  Collapse rescue: This involves building collapse or other structural collapse as seen in large urban areas affected by a sudden-onset event (earthquake).
zh: 倒塌建筑物救援：这涉及建筑物倒塌或其他结构倒塌的情况，如受突 发事件（地震）影响的大城市地区。

[p.67] en: Many collapse rescue teams have been
zh: 在地震多发地区，已组建了多支 倒塌建筑物救援队。

[p.67] en: They may also be needed in cities that have many older buildings or new construction projects.  Trench/cave-in rescue: Trench or cave-in rescue could occur in almost any jurisdiction.
zh: 沟渠/ 塌方救援：几乎所有的人类居住区，都可能出现需要进行沟渠 或塌方救援的情况。

[p.67] en: Trenches are often found in areas of new construction where pipes or cables are being buried.
zh: 沟渠经常出现在埋有管道或电缆的新建筑区域。

[p.67] en: The most common trench rescue scenario involves rescuing a construction worker trapped when the trench walls collapse.  Rope rescue: High-angle or low-angle rescues are likely to occur around cliffs, ravines, caves, mountainous areas, high-rise buildings, communications towers, water towers, or silos.
zh: 最常见的沟渠救援场景是营救因沟壁倒塌受困的建筑工人。

[p.68] en: These rescues may require complex rope and hauling systems to safely secure personnel and extricate victims.  Industrial and agricultural rescue: Industrial machinery presents many challenges to rescuers.
zh: 这些救援可能需要复杂 的绳索和牵引系统，以确保救援人员的安全及解救受困人员。

[p.68] en: Many industrial rescues involve confined spaces or heavy extrication to free victims trapped by machinery.
zh: 许多工业事故救援涉及密闭空间或重型机械救援，以解救受困于 机械设备中的人员。

[p.68] en: It could also involve individuals trapped under or inside agricultural machinery or silos.  Vehicle rescue: Vehicle collisions (no matter which type) may result in the entrapment of one or more passengers.
zh: 车辆事故救援：无论哪种类型的车辆碰撞事故，都可能导致一名或多 名乘客被困。

[p.68] en: Extrication of these victims requires specialised knowledge, training and equipment.  Transportation rescue: Crashes, collisions or derailments that may result in entrapment of passengers.
zh: 营救这些受困人员需要专业知识、培训和装备。

[p.68] en: Extrication of these victims requires specialised knowledge, training and equipment.
zh: 营救这些受困人员需要专业知识、培训和装备。

[p.68] en: 2.3 Considerations Before Forming a Team This chapter describes the types of factors that must be evaluated when considering whether to form a technical rescue team.
zh: 3 组建队伍之前的考虑因素 本章介绍了在考虑是否组建技术救援队时必须评估的各种因素。

[p.68] en: For the purposes of this manual, a team will refer to a group of persons who are trained and equipped to perform technical rescues in one or more specialised areas.
zh: 就本手册而 言，队伍是指经过培训并配置救援装备的一组人员，可以在一个或多个专业领域 执行技术救援。

[p.68] en: Many considerations must be made before starting a rescue team, including whether a team is really needed, whether local officials will financially support a team, whether responders are committed to forming a team, what are the risks associated with a rescue team, and what laws affect the formation of a team.
zh: 在组建救援队之前必须考虑很多因素，包括组建救援队的必要性、当地政府 对于救援队的财政支持、救援人员对于组建救援队的投入、救援队可能遇到的风 险以及队伍组建的相关法律规定。

[p.68] en: The following questions should be considered by the proper authorities before attempting to develop a technical rescue team.
zh: 在尝试建立技术救援队之前，主管部门应考虑以下九个问题。

[p.68] en: This question can be answered by conducting a risk analysis of the local community.
zh: 社区救援队的必要性 通过对当地社区进行风险分析，可以回答这个问题。

[p.68] en: The ultimate decision for choosing to develop technical rescue expertise should be based on the needs of the local community.
zh: 选择发展技术救援专业 力量的最终决定应基于当地社区的需求。

[p.68] en: The sponsoring organisation (such as the government or the donor) must honestly and accurately assess the risk level in the community and if the risk is real, the sponsoring organisation should make every effort to secure the necessary resources to perform a rescue safely and efficiently.
zh: 主管部门（如政府或捐助者）必须真实、 准确地评估社区的风险水平，如果风险确实存在，则主管部门应尽一切努力确保 进行安全有效救援所需的资源。

[p.68] en: If a need does exist, but this need is being satisfied by an outside response team that is available to respond into the jurisdiction, then developing a separate team may be unnecessary.
zh: 如果确实存在需求，且需求可由对管辖范围做出 响应的外部救援队来满足，则可能没有必要建立单独的救援队。

[p.69] en: Should the team have a single function, or is expertise needed in multiple disciplines?
zh: 54 2.3.2 社区所需的救援队类型 队伍应当具有单一救援能力，还是需要多专业的救援能力？

[p.69] en: Again, this question can best be answered after conducting a risk assessment.
zh: 同样，在进行风 险评估后，可以准确地回答这个问题。

[p.69] en: Planners should thoroughly consider the ability of existing emergency response personnel to take on a new challenge.
zh: 队员对救援工作的投入 救援规划人员应充分考虑现有应急响应人员应对新挑战的能力。

[p.69] en: The level of commitment needed to start a technical rescue team is extremely high since it requires dedicated leadership and participation on the part of the entire membership.
zh: 组建技术救 援队所需的投入程度非常高，因为需要具有奉献精神的领导和全体成员的参与。

[p.69] en: Many times, only the members who are undergoing the training are considered and forget to evaluate the impact of this training on their co-workers who assume additional responsibilities during technical rescue-related absences.
zh: 很多时候，救援规划人员只考虑了正在接受培训的成员，而忘记评估这类培训对 其同事的影响。

[p.69] en: From this perspective a total commitment and clear understanding of the impact of this responsibility must be shared throughout the organisation in pursuing a technical rescue responsibility.
zh: 在技术救援期间，救援人员的同事也承担了额外的责任。

[p.69] en: Planners must thoroughly evaluate both the start-up costs and the ongoing operational costs for this type of venture.
zh: 队伍组建的具体费用及资金的获取与可持续情况 救援规划人员必须全面评估此类救援队的启动成本和持续运行成本。

[p.69] en: Start-up costs may be very expensive but depend on the equipment the resource already possess, and the type of team emergency officials want to initiate.
zh: 启动成 本可能非常高，但取决于已拥有的装备资源，以及应急管理官员想要启动的队伍 类型。

[p.69] en: Most start-up costs go toward equipment purchases and training.
zh: 大部分启动成本用于装备购置和人员培训。

[p.69] en: Operational costs may include ongoing training, equipment maintenance, and salaries if paid employees are utilised.
zh: 运行成本可能包括持续培训、 装备维护和人员工资（如果使用带薪员工）。

[p.69] en: Planners must consider whether the funding already exists for a new rescue team and how likely it is for the sponsoring organisation to obtain funding.
zh: 救援规划人员必须考虑组建救援队的资金是否已经到位，以及主管部门获得 资金的可能性有多大。

[p.69] en: Funding may come internally from the city or externally from donations by outside organisations.
zh: 资金可能来自所在行政区域，也可能来自外部组织的捐赠。

[p.69] en: The formation of any rescue team will require support and commitment from officials outside of the sponsoring organisation, and in some case requires endorsement by the government.
zh: 政府官员和城市管理层给予技术救援队的支持 任何救援队的组建，除了需要主管部门，还需要政府官员的支持和承诺，在 某些情况下还需要政府的认可。

[p.69] en: They will have the ultimate say about funding a team.
zh: 政府官员对于资助队伍拥有最终决定权。

[p.69] en: The basic expenses such as purchasing special equipment or funding training can only be met if there is full support from outside officials.
zh: 只有得 到官方的全力支持，才能满足救援队购买专用装备或资助培训等的基本费用。

[p.69] en: Their support is also necessary if emergency managers try to share resources with other communities.
zh: 如 果应急管理人员试图与其他社区共享资源，官方的支持也是必要的。

[p.69] en: In many instances the decision by local authorities to develop an expertise in technical rescue is prompted by an incident of significant magnitude in which the local responders were found to be unprepared to handle the situation.
zh: 在许多情况下，地方主管部门决定发展技术救援专业力量是由于发生了重大 事件，而当地救援人员却被发现没有做好应急响应的准备。

[p.69] en: Emergency managers may feel the need to develop technical rescue skills but, in the absence of a major incident, are unsure of how to justify this type of expenditure.
zh: 应急管理人员可能认 为有必要发展技术救援能力，但在没有发生重大事件的情况下，不确定如何证明 此类支出的合理性。

[p.69] en: Consider the questions that will be asked by fiscal personnel or elected officials about these expenditures such as:  Why do we need all this expensive equipment?  How many incidents did we have last year?  We have done just fine in the past, why do we need it now?
zh: 考虑财务人员或政府官员可能提出的有关这些支出的问题，如：

[p.70] en: An emergency manager may be acutely aware of the current limitations of current capabilities and the potential criticism that may result if the response resource is not prepared when a major incident occurs.
zh: 应急管理人员可能敏锐地意识到现有能力的局限性，以及，如果在重大事件 发生时，因响应资源没有准备好可能导致的潜在批评。

[p.70] en: Emergency managers should recognise the risks that are involved if the sponsoring organisation commits emergency workers to a work environment that they are insufficiently trained or ill-equipped to handle.
zh: 应急管理人员应认识到， 如果主管部门将缺乏培训或装备不足的应急工作人员派遣到应急工作环境中，则 会带来各种风险。

[p.70] en: Consider whether the USAR Team can explain these risks to managers and elected officials and what their reactions will be.
zh: 应考虑城市搜索与救援队是否可以向管理人员和政府官员解释 这些风险，以及对方的反应。

[p.70] en: As the planning of an assessment of current technical rescue needs, consider the option of sharing these resources among two or more communities.
zh: 邻近社区提供的其他资源 在规划当前技术救援需求评估时，请考虑在两个或多个社区之间共享这些资 源的方案。

[p.70] en: Utilising a shared or multi-agency response is fiscally responsible and can provide an appropriate level of service.
zh: 利用共享或多机构响应的方案在财政上是负责任的，同时又可以提供 适当水平的服务。

[p.70] en: Conducting technical rescue, like firefighting, is dangerous.
zh: 组建队伍所面临的具体挑战 进行技术救援，就像消防一样，存在各种危险。

[p.70] en: Certainly, risks can be limited by providing proper training about safe rescue techniques and by purchasing equipment designed to make rescues safer, but the sponsoring organisation must consider what dangers will confront rescuers and whether it and the rescuers are willing to face these dangers in a real incident.
zh: 当然，通过提供适当的安全 救援技术培训，以及购买确保救援工作更安全的装备，可以限制风险，但主管部 门必须考虑救援人员将面临哪些危险，以及主管部门和救援人员是否愿意在真实 事故中面对这些危险。

[p.70] en: Statistics indicate that a sizable number of deaths in confined spaces involve untrained and/or ill-equipped rescuers.
zh: 统计数据表明，密闭空间内的重大死亡事件涉及未经培训和/ 或装备不良的 救援人员。

[p.70] en: Technical rescuers may face many risks including asphyxiation within a confined space, fall injuries from operating on ropes, and drowning while operating in swift water conditions.
zh: 技术救援人员可能面临许多风险，包括在密闭空间内窒息，在绳索上 作业时坠落受伤，以及在湍急的水流条件下作业时溺亡。

[p.70] en: One of the greatest mistakes made when forming a team is to think that the sponsoring organisation can create a team without basic training and basic equipment.
zh: 组建队伍时，相关人员犯下的一个最大错误，就是认为主管部门可以在没有 基本培训和基本装备的情况下组建一支队伍。

[p.70] en: Some organisations have attempted to start a team or perform dangerous rescues without having even basic equipment or training.
zh: 在没有基本装备或培训的情况下， 某些组织甚至试图组建队伍或进行危险的救援。

[p.70] en: This is extremely risky from the standpoint of both the rescuers and the victims.
zh: 从救援人员和受困人员的角度来 看，这样做都是极其危险的。

[p.70] en: One of the most complicated and misunderstood areas affecting technical rescue is legal mandates and standards.
zh: 法律、法规和标准对队伍发展的影响 影响技术救援的最复杂和最容易被误解的一个领域，就是法律、法规和标准。

[p.71] en: A host of mandates and standards have been written which affect different types of rescues.
zh: 56 针对不同类型的救援，已经出台了相应的法规和标准。

[p.71] en: Compliance with these regulations is required for all rescuers for safety purposes.
zh: 出于安全目的，所有救援 人员都必须遵守这些法规和标准。

[p.71] en: Before starting a team, the Team Leader must consider what laws regulating response will affect a team and the costs of compliance and non-compliance.
zh: 在组建队伍之前，队伍负责人必须考虑到那些对队伍具有约束力的法规，以 及为了合规所需的投入、因不合规所造成的代价。

[p.71] en: Failure to comply with a regulation during a rescue can result in fines or other penalties.
zh: 在救援过程中，不遵守法规可 能会导致罚款或其他处罚。

[p.71] en: Additionally, the Team Leader must ensure the resource will complement existing national disaster legal framework, and that the team is considered a part of national disaster planning.
zh: 此外，队伍负责人必须确保救援资源能够补充现有的国家灾害法律框架，并 且救援队可以被看作国家灾害管理规划的一部分。

[p.71] en: National training requirements must be considered when planning for a rescue team.
zh: 培训的具体要求 在规划组建救援队时，必须考虑国家的相关培训要求。

[p.71] en: Mandatory training requirements vary from country to country or even among localities.
zh: 在不同国家甚至不同 地区，强制性培训要求也不同。

[p.71] en: Most technical rescue training mandates are self-determined by a country or locality that may require the sponsoring organisation to follow a particular standard of training.
zh: 大多数技术救援培训任务是由国家或地区自行确 定的，可能要求主管部门遵循特定的培训标准。

[p.71] en: 2.4 How to Form a Technical Rescue Team The formation and development of a technical rescue team is a considerable undertaking.
zh: 4 组建技术救援队的流程 技术救援队的组建和发展，是一项艰巨的任务。

[p.71] en: While the formation of all aspects of a team, both administrative and operational, is quite intensive, the maintenance and recurring training is even more challenging.
zh: 虽然组建队伍所涉及的各个 方面（包括行政和运行）都任务繁重，但队伍维护和定期培训更具挑战性。

[p.71] en: It can be an expensive undertaking requiring new training and equipment, and most importantly, careful planning.
zh: 组建 队伍可能是一项投入很高的任务，需要培训人员和购置装备，还有一项重要的任 务就是仔细规划。

[p.71] en: This chapter recommends steps to be taken in the formation of technical rescue team.
zh: 本章提出了组建技术救援队应采取的步骤。

[p.71] en: The steps are organised into four phases of team development:
zh: 这些步骤涉及队伍发展的四个阶 段，如图1 所示。

[p.71] en: Given the complexity of forming a technical rescue team, each step must be carefully considered so that important issues are not missed.
zh: 鉴于组建技术救援队的复杂性，每一步都必须仔细考虑，以免遗漏重要事项。

[p.71] en: 2.4.1 Phase I: Assessment of Community Risks and Rescue Needs Risks and rescue needs In determining whether a team is needed in the community, the sponsoring organisation must first do some research to evaluate the risks in the area.
zh: 第一阶段：社区风险、救援需求评估风险及救援需求 在确定社区是否需要救援队时，主管部门必须首先进行一些研究，评估该地 区的风险。

[p.71] en: A risk analysis will help them to determine what the level of risk is and what potential hazards exist so a decision can be made whether a team is needed.
zh: 通过风险分析，主管部门可以确定风险级别以及存在的具体潜在危险， 从而决定是否需要救援队。

[p.71] en: This is a particularly important part of starting a team for two reasons.
zh: 这是组建队伍的一个特别重要的阶段，有如下两个方 面的原因：首先，政府官员想知道存在的具体风险，证明为组建队伍提供资金的 合理性；

[p.71] en: First, political leaders will want to know what risks exist to justify funding a team.
zh: 其次，主管部门想知道其所面临的具体风险，进行队伍培训所针对的危 险场景的类型，以及应对这些风险所需的救援装备。

[p.71] en: Second, the sponsoring organisation will want to know what risks confront them, what type of hazardous scenarios to train for, and what rescue equipment will be needed to address the risks.
zh: 通过全面的风险分析，可以 确定主管部门组建救援队的目标，并证明组建队伍这项工作的合理性。

[p.72] en: Start with asking the basic questions:  What is the largest natural and/or man-made hazard facing the community?  What would the organisation do if the worst-case scenario happened today?  How would the community to react if the organisation was not prepared to respond?  How could the population and environment be affected if no local capacity exists?
zh: 如果当地没有救灾能力，社区民众和环境会受到怎样的影响？

[p.72] en: (a) Perform a Risk Assessment A risk assessment should be based on historical data on rescues allied to an analysis of newly introduced risks.
zh: 开展风险评估 风险评估应基于救援工作历史数据，并结合最新出现的风险进行分析。

[p.72] en: Begin by assessing past rescue needs in the assigned response area.
zh: 首 先评估特定响应区域过去的救援需求。

[p.72] en: The sponsoring organisation may look to past incidents or planned new construction to determine the frequency of technical rescues in the area.
zh: 根据过去的发生事件或计划新建的建筑， 主管部门可以评估该地区技术救援的频率。

[p.72] en: Other potential sources of data include the national office of statistics, construction or contractors’ associations, building officials and inspectors, and safety managers at local businesses.
zh: 其他潜在的数据来源包括：国家统计 局、建筑或承包商协会、建筑主管官员和检查人员以及当地企业的安全管理人员。

[p.72] en: Experience may indicate the likelihood of technical rescue-type incidents during major construction projects.
zh: 经验可能表明，重大建设项目期间，可能会发生技术救援类事件。

[p.72] en: The sponsoring organisation must also consider target hazards that exist in the assigned response area now or anticipated in the future.
zh: 对于指定 响应区域中现在存在或未来预期存在的目标风险，主管部门也必须对其进行考虑。

[p.72] en: Target hazards are specific risk areas that confront the team in a rescue emergency.
zh: 目标危险是指，在紧急情况下，救援队面临的特定风险领域。

[p.72] en: A review of the natural features of a locality will reveal some hazards.
zh: 通过审视当地的自然特征，可以揭示一些危险。

[p.72] en: Rivers, rapids, cliffs and rock-climbing sites are but a few of the areas where incidents may occur.
zh: 河流、急流、悬崖和攀岩地 点，是可能发生事故的部分区域。

[p.72] en: A review of existing building plans may highlight certain types of commercial or industrial facilities that might require the services of a specialty team.
zh: 对现有建筑规划的审查，可能会突出反映需要

[p.73] en: Contact the local building authority to identify new or planned construction that may contain target hazards.
zh: 联系当地建筑主管部门，确 定可能包含目标危险的新建筑或规划建筑。

[p.73] en: Make a list of target hazards which present special rescue challenges requiring special technical rescue equipment or advanced rescue training to safely and effectively control.
zh: 列出带来特殊救援挑战的各种目标危险，针对这些危险进行安全有效的控 制，必须依靠特殊技术救援装备或高级救援培训。

[p.73] en: Lastly, the sponsoring organisation should survey personnel about their knowledge of hazards.
zh: 最后，主管部门应调查工作人 员对危险知识的掌握情况。

[p.73] en: Regardless of the size or economic make-up of the community almost every locality is subject to some type risk, such as a major transportation accident or construction collapse, that would necessitate technical rescue expertise.
zh: 无论社区规模或经济结构如何，几乎每个地方都面临某种类型的风险，如重 大交通事故或建筑物倒塌，这些风险都需要技术救援专业力量。

[p.74] en: The presence of hazards in a community creates a risk that someone will become injured or need assistance from rescuers.
zh: 社区中存在的危险，会造成人员受伤或需要救援 人员提供帮助。

[p.74] en: Likewise, if the community expects the team to provide rescue assistance, the lives of the rescuers performing a rescue will be put at risk.
zh: 同样，如果社区期望救援队提供援助，那么执行救援行动的救援人员的生命 就会受到威胁。

[p.74] en: Risks vary in severity.
zh: 风险的严重程度各不相同。

[p.74] en: The presence of one risk may be very mild, whereas the presence of another very severe.
zh: 某一种风险的概率可能非常低，而另 一种风险的概率可能非常高。

[p.74] en: The severity of a hazard must be considered as part of a final risk determination.
zh: 危险的严重程度必须加以考虑，将之作为最终风险 评估结果的一部分。

[p.74] en: In terms of a water rescue team, the risks created by a small pond are much less than those created by a swift water channel.
zh: 对于水域救援队来说，小池塘造成的风险远小于湍急水道造成的风险。

[p.74] en: Likewise, the probability of the occurrence of a rescue incident involving a swift water channel is usually greater than that involving a small pond.
zh: 同样， 涉及急流的水道发生救援事件的概率通常大于涉及小池塘的救援事件。

[p.74] en: The community with the small pond may determine that the risk level created by the pond is too minor to warrant a special water rescue team, whereas the community with the swift water channel may determine otherwise.
zh: 拥有小池 塘的社区可能会认为池塘造成的风险水平太小，所以不需要专业的水域救援队， 而拥有湍急水道的社区可能会做出相反的决定。

[p.74] en: If the rescuers are expected to perform rescues in hazardous environments, they will face risks including toxic environments and inhalation injuries (confined space rescue), drowning (water rescue), falls (rope rescue), secondary collapses and crush syndrome (collapse rescue), and explosions (silo rescue).
zh: 如果救援人员要在危险环境下进行救援，将面临以下各种风险：有毒环境和 吸入性损伤（密闭空间救援）、溺水（水域救援）、坠落（绳索救援）、二次塌 方和挤压综合征（塌方救援）和爆炸（筒仓救援）。

[p.74] en: Each community will have to make its own determination about what an acceptable level of risk is, and what is the risk “threshold” that will necessitate the formation of a special rescue team.
zh: 每个社区都必须自行确定可接受的风险水平，以及需要组建专业救援队的风 险“阈值”。

[p.74] en: The community and local officials should know exactly what the rescue team’s rescue capabilities and limitations are, what risks confront the community, and the dangers that rescuers face in performing rescues.
zh: 社区和地方官员应当清楚地了解以下因素：救援队的救援能力和局 限性、社区面临的风险以及救援人员在救援过程中面临的危险。

[p.74] en: The community should not expect rescuers to perform certain rescues without proper training and equipment.
zh: 在没有适当培训 和装备的情况下，社区不可期望救援人员进行相应的救援工作。

[p.74] en: It is important to differentiate between trained rescuers and spontaneous responders at this point.
zh: 在这种情况下，区分训练有素的救援人员和自发响应人员至关重要。

[p.74] en: Trained personnel know the limitations of their capacity while an untrained spontaneous responder will not.
zh: 受过培 训的人员知道自己救援能力的局限性，而未经培训的自发响应人员则不会。

[p.74] en: Responders of any type must always be cautious not to place themselves in a position where they can become the next victim.
zh: 任何 类型的响应人员都必须始终保持谨慎，不要将自己置于危险环境而成为下一个受 困人员。

[p.74] en: The sponsoring organisation however must consider that when there is no forethought or when rescue operations are clearly botched, there is likely to be public outcry.
zh: 尽管如此，主管部门必须考虑到，如果救援行动缺乏深思熟虑或做得一 团糟，那么很可能会引起公众的强烈抗议。

[p.74] en: The risk analysis should help the sponsoring organisation determine whether a team is necessary.
zh: 通过风险分析，主管部门可以确定是否需要救援队。

[p.75] en: If it demonstrates that a team is required, the next step is to determine what type of team is needed.
zh: 60 表明需要救援队，那么下一步就是确定所需队伍的类型。

[p.75] en: What risks is the sponsoring organisation trying to address?
zh: 主管部门试图应对哪些 风险？

[p.75] en: Will the team handle only basic rescues, or will it be expected to perform complex rescues?
zh: 这支队伍将只执行基本救援，还是需要执行复杂的救援？

[p.75] en: What types of emergencies will this team respond to?
zh: 这支队伍将应对 什么类型的紧急情况？

[p.75] en: Define the extent of the capabilities the sponsoring organisation thinks are needed.
zh: 确定主管部门认为需要具备的各种救援能力。

[p.75] en: These may include:  High angle/rope rescue.  Trench collapse.  Structural collapse.  Confined space.  Agricultural rescue.
zh: 这些救援能 力可能包括：①高角度/ 绳索救援；

[p.75] en:  Vehicle rescue.  Mass transportation rescue.  Industrial rescue.  Machinery entrapment.  Calm or swift water rescue.
zh: ⑩静水救援或急流救援。

[p.75] en: Should a multi-disciplinary team be needed to cover several hazards, such as water and confined space rescue, the sponsoring organisation may want to begin by forming a team in only one of these disciplines, become proficient in it, and then expand to a second discipline.
zh: 如果需要组建一支多专业的救援队伍以应对多种危险，如水域和密闭空间救 援，主管部门可能希望首先只组建其中一个专业的队伍并精通该专业，然后扩展 到第二个专业救援能力。

[p.75] en: It is recommended to first establish proficiency in the most important areas and expand later as the team builds on the initial capacity and after initial skills are developed in this area.
zh: 建议首先在最重要的领域培养熟练的救援技能，在该领域形成初步技能，然 后以此为基础，扩展队伍的技能。

[p.75] en: 2.4.2 Phase II: Planning (a) Establish a Planning Committee to Develop a Plan Select a committee to develop the sponsoring organisation’s plan and appoint a chair.
zh: 第二阶段：规划 2.4.2.1 成立规划委员会以制定计划 组建一个委员会，制定主管部门的计划，并任命一名主席。

[p.75] en: The development committee should contain competent planners as well as individuals who might become the Team Leaders of the technical rescue team during its development and operation phases.
zh: 计划制定委员会 的人员组成应包括：有能力的规划人员，以及可能成为技术救援队组建和行动阶 段组长的人员。

[p.75] en: In forming the committee, the sponsoring organisation may want to place certain individuals that already have rescue experience or other related experience on the planning team.
zh: 在组建委员会时，主管部门可能希望将某些已经具有救援经验或其他相关经 验的个人纳入规划队伍。

[p.75] en: First define the goals for a technical rescue team development committee.
zh: 首先确定技术救援队发展委员会的目标。

[p.75] en: What is the committee’s charter?
zh: 委员会的章程是什么？

[p.75] en: What are the objectives and parameters?
zh: 目标和量化 指标是什么？

[p.75] en: When do they need to complete their planning?
zh: 委员会什么时间必须完成计划？

[p.75] en: The committee should understand the goals and ensure that the goals are focused.
zh: 委员会应了解这些目标，并确保目标的专注性。

[p.75] en: A timeframe should be given for the team to complete a plan.
zh: 应为委员会设定一个完成计 划的时间表。

[p.75] en: At least one member of the rescue team’s top management should be a part of the committee to help give it direction and to verify that it stays on course.
zh: 在救援队最高管理层中，至少有一名成员应成为委员会的成员并提 供指导，确保委员会在正确的轨道上前进。

[p.75] en: The plan should address resources and operations for the following areas:  Organisational structure: What is the hierarchy of the team?
zh: 该计划应涉及以下领域的资源和运作： （1） 组织结构：队伍的层级结构是怎样的？

[p.75] en: How do the administrative and operational elements blend?
zh: 队伍的行政要素和行动要素如 何相得益彰？

[p.76] en: What is the decision-making process?  Personnel and Staffing: Who will be the Team Leader(s)?
zh: 61 第二卷 准备和响应 （2） 人事安排和人员配置：谁将担任队长？

[p.76] en: What types of skills will be necessary to join the team?
zh: 加入队伍需要哪些类型的技 能？

[p.76] en: What will be the size of the team?  Equipment: What equipment will be needed?
zh: 个人能提供什么装备，队伍能提供什么装备？

[p.76] en: What equipment do the individuals provide, what does the team provide?  Vehicles: What type(s) of vehicle(s) will best serve the assigned response area and rescue mission?  Training: What initial training and recurring proficiency training will be needed?
zh: 车辆：什么类型的车辆最适合指定的响应区域和救援任务？

[p.76] en: The specialties covered with the team and the needs of the jurisdiction will help the sponsoring organisation to formulate a mission statement for the team.
zh: 根据队伍涵盖的专业和管辖区的需求，主管部门可以为队伍制定一份使命宣 言。

[p.76] en: The mission statement is important because it will give direction and focus to a new team.
zh: 使命宣言很重要，因为它将为新队伍指明方向和重点。

[p.76] en: Once the sponsoring organisation has determined the type of team needed, it should develop a specific plan of action for creating the team.
zh: 主管部门一旦确定了所需队伍的类型，就应当制定创建队伍的具体行动计 划。

[p.76] en: This plan should cover all aspects of team development including personnel, equipment, and training.
zh: 这份计划应涵盖队伍发展的各个方面，包括人员、装备和培训。

[p.76] en: Organisation structure: Who will lead the organisation, will maintain records, equipment inventories, and provide programme oversight?
zh: 组织架构：谁将领导这支队伍，维护行动记录、管理装备库存并负责项目 监督？

[p.76] en: Political support: Will the sponsoring organisation need to obtain this, or does it already have support from local leaders? (b) Determine Current Capabilities Identify what equipment and training the sponsoring organisation already possesses.
zh: 政府支持：主管部门是否需要获得政府支持，或者是否已经获得地方政府负 责人的支持？

[p.76] en: Some of the equipment needed is probably already on hand.
zh: 某些所需的装备可能已经配 置。

[p.76] en: Additionally, some of team members may have already taken rescue classes.
zh: 此外，某些队员可能已经参加了救援培训课程。

[p.76] en: The more capabilities the sponsoring organisation can identify it already has, the faster and cheaper it will be to start a team. (c) Prepare a Concept of Operations Develop a basic concept of operations and a set of operational procedures.
zh: 主管部门确定其已经拥有的 能力越多，组建队伍的速度就越快，成本也就越低。

[p.76] en: The concept of operations will assist the sponsoring organisation in thinking through how it intends to operate and what resources it will need.
zh: 利用行动概念，主管部门 可以思考救援队的行动方式，以及所需的具体资源。

[p.76] en: It will also help the sponsoring organisation demonstrate to programme management and the public of the potential consequences the community could face if such a resource is not developed, while at the same time showing how the team will be used.
zh: 行动概念还有助于主管部门 向项目管理队伍和公众展示：如果不开发此类资源，那么社区可能面临的潜在后 果；

[p.76] en: Outlines of the operational procedures are needed early in the process to demonstrate to management that the sponsoring organisation have thought through the programme and have not left anything out.
zh: 在组建队伍的早期，需要制定行动程序的大纲，向管理队伍证明主管部门已 经仔细考虑了队伍组建计划，并且没有遗漏任何事项。

[p.77] en: The sponsoring organisation can fill in the detail procedures as it gets closer to putting the team into service. (d) Determine Programme Management Structure An organisation considering the formation of a technical rescue team should identify and task personnel to address the fundamental requirements of the programme.
zh: 62 2.4.2.4 确定项目管理架构 考虑组建技术救援队的组织，应明确项目人员分工，满足完成组建队伍的基 本要求。

[p.77] en: These personnel would comprise the programme management team.
zh: 这些人员将组成项目管理队伍。

[p.77] en: A senior person should be identified as the senior programme officer.
zh: 应指定一名资深人员作为项目高级官员。

[p.77] en: This individual is the central administrator who coordinates all ongoing programme responsibilities (i.e. scheduling meetings, developing proposals and correspondence, assigning tasks, tracking accomplishments, etc.) Most developing teams have found it necessary to name at least one rescue training officer.
zh: 此人是核心管理员，负责承担所有正在进行项目的相关职责（如安排会议、制定 方案和安排沟通、分配任务、跟踪成果等）。

[p.77] en: This position is responsible for the myriad issues involved in developing, conducting, and tracking training certification.
zh: 这名救援培 训官员负责各种相关问题，涉及培训方案的制定、实施和培训认证情况的跟踪。

[p.77] en: Likewise, the assignment of an equipment officer is extremely important.
zh: 同样，救援装备官员的任命也极其重要。

[p.77] en: Tracking information related to equipment and personnel details is made more manageable with the assistance of a computer for word processing, database, spreadsheet programmes etc. (e) Develop a Staffing Plan One of the most critical development steps to accomplish in the formation of a new technical rescue team is to determine how many people are needed for the team.
zh: 制定人员配置计划 在组建新技术救援队时，最关键的一项考虑因素是确定这支队伍的人员配置 规模。

[p.77] en: In general, staffing requirements must address filling all identified command/management staff as well as addressing the minimum number of personnel to effectively and safely conduct tactical operations.
zh: 一般来说，人员配置要求必须解决所有确定的指挥/ 管理人员的问题，并 满足有效、安全地执行策略行动所需的最低人员数量的要求。

[p.77] en: Staffing size will depend on the type of rescue team; a trench rescue team could need more personnel than a water rescue team.
zh: 人员配置规模取决于救援队的类型；

[p.77] en: In general, all major technical rescue disciplines are staffing intensive, at least during the initial start-up phase of operation.
zh: 一般来说，所有主要的技术救援专业都是人员密集型的，尤其是在行动 的初始阶段。

[p.77] en: Trench rescue and structural collapse operations may be the most intensive, easily requiring at least four or five specialists, overseen by command positions and assisted by non-certified personnel.
zh: 沟渠救援和建筑物倒塌救援行动可能是人员最密集的，很容易需要 至少4 ～5 名专家，由指挥人员监督并由非认证人员提供协助。

[p.77] en: Advanced rope operations may require a sizeable cadre of personnel for raising operations.
zh: 高难度的绳索救援可能需要大量人员，以进行提升作业。

[p.77] en: The majority of personnel operating raising or belay lines need not be certified personnel (but must be under direct control of certified personnel).
zh: 进行提升作业或固 定保护绳的大多数人员，不必是经过认证的人员（但其进行救援时，必须在经过 认证的人员的直接指挥下）。

[p.77] en: The staffing plan should also address the number of personnel required per rescue unit (vehicle).
zh: 人员配置计划还应说明每个救援单位（车辆）所需的人员数量。

[p.77] en: Many first response organisations staff heavy rescue squads or other specialised units to address specific tactical requirements.
zh: 许多第一响 应组织配置了重型救援分队或其他专业单位来满足特定的策略需求。

[p.77] en: Other organisations may not be able to accomplish this due to size limitations or other restrictions.
zh: 由于规模等 因素的限制，其他组织可能无法完成此项任务。

[p.77] en: The plan must also include redundancy for all operational positions; the INSARAG Guidelines require a redundancy ratio of 2:1 for these positions.
zh: 这份计划还必须包括所有行动岗位的冗余配置；

[p.77] en: As example, if the team requires 12 rescue personnel for despatch, the team must have 24 rescuers available.
zh: 例如，如果队伍需要派遣12 名救援人员，则队伍必

[p.78] en: Redundancy accounts for member illness, injury or absence without putting the team out of service due to staffing. (f) Identify Initial Equipment and Vehicle Requirements An analysis of the equipment needs should be conducted separately for each discipline.
zh: 冗余配置是为了应对队员生病、受伤或缺勤，这样就不 会导致队伍因人员配置而停止服务。

[p.78] en: Then the separate lists can be combined into a single equipment procurement list.
zh: 然后，可以将各专业的装备 清单合并为一个汇总的装备采购清单。

[p.78] en: Most response agencies may already possess much of the identified equipment.
zh: 大多数应急响应机构可能已经拥有大部分 确定需要的装备。

[p.78] en: In this case, it may only be necessary to gather the equipment in a central location or develop a resource list denoting each item’s location and a mechanism to gather it for response use.
zh: 在这种情况下，可能只需要将装备集中存放在一个位置，或者 编制一个针对各项目位置的装备资源列表，以及装备的紧急调集机制。

[p.78] en: This process may dramatically reduce the funds needed to procure all necessary equipment for the team’s operations, however it will require time in an emergency to gather the equipment if it is not kept at a central location.
zh: 这一过程可能会大幅减少队伍行动所需装备的采购资金，但如果装备没有集 中存放在指定位置，那么在紧急情况下就需要时间来调集装备。

[p.78] en: Some organisations have sent members to training classes to learn what rescue tools are necessary for a new team.
zh: 某些组织已派成 员参加培训班，了解新队伍所需的具体救援装备。

[p.78] en: This is an excellent way to establish basic knowledge of equipment capabilities, which is important for identifying what is needed.
zh: 参加培训是获取装备功能基本 知识的绝佳方法，这对于确定需求非常重要。

[p.78] en: In most cases, if funds are limited, the purchase of equipment should be prioritised based on the greatest need for one or more of the identified team disciplines.
zh: 在大多数情况下，如果资金有限，应优先根据一项或多项已确定的队伍救援 专业的最大需求来购买装备。

[p.78] en: Purchases that increase personnel safety should receive higher priority, while purchases that expand capabilities should be a secondary priority.
zh: 对于人员安全相关装备的采购应当设为更高的优先 级，而用于扩展能力的采购应当是次要的。

[p.78] en: In any case, safety and the need for a certain amount of redundancy in equipment must be stressed.
zh: 无论如何，必须强调安全性，并且， 适当数量的装备冗余是必要的。

[p.78] en: Obviously, if a key tool or piece of equipment malfunctions, or is unavailable due to maintenance, the ability of the team may be critically impaired.
zh: 显然，如果关键工具或装备发生故障或因正在维护而无法使用，并且没有冗 余的装备，那么队伍的能力可能会受到严重损害。

[p.78] en: It may be easiest to request copies of equipment lists from other technical rescue teams and use one or more of these as a starting point for the equipment cache development.
zh: 最简单的方法可能是参考其他 技术救援队的装备列表副本，并以其中一个或多个装备列表为依据，建立装备的 库存。

[p.78] en: Once the sponsoring organisation has determined what equipment is necessary for the team, it can consider which vehicles can carry the equipment and team members.
zh: 主管部门一旦确定了队伍所需的装备，就可以考虑可承载装备和队员的适当 车辆。

[p.78] en: The sponsoring organisation may be able to fit the equipment on an existing unit, or it may need to purchase a new vehicle.
zh: 主管部门可能利用现有的车辆运载装备或者可能需要购买新的车辆。

[p.78] en: Some teams use a cargo trailer, convert an old unit, or request a vehicle be donated by a local business.
zh: 某些 队伍使用货运拖车、改装旧车辆或请求当地企业捐赠车辆。

[p.78] en: (g) Identify Training Requirements The training to competently and safely address each individual capacity is intensive.
zh: 确定培训需求 为了充分和安全地提升每名队员的能力，需要进行密集的培训。

[p.78] en: The greater the number of specialties a technical rescue team assumes responsibility for, the more difficult is the task of bringing personnel up to the necessary training and skill levels.
zh: 技术救援队 负责的救援专业越多，提升人员达到必要的培训和技能水平的任务就越困难。

[p.78] en: In the planning stage, the sponsoring organisation must identify what training it will need, what training is available, and how it will be delivered.
zh: 在规划阶段，主管部门必须确定所需的培训项目、现有的培训项目以及开展 培训的方式。

[p.78] en: Training needs will be determined by the team’s focus.
zh: 培训需求将由队伍的工作重点决定。

[p.78] en: These needs will also be determined by any local or state training requirements (this is particularly important in states regulated by their ministry for occupational safety and health).
zh: 培训需求也将由当地或所在国培 训的要求决定，这在有职业安全和健康监管部门的国家尤其重要。

[p.79] en: When will the training be delivered?
zh: 64 以下问题：培训什么时候开展？

[p.79] en: Who will deliver the training, and how does the team develop its own cadre of trainers? (h) Consider a Plan for Delivering Recurring Training Maintenance of skills is critical to the competency of rescue team members.
zh: 考虑制定复训计划 救援技能的保持，对于救援队员的能力建设至关重要。

[p.79] en: Develop a plan which establishes minimum continuing education standards for members.
zh: 制定一项计划，为救 援队员制定基本的复训标准。

[p.79] en: Some of the recurring training can be done on an individual basis, but the entire team should convene for a team training session several times a year.
zh: 某些复训可以针对个别成员进行，但整支队伍应当 每年开展数次集体培训课程。

[p.79] en: Check with the national training authority to see if it has already established continuing education requirements for rescue team members.
zh: 查询国家培训机构是否已经针对救援队员制定复训要求，还必须考虑开展复 训的成本。

[p.79] en: The cost of recurring training must also be considered. (i) Estimate Cost of Team and Develop a Budget Preparing cost estimation for the team is time consuming and requires research, but it is a very important step in the development of a team.
zh: 估算队伍组建成本并制定预算 队伍组建的成本估算非常耗时且需要进行调查研究，但这是队伍发展中非常 重要的一步。

[p.79] en: Local officials will require a detailed budget plan before approving a team.
zh: 在批准队伍组建之前，地方官员会要求提供一份详细的预算计划。

[p.79] en: The first step in planning a budget is to list separately the major types of rescue the sponsoring organisation plan to undertake (i.e. water rescue, confined space rescue, trench rescue, etc.).
zh: 进行预算的第一步是单独列出主管部门计划进行的主要救援类型（如水域救 援、密闭空间救援、沟渠救援等）。

[p.79] en: Consider each of these as an individual heading.
zh: 将其中每一个类型视为一个单独的预算名目。

[p.79] en: Under each area, list the training, equipment, and apparatus that will be needed to start the team.
zh: 在每个预算名目下，列出组建队伍所需的培训、装备和仪器。

[p.79] en: It is important at this phase to also include costs associated with the design and development of appropriate training areas.
zh: 在此阶段，预算中还应包括与培训场地设计和开发相关的成本，这很重要。

[p.79] en: These areas must accommodate training required for the skill sets that are being developed.
zh: 培训场地必须满足救援队发展技能的培训需求。

[p.79] en: A central training area is acceptable, but consideration must also be given to having access to identified target hazards in the community (industrial plants, cliffs, tunnels etc.) to ensure realistic training is accomplished.
zh: 集中式培训场地是可以考虑的， 但还必须考虑能够进入社区中已确认的目标危险区（工业厂房、悬崖、隧道等）， 以确保在真实现场条件下完成培训。

[p.79] en: List all the equipment and training the sponsoring organisation would like to have – do not leave anything out.
zh: 列出主管部门想要的所有装备和培训项目，不要遗漏任何内容。

[p.79] en:  Training props (concrete slabs, timber etc.)  Classrooms.  Insurance.  Travel expenses.  Medical requirements including vaccinations, medical examinations, post mission recovery etc.  Tools and specialised rescue equipment.  Vehicles.  Protective Clothing (helmet, gloves, boots, clothing etc.) Next, follow national regulations and procedures for the purchase of equipment.
zh: ⑮工具和专业救援装备；

[p.79] en: This will require heavy research.
zh: 这一过程需要进行大量的调查 研究。

[p.79] en: Do not just rely on costs in a catalogue.
zh: 不可仅仅参照装备商品目录中的成本信息。

[p.79] en: Thorough research on pricing involves talking with manufacturers or distributors to find out product capabilities and limitations so that the sponsoring organisation can compare different products.
zh: 对装备价格的深入研究包括： 与制造商或分销商交谈、了解装备的功能和局限性，主管部门以此比较不同的装 备商品。

[p.79] en: The sponsoring organisation also may be able to discuss special pricing.
zh: 主管部门也可以针对具体设备进行议价。

[p.79] en: Prices should be rounded-up in the budget so that it is not under-budgeted.
zh: 预算中的各项价格应向上舍入，

[p.80] en: Once the sponsoring organisation has completed pricing and product research, compare the different products and prices to determine what is best for the current situation.
zh: 主管部门一旦完成价格确认和装备商品研究后，应比较不同的商品和价格， 确定最适合救援队实际需求的产品和价格。

[p.80] en: Total the cost of each training, equipment, and apparatus item to determine the maximum start-up cost.
zh: 计算所有可能的培训、装备和仪器项 目的总成本，确定最大启动成本。

[p.80] en: Those items not immediately essential to initiating a team may be tabled and budgeted in the future.
zh: 那些组建队伍初期并不急需的项目，可能会在 未来提出并制定预算。

[p.80] en: This too will help lower the initial start-up costs.
zh: 上述这样的安排也将有助于降低初始启动成本。

[p.80] en: The sponsoring organisation must determine what items are essential to begin a team.
zh: 主管部门必须确定组建队伍所必需的项目。

[p.80] en: The total of the cost of the essential items is the minimum start-up cost. (j) Obtain Management Support This is probably the most important step in developing a technical rescue team.
zh: 获取管理层的支持 这可能是组建技术救援队最重要的一步。

[p.80] en: The sponsoring organisation must market the added benefit the programme will bring to the community, local businesses and government officials.
zh: 主管部门必须宣传队伍组建计划， 将队伍组建所带来的益处告知社区、当地企业和政府官员。

[p.80] en: All players will need to recognise the benefits of this kind of programme and support it.
zh: 所有利益相关方都需 要认识到此类计划的益处，进而予以支持。

[p.80] en: Is the programme technically feasible?
zh: 队伍组建方案在技术上可行吗？

[p.80] en: Get all necessary supporting materials ready and rehearse before going public with the plan.
zh: 在公开队伍组建计划之前，准备好所有必要 的支持材料，并进行宣传预演。

[p.80] en: The sponsoring organisation may only get one chance to show the value of the programme and can assume that some of the audience will not be favourable or supportive.
zh: 主管部门可能只有一次机会展示队伍组建方案的 价值，并且可以假设某些受众将不赞成或支持这项计划，应为上述可能发生的情 况做好准备。

[p.80] en: Cite other organisations in neighbouring regions or countries that have teams and summarise how their teams are beneficial.
zh: 可引用拥有救援队的邻近地区或邻国其他组织的实例，并总结这些 队伍所带来的益处。

[p.80] en: The sponsoring organisation objective in this step is to get permission to develop the Technical Rescue Team.
zh: 在这一步，主管部门的目标是获得组建技术救援队的许可。

[p.80] en: Obtain support of the sponsoring organisation first, and then present the team concept to the local elected officials.
zh: 首先，主管部门 要支持队伍的组建，然后向当地政府官员介绍队伍理念。

[p.80] en: Usually management will want time to think over the idea.
zh: 通常而言，管理层会需 要时间来思考这一提议。

[p.80] en: Try to set a realistic timeline for the approval decision.
zh: 尝试为提议的批准进程设定一个切实可行的时间表。

[p.80] en: If the sponsoring organisation operates independently of any outside jurisdictional oversight, it can minimise this step.
zh: 如果主管部门有权独立进行队伍的组建，不受辖区任何其他部门的监督，则 可以省略这一步。

[p.80] en: However, if it does not know how its membership feels about a rescue team, don’t assume they will buy into it without significant convincing. (k) Obtain Political Support Develop a plan to obtain political support.
zh: 然而，如果主管部门不知道救援队员对于队伍组建这件事的态 度，不要假设救援队员会在没有充分理由说服的情况下就能接受。

[p.80] en: independent funding source.
zh: 如果主管部门没有独立的资金来源支持，则需要政府支持才能获得资金。

[p.80] en: Remember that eventually the sponsoring organisation will have to go to these elected officials to procure funds for the project.
zh: 请注意，主管部门最终必须寻求这些政府官员的支持，以获得项目资金。

[p.80] en: Be prepared to answer questions about the team.
zh: 准备好回答由政府官员提出的队伍组建相关问题。

[p.81] en: If the sponsoring organisation has gone through each of the previous steps, it will be prepared to answer questions like these.
zh: 如果主管部门已经完成了前面的每个准备步骤，那么需要为回答此类问题做 好准备。

[p.81] en: Be ready to make specific, concise points to justify the request for approval of a new team.
zh: 回答时应做到内容具体、观点简明扼要，证明批准新队伍组建请求的合 理性。

[p.81] en: Below is a list of tips that may help the sponsoring organisation win political support:  Be sure to have support from the sponsoring organisation before going to the elected officials.  Discuss the concept of a team with relevant elected officials.  Prepare a list of hazards in the response area and note the dangers and risks associated with each.
zh: 为了促进主管部门赢得政府支持，可以参考以下建议： （1） 在与政府官员接触之前，务必取得主管部门的支持。

[p.81] en: Give this to the elected officials.  Create a video or slide presentation that will demonstrate the hazards that exist in the area.
zh: 创建视频或幻灯片，展示响应区域存在的危险。

[p.81] en: This alone may justify the team.  Become familiar with other rescue programmes around the region or country that will serve as examples. (l) Look for Partnerships Partnerships are especially helpful to gain political support and secure funding.
zh: 熟悉所在国家/ 地区的其他救援项目，以作为范例。

[p.81] en: Local industry may have confined spaces and, under national regulations, may be required to have a confined space rescue team.
zh: 如果当地产 业设施可能存在密闭空间，那么根据国家法规，可能需要拥有密闭空间救援队。

[p.82] en: The local industry, however, may not have the personnel necessary to have a team, and may request assistance from the sponsoring organisation to serve as their confined space rescue team.
zh: 67 第二卷 准备和响应 然而，当地产业队伍中可能没有组建救援队所需的人员，可能会请求主管部门提 供帮助，将主管部门组建的队伍作为密闭空间救援队。

[p.82] en: The INSARAG Regional Group would be a suitable platform for UN Member States and USAR Teams to share and explore possible support from the regional network, including regional donors.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团区域组是一个合适的平台，联合国成员国和城市搜索 与救援队借此分享和探索区域网络可能提供的支持，包括区域捐助者。

[p.82] en: 2.4.3 Phase Ill: Development of Team (a) Selection of the Team Members Selection of the required team members must be based on the overall teams’ needs and requirements.
zh: 第三阶段：队伍的组建 2.4.3.1 队员的遴选 所需队员的选择，必须基于组建整支队伍的需求和要求。

[p.82] en: The team must comprise the core members that can be deployed immediately for the task.
zh: 队伍必须包含核心 队员，这些队员可以随时部署以执行任务。

[p.82] en: Additional members could be recruited on volunteer basis and their services will only be rendered upon availability.
zh: 以志愿人员为基础，还可以招募队伍 其他成员，他们仅在有空时提供服务。

[p.82] en: considerations such as the acquired skills, knowledge, expertise and competency need to be considered in the selection of the member.
zh: 在选择队员时需要考虑的关键因素，包括其所获得的技能、知识、专长和能 力等。

[p.82] en: One of the best and uniform methods for selecting team members is to conduct interviews.
zh: 遴选队员的一种最佳通用方法是进行面试。

[p.82] en: Start by soliciting personnel who are interested in joining the team.
zh: 首先招募有意加入队伍的人员。

[p.82] en: Have them complete a short questionnaire about why they want to join the team and what skills they could bring to the team.
zh: 让候选人员完成一份简短的调查问卷，了解 他们加入队伍的目的，以及他们可以为队伍带来的技能。

[p.82] en: Any person who has outside skills in areas such as construction, rappelling, EMS, etc. will bring added skills at no extra cost to the organisation.
zh: 在倒塌建筑物救援、绳索垂降、紧急医疗救助等领域，拥有相关技能的各类 人员都可以为组织带来相关领域的技能，而且不会增加机构的成本。

[p.82] en: It is imperative that the sponsoring organisation clearly delineates the additional demands and responsibilities that will be expected of those joining the team before they officially join.
zh: 在这些人员 正式加入队伍之前，主管部门必须向其明确说明加入队伍所要满足的其他要求， 以及要承担的责任。

[p.82] en: For instance, they may be expected to participate in continuing rescue training in addition to maintaining their primary profession.
zh: 例如，除了维持其现有职业外，他们可能还需要参加持续的救援培训。

[p.82] en: In a volunteer organisation, it is especially important to delineate expectations in advance because technical rescue team demands will probably take much more time.
zh: 在志 愿者组织中，提前向队员说明要求尤其重要，因为满足技术救援队的要求可能会 占用较多时间。

[p.82] en: Another consideration when selecting a team is to recruit members who have emergency medical training.
zh: 选择队员时的另一个考虑因素，是招募接受过紧急医疗培训的成员。

[p.82] en: Many rescues will require personnel to perform technical rescue team and emergency medical skills. (b) Train the Team The team will need a thorough initial training programme on all the equipment and the rescue techniques.
zh: 许多救 援工作都需要人员同时具备救援队技术能力和紧急医疗技能。

[p.82] en: Train the people to handle the specific target hazards in the response area (please refer to Annex B).
zh: 队伍培训涉及处 理响应区域内的特定目标危险（请参见本卷本册附件B）。

[p.82] en: It is critical to ensure that the training programme includes a mix of hands-on and technical classroom topics.
zh: 确保培训项目既包括动手实践，又包括课堂技术专题，这一点至关重要。

[p.82] en: INSARAG methodology suggests a foundational approach be taken to any training programme to ensure a stair-step method is followed.
zh: 根 据国际搜索与救援咨询团提供的方法，建议对各种培训项目都采取夯实基础的方

[p.83] en: This lessens the potential that the basic principles of search and rescue training are not overlooked or given lesser status.
zh: 通过这种方法，可以降低搜救培训的基本原则遭到 忽视或不受重视的可能性。

[p.83] en: Realistic training scenarios will require working with area contractors or other organisations to donate trenches, buildings, or other facilities, even after training grounds/props have been developed by the sponsoring organisation. (c) Purchase Equipment and Uniforms Purchase the equipment the team will need based on its mission objectives and based on equipment needs previously defined.
zh: 即使主管部门已经将培训场地建设好并将培训道具制作好，如果想要实现逼 真的培训场景，那么还需要与地区承包商或其他组织合作，获取他们捐助的沟渠、 建筑物或其他设施。

[p.83] en: Start with the basic equipment and add the more complex technical rescue equipment as progress is made. (d) Purchase Vehicles During the planning phase, the sponsoring organisation specified the general type of vehicle it would need (trailer, four-wheel drive, etc.).
zh: 车辆的采购 在规划阶段，主管部门指定了所需车辆的一般类型，如拖车、四轮驱动等。

[p.83] en: In this step, detailed vehicle plans are necessary, including equipment storage, to ensure that equipment will fit in the vehicle.
zh: 在这一步，需要制定详细的车辆计划，包括装备存储，确保车辆适合装备的运输 需求。

[p.83] en: The sponsoring organisation should allow about a one-third growth factor for future equipment additions.
zh: 主管部门应为未来购置的装备留出大约三分之一的尺寸，以增加裕度。

[p.83] en: Make sure there is a secure storage area for everything to avoid damage or injury.
zh: 确保所有装备都有一个安全的储存区域，避免其损坏或损伤。

[p.83] en: If a trailer vehicle is planned, verify that the trailer hitch is sufficient to handle the weight of the trailer and equipment.
zh: 如果计划使用拖 车，那么需要核实拖车挂钩是否足以承受拖车和装备的重量。

[p.83] en: This may require warehouse-type storage as well as what is mounted safely on the vehicle(s).
zh: 采购过程不仅涉及仓库式存储，还涉及将设备安全地固定在车辆上。

[p.83] en: Also, consideration of whether local climate variations (and security) will result in the need for garage parking of the vehicle(s).
zh: 此外， 还要考虑当地的气候变化（及安全状况），确定是否需要在车库中停放车辆。

[p.83] en: (e) Provide Administrative Support One part of the planning process of technical rescue team development that is usually overlooked is the administrative effort necessary to get the team started.
zh: 行政支持保障 在组建技术救援队的规划过程中，通常容易忽视的环节是开始组建队伍所需 的行政工作。

[p.83] en: Members of the team or support staff should be assigned to maintain the records for the team.
zh: 应安排队员或支持人员做好队伍的各项记录。

[p.83] en: The importance of identifying and developing a continuous training and re-training programme is addressing the tracking equipment and accounting of team member attendance at training.
zh: 确定和制定持续定期的培训和复训计划很重要，有助于跟踪装备使用情况， 并统计队员参加培训的出勤情况。

[p.83] en: This is an important administrative step.
zh: 这是一项重要的行政管理工作。

[p.83] en: Additionally, the sponsoring organisation must track all expenses related to training and equipment.
zh: 此外，主管部门必须跟踪与培训和装备相关的所有费用。

[p.83] en: This information will help it conform to the approved budget, develop year-out budgets and will be necessary for reporting to administrators and elected officials. (f) INSARAG First Responder Training Programme To assist in the development of local community response, INSARAG has developed the INSARAG First Responder Training Programme.
zh: 这些信息将有助于 确保费用开支符合批准的预算，制定全年预算，并且也是向管理人员和政府官员

[p.84] en: The flexible programme can be used by the national/local authority as a foundation for first responder capacity building in disaster prone countries.
zh: 国家/ 地方主管部门可以利用灵活这一计划，将其作为灾害多 发国家第一响应人能力建设的基础。

[p.84] en: The programme, which can be adapted to suit local conditions, consists of:  INSARAG First Responder Course.  INSARAG First Responder Training of Trainers Course.  Supporting material for the participants.
zh: 这一计划可根据当地情况进行调整，包括： ①国际搜索与救援咨询团第一响应人课程；

[p.84] en: This course is designed for the local responders from the emergency services and members of local community organisations that will become involved in the emergency management of sudden-onset disasters.
zh: 这一课程是为以下人员设计的：参与突发灾害应急管理的当地应急服务人 员，以及当地社区组织的成员。

[p.84] en: The INSARAG First Responder Course provides the participants with an overview of an organised approach to disaster response, with education provided primarily in the fields of rapid assessment, surface rescue, and initial medical care.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团第一响应人课程向参与者 介绍了有组织的灾难响应方法的总体情况，主要涉及快速评估、地面救援和初步 医疗护理领域的培训。

[p.84] en: Details of the abovementioned programme are available at www.insarag.org and from the INSARAG Secretariat.
zh: 有关上述计划的详细信息，请访问www.insarag.org 网站或咨询国际搜索与 救援咨询团秘书处。

[p.84] en: 2.4.4 Phase IV: Development of SOPs (a) Obtain or write administrative and operational SOPs for the team SOPs are an integral part of a technical rescue team and should complement the approved Concept of Operations.
zh: 第四阶段：标准行动程序的制定 2.4.4.1 制定或编写含有管理和行动两个类型的标准行动程序 标准行动程序是技术救援队不可或缺的部分，将已批准的行动概念补充完善。

[p.84] en: Some organisations choose to function without SOPs, but these are vital to have a safe and organised rescue operation.
zh: 虽然某些组织在没有标准行动程序的情况下就决定开展行动，但这些程序对于安 全和有组织的救援行动至关重要。

[p.84] en: SOPs establish technical rescue team organisation, processes, and techniques before an emergency incident occurs.
zh: 在紧急事件发生之前，运用标准行动程序，可 以确定技术救援队的组织、流程和技术。

[p.85] en: SOPs should answer questions such as who is in charge, what equipment will be used, what techniques will be used, who is qualified to perform a technique, what is expected of each responding unit, and what staffing is required at a rescue incident.
zh: 70 标准行动程序应回答以下问题：谁是负责人、将使用什么装备、将使用什么 技术、谁有资格执行某项技术、对每个应急响应单元有什么期望以及特定救援事 件需要哪些人员配置等。

[p.85] en: Most importantly, they provide a structure by which a technical rescue team can respond safely in an organised fashion to the chaos and uncertainty presented at almost any emergency incident.
zh: 最重要的是，这些行动程序提供了一种指导框架，通过 这种指导框架，技术救援队能够以有组织的方式安全地应对几乎所有紧急事件中 出现的混乱和不确定性。

[p.85] en: Development of technical response SOPs can often prove challenging.
zh: 制定技术响应标准行动程序的过程，通常具有挑战性。

[p.85] en: If the sponsoring organisation requires assistance, it should contact the INSARAG Secretariat who can provide an introduction to resources that have these SOPs on hand.
zh: 如果主管部门需要帮 助，应联系国际搜索与救援咨询团秘书处，获取现有标准行动程序资源的相关信息。

[p.85] en: Technical rescue teams should consider forming two types of SOPs: administrative and operational.
zh: 技术救援队应考虑制定两种类型的标准行动程序：管理类型下的标准行动程 序和行动类型下的标准行动程序。

[p.85] en: The procedures should be consolidated into one manual, and they should be fully integrated with the sponsoring organisation’s existing SOP system.  Administrative SOPs provide the framework for the personnel structure of the team.  Operational SOPs describe things such as techniques and unit responsibilities that are used at an emergency incident.
zh: 管理类型下的标准行动程序，为队伍的人员结构配置提供了指导框架。

[p.85] en: Administrative SOPs The administrative section should address:  Chain of command: The administrative and operational sides of the chain of command for the technical rescue team should be clearly defied.  Specialty certification requirements: The tactical capabilities that the team is responsible for must be clearly identified.
zh: 管理类型下的标准行动程序包括以下内容： （1）指挥链：应明确技术救援队指挥系统的管理和行动命令流程。

[p.85] en: The training requirements related to each discipline must be fully defined.
zh: 必须清晰定义与 每个救援专业相关的培训要求。

[p.85] en: This should include the initial training required for certification in each discipline, as well as continuing education requirements.
zh: 应包括每个救援专业认证所需的初始 培训，以及持续培训要求。

[p.85] en:  Unit/equipment requirements: This section would define the types of vehicles and equipment for the technical rescue team.
zh: 单元/ 装备要求：这一部分将定义技术救援队的车辆和装备类型。

[p.85] en: Any requirements related to the management, organisation, and maintenance of the team equipment cache must be addressed.
zh: 与 队伍装备库存管理、组织和维护相关的所有要求都必须得到满足。

[p.85] en: This should include the development of a routine cache maintenance/exercise schedule to ensure the operational readiness of all tools, equipment, and supplies.  Unit staffing: The staffing of specialty vehicles, if dedicated, should be identified.
zh: 这 应包括制定例行装备库存维护/ 装备使用演练计划，确保行动需要的 所有工具、装备和用品都已准备就绪。

[p.85] en: This would include any minimum staffing requirements, if mandated.
zh: 如果法律法规有相关的要求，则应明确最低人员配置。

[p.85] en: Or, it may only be necessary to mandate the number of specialty personnel required to effectively handle technical rescue operations (the number may vary by incident type).
zh: 或者，可能只 需要规定高效开展技术救援行动所需的专业人员数量（数量可能因灾 害事件类型而异）。

[p.85] en: In any case, the number of certified personnel and/or minimum staffing requirements should be clearly understood by all.
zh: 无论在何种情况下，所有队员都应当清楚地了解 认证人员的数量和/ 或最低人员配置要求。

[p.86] en: These may be separated by event type (i.e. trench, structural collapse, rope, etc.), if necessary.
zh: 如有 必要，可按灾害事件类型（如沟渠救援、建筑物倒塌救援、绳索救援 等），将行动程序分别列出。

[p.86] en: Unique requirements or considerations for each discipline should be addressed.  Regulations/requirements: Certain technical rescue operations are impacted by local, state, or national regulations.
zh: 法规/ 要求：某些技术救援行动需要遵循地方级、省级或国家级法规 的要求。

[p.86] en: These regulations should be included in the procedures.  Scene management procedures: Most organisations already have an incident command system in place.
zh: 现场管理流程：大多数组织已经建立了事故指挥系统。

[p.86] en: The basic command structure can be used at any incident, including a technical rescue incident, but additional technical rescue command positions should be added to it.
zh: 基本指挥结构 可用于任何灾害事件救援，包括技术救援事件，但还应增加其他的技 术救援指挥岗位。

[p.86] en: This section of the SOPs must detail how technical rescue incidents will be commanded.
zh: 标准行动程序的这一部分，必须详细说明技术救援 事件的指挥流程。

[p.86] en: A command organisational structure designed for technical incidents should be prepared.  Tactical command worksheets: Most technical rescue teams have developed some type of tactical checklist or command worksheets to assist technical rescue command personnel in the management of an incident.
zh: 策略性指挥工作表：大多数技术救援队伍都制定了某种类型的策略核 查表或指挥工作表，以协助技术救援指挥人员管理救援事件。

[p.86] en: These may be developed for each discipline, if necessary.  Team activation: Activation procedures must be developed and exercised by the full team to ensure their completeness and adequacy.
zh: 队伍启动：启动程序必须由整支队伍制定和执行，确保其完整性和充 分性。

[p.86] en: In addition, after a major rescue incident, the procedures should be reviewed and revised if they proved to be faulty or gaps identified.
zh: 此外，在重大救援事件发生后，如果发现程序有缺陷或存在漏洞，则应 重新审查和修订程序。

[p.87] en: Figure 2: How to Form a Technical Rescue Team
zh: 72 组建技术救援队的流程如图2 所示。

[p.88] en: 2.5 Funding Requirements and Potential Sources Technical rescue operations can be an expensive undertaking for many jurisdictions.
zh: 73 第二卷 准备和响应 2.5 资金需求和潜在来源 对于许多辖区来说，技术救援行动可能是一项成本高昂的任务。

[p.88] en: Given financial constraints, locating funding sources can be one of the most difficult hurdles to overcome for new rescue teams.
zh: 鉴于资金有 限，寻找资金来源可能是新救援队最难克服的一个障碍。

[p.88] en: Existing teams often fight for their budgets each fiscal year and are always looking for new and creative ways to finance their operations.
zh: 在每个财政年度，现有 队伍经常为争取预算资金而努力，并且一直在寻找新的、创造性的方式来为队伍 运作融资。

[p.88] en: This chapter discusses where the money goes when forming a team, sources of funding, and ideas for justifying a team’s expenses.
zh: 本章节讨论组建队伍时的资金流向、资金来源以及证明队伍开支合理性的 方法。

[p.88] en: 2.5.1 The Financial Costs: Where the Money Goes To help establish the type of rescue service needed in the community and the financial support the community is willing to give, it will be important to understand where the money need to be spent and how much is needed.
zh: 财务成本：资金流向 为了帮助确定社区所需的救援服务类型，以及社区愿意提供的财务支持，了 解资金流向以及所需资金规模非常重要。

[p.88] en: To prepare for budgeting, care should be taken to account for the large number of consumables (timber, blades, medical supplies and so on), as well as operating expenses (equipment rental) and personnel costs (travel, compensation, insurance as example) required to delivery training. a.
zh: 在编制预算时，应注意考虑用量较大的 消耗品（木材、刃具、医疗用品等），以及运行费用（装备租赁）和开展培训所 需的人员开支（如差旅费、报酬、保险费）。

[p.88] en: Initial training: Training costs can range per student per course.
zh: 初始培训：每一位学员每门课程的培训费用各不相同。

[p.88] en: Thorough training is necessary to have a safe and effective rescue capacity.
zh: 要想具备安全高效的救援能力，全面培训必不可 少。

[p.88] en: The sponsoring organisation may consider training team members over a two- or three-year period to spread out the costs.
zh: 主管部门可以考虑将队员培训安排在两年或三年的时间内完成， 以分摊成本。

[p.88] en: Budget for personnel to receive basic awareness level training the first year and operations training the second year.
zh: 第一年的预算用于人员基本认知层面的培训；

[p.88] en: A few select members could later be trained to the technician level or higher.
zh: 某些经过选拔的队员，随后可以接受技术人 员或更高级别的培训。

[p.88] en: Efforts should be made to have incident commanders participate in training, so they have an understanding of the rescue operations and equipment.
zh: 要尽力让事故救援指挥官参加培训，确保其了 解救援行动和装备。

[p.88] en: This will also help when commanders develop SOPs for their rescue teams.
zh: 指挥官在为其救援队制定标准行动程序时，参加 培训也将有所帮助。

[p.88] en: It is also vital to develop an internal core of trainers to lessen the cost of a programme. b.
zh: 培养内部教官骨干以降低项目成本，也至关重要。

[p.88] en: Continuing education: Funding for technical rescue teams must consider a commitment to continually train and retrain personnel.
zh: 持续培训：在为技术救援队提供资金时，必须考虑人员持续培训和复 训的投入。

[p.88] en: It is not enough to initially train and equip a team; to be effective members must constantly practice their skills and learn new ones.
zh: 要培养出行动高效的队员， 必须不断练习已有技能并学习新技能。

[p.88] en: For example, it has been estimated that proficiency at technical rope rescue skills is reduced within six months after completing a rope rescue course if training is not maintained.
zh: 例如，在完成绳索救援课程后 的六个月内，如果不坚持练习，那么绳索救援技术的熟练程度可能会 下降。

[p.88] en: Continuing education for technical rescue may be even more important because rescue incidents are usually rare, unlike other emergency events.
zh: 技术救援的持续培训可能更为重要，因为与其他紧急事件不同， 救援事件的发生频率通常较低。

[p.88] en: Continuing education expenses are incurred from sending personnel to refresher courses or advanced courses that count toward recertification, or from holding a special continuing education drill.
zh: 持续培训费用涉及以下过程产生的费 用：派遣人员参加重新认证的复训课程或高级课程或举办专门的持续 培训演练。

[p.89] en: Holding a drill is generally the cheapest alternative but, in most cases, it will not provide certification for attendees.
zh: 74 举行演练通常是费用最少的方式，但在大多数情况下，这种方式不能 为参加者提供认证。

[p.89] en: Legal mandates may require regular recertification training, which can be a more expensive proposition requiring the sponsoring organisation to hire an instructor that can recertify personnel.
zh: 法律可能要求定期进行重新认证培训，这可能是 一种费用更高的方式，因为这意味着要求主管部门聘请可以对人员进 行重新认证的教练。

[p.89] en: Forty-eight hours of continuing education per year is not an unreasonable requirement. c.
zh: 每年为期48 小时的持续培训，是一项合理的要求。

[p.89] en: Equipment: Equipment costs will depend on the type of rescue capacity the community requires.
zh: 装备：装备成本将取决于社区所需的救援能力类型。

[p.89] en: Basic equipment to perform many rescues such as rope, ladders, and breathing apparatus may already be available within organisation.
zh: 主管部门可能已 经配备了执行多种救援的基本装备，如绳索、架梯和呼吸器具。

[p.89] en: In many cases, supplemental equipment to augment the rescue capabilities could be purchased.
zh: 在许 多情况下，可以补充购买其他装备以增强救援能力。

[p.89] en: Advanced capabilities, however, generally require expensive specialised equipment.
zh: 然而，更强的救 援能力通常需要昂贵的专用装备。

[p.89] en: Costs for equipment storage and maintenance must be considered also.
zh: 还必须考虑装备的储存和维护成本。

[p.89] en: Large caches of equipment must be kept secured but accessible in an emergency.
zh: 储存的大量装备必须妥善保管，确保其在紧急情况下可以使用。

[p.89] en: Transport vehicles: The major vehicle expenses a rescue team will encounter are for purchasing or retrofitting, maintenance, and fuel.
zh: 运输车辆：救援队所需的主要车辆费用，涉及车辆的购买、改装和维护， 以及燃料。

[p.89] en: The amount of money spent on vehicles to transport a team and its equipment will also vary widely.
zh: 对于运输车辆及其装备，不同队伍花费的金额有很大差异。

[p.89] en: Vehicles range in type from pickup trucks and sport utilities to box vans and heavy squads.
zh: 车辆类型多种多样，包括皮卡车、运动型多功能车、厢式货车和重型 货车。

[p.89] en: Many teams pull gear in trailers.
zh: 许多队伍利用拖车运输装备。

[p.89] en: Opportunity exists for having vehicles donated.
zh: 有时可以获得捐赠的车辆。

[p.89] en: Many utility companies donate vans or trucks to non-profit entities; the sponsoring organisation may be eligible.
zh: 许多 公用事业公司向非营利组织捐赠货车或卡车；

[p.89] en: Private companies have donated beverage trucks or tractor trailer boxes to teams.
zh: 私营公司可能向队伍捐赠了饮料车或货柜车厢。

[p.89] en: Using these local resources can reduce the budgeting amounts.
zh: 利用这些当地资源， 可以减少预算金额。

[p.89] en: Annual maintenance costs must also be accounted for, especially if an additional unit is added to a fleet of apparatus. e.
zh: 还必须考虑年度维护成本，特别是在一组装备中 添加其他单元的情况下。

[p.89] en: Insurance: The cost of insurance is often overlooked.
zh: 保险：保险费用常常被忽视。

[p.89] en: The sponsoring organisation may need to purchase insurance for equipment, vehicles, personnel, or malpractice.
zh: 主管部门可能需要为装备、车辆、人员 或意外事故购买保险。

[p.89] en: An organisation may be able to absorb insurance costs into its existing policy.
zh: 主管部门也许能够将保险成本纳入其现有保单 中。

[p.89] en: In this case, the sponsoring organisation must verify that existing policies will extend coverage for these new operations.
zh: 在这种情况下，主管部门必须检查现有保单是否能扩大并覆盖这 些新保险范围。

[p.89] en: An organisation may need to add or make changes to its insurance policy to make sure its members are covered for confined space rescue or water rescues – duties which may not be listed in the organisation’s charter, by-laws, mission statement, or articles of incorporation.
zh: 主管部门可能需要添加或更改其保单，确保其成员获得密闭空间救援 或水域救援的承保，这些职责可能未在主管部门的章程、附则、使命 宣言或公司章程中列出。

[p.89] en: Local officials and lawyers should be involved in this process.
zh: 地方官员和律师应参与这一购买保险的过程。

[p.89] en: Insurance issues for consolidated teams, mutual aid coverage, and out of jurisdiction training also must be addressed. f.
zh: 整合队伍、互助保险和辖区外培训的保险问题，也必须得到解决。

[p.89] en: Justifying expenses: Local officials will want the sponsoring organisation to justify the expenses necessary to start and fund a rescue team.
zh: 证明费用的合理性：为了组建和资助救援队，当地官员希望主管部门 证明所需费用是合理的。

[p.89] en: A team may be easier to justify in a community with a large risk potential; smaller or less frequent risks make justifying funding more difficult.
zh: 而在风险较小或风险发生频率较低的社 区，证明队伍组建融资的合理性将变得更加困难。

[p.90] en: The expenses must be justified to the many individuals who control the financing; attempts should be made to involve all of them in the programme development for the team.
zh: 应尝试让所有相关人员都 参与到队伍组建项目中。

[p.90] en: A Team Leader must justify the funding to the organisation, who then must justify it to the elected officials.
zh: 队长必须向主管部门证明资金流向的合理性，然后主管部门必须向政 府官员证明资金流向的合理性。

[p.90] en: Today, public budgets are placed under a microscope – a clearly defined mission for a team is as important to its financial success as to its operational success.
zh: 如今，公共预算受到公众的仔细检视， 而明确的队伍使命同样重要，后者有助于成功获得资金和开展救援行 动。

[p.90] en: Linking funding requests to existing local needs – especially past incidents and safety concerns, provides more legitimate justification of the funding requests.
zh: 将资金需求与当地现有需求（尤其是过去的救援事件和安全问题） 联系起来，可以为资金需求提供更加合理的理由。

[p.90] en: Local, state or national regulations can also be used to justify a team’s expenses.
zh: 地方级、省级或国 家级法规也可用于证明队伍资金需求的合理性。

[p.90] en: An analysis of a country’s occupation health and safety regulations and other rescue standards should be conducted.
zh: 国家职业健康和安全法规以及其他救援标准，也应进行分析。

[p.90] en: The sponsoring organisation should research local/national safety rules and regulations to justify team expenses.
zh: 主管部 门应研究当地/ 国家的安全法律和法规，以证明队伍资金需求的合理 性。

[p.90] en: All decision-makers should understand that, unlike most emergency operations, providers of technical rescue may be subject to severe fines and sanctions if they fail to comply with established occupational health and safety standards while performing their duties.
zh: 所有决策者都应当了解，与大多数紧急行动不同，如果技术救援 提供方在履行职责时未能遵守既定的职业健康和安全标准，那么可能 会受到严厉的罚款和处罚。

[p.90] en: Many would-be rescuers have died attempting to perform rescues they were not trained or equipped to handle.
zh: 在没有接受过培训或缺乏装备的情况下， 许多非认证救援人员会在尝试进行救援时丧生。

[p.90] en: Making the public and government administrators aware of these issues may help justify the team.
zh: 让公众和政府管理人 员意识到这些问题，可能有助于证明队伍资金需求的合理性。

[p.90] en: 2.5.2 Funding Sources Finances for a technical rescue programme may come from many different sources.
zh: 资金来源 对于技术救援需求的资金，可能有许多不同的来源。

[p.90] en: Often, municipal tax funds are allocated to add technical rescue services to existing emergency service providers.
zh: 通常，市政税收资金会 被分配给现有的紧急服务提供方，以增强技术救援服务。

[p.90] en: Donated money and equipment can also be used.
zh: 捐赠的资金和装备也可 以使用。

[p.90] en: Grants may be difficult to secure but may provide the necessary seed money to get a programme established.
zh: 拨款可能很难获得，但可以提供必要的种子资金以启动项目。

[p.90] en: Examples of funding sources include:  Direct funding from local and national government.  Cost sharing.  Public-private partnerships.  Local clubs and community charities.  User fees and cost recovery.  Permit fees.  Donor countries/organisations.
zh: 资金来源的示例如下：①地方政府和国家政府的直接资助；

[p.90] en: 2.6 Personnel and Staffing The backbone of a good technical rescue team is well trained, experienced personnel.
zh: 6 人事安排和人员配置 一支优秀的技术救援队，其骨干是训练有素、经验丰富的人员。

[p.90] en: The personnel can be either career or volunteer or come from other backgrounds.
zh: 这些人员可 以是职业人员、志愿者或来自其他背景。
