[p.132] en: A specialist could be thoroughly expert in the use of all types of rescue equipment and techniques for trench rescue incidents and should have practical and teaching experience.
zh: 专家层级的培训可能要求精通各种类型的救援装备和沟渠救援行动技术，并 且具有实践和教学经验。

[p.132] en: Trench rescue shares equipment, rescue techniques, and skills with both confined space rescue and collapse rescue.
zh: 沟渠救援与密闭空间救援和塌方救援一样，需要相同的装备、救援技术和技 能。

[p.132] en: A course could be designed to include aspects of each discipline.
zh: 课程安排可能包含每个救援专业的各个方面。

[p.132] en: Sample course topics:  Trench hazards.  Securing the scene.  Safety.  Incident command.  Equipment and resources.  SOPs.  Shoring techniques.  Rigging.  EMS care.  Entry and patient removal techniques.
zh: 沟渠救援课程主题示例 （1）沟渠的各种危险 （5）装备和资源 （9）紧急医疗救助 （2）现场安全 （6）标准行动程序 （10）沟渠进入和伤员转移技术 （3）安全 （7）支护技术 （4）事件指挥 （8）索具 沟渠救援必要的个人装备 （1）头盔 （4）个人防护服 （7）护眼装置 （2）手套 （5）安全带 （8） 自给式呼吸装置/ 供气呼吸系统 （3）工作靴 （6） 护膝/ 护肘 （9）折叠铲 4. 结构性倒塌救援 结构性倒塌救援与沟渠救援和密闭空间救援一样，采用许多相同的技术。

[p.132] en: An awareness of the dangers of structural collapse could cover types of construction and associated hazards, types of collapses, how to secure the scene, and when to call for help.
zh: 对 结构倒塌危险的认知层级培训内容可能包括：建筑类型和相关危险、倒塌类型、 现场保护方法以及寻求援助的时机。

[p.132] en: This could be taught in approximately eight hours.
zh: 认知层级的培训大约需要8 个小时就能完成。

[p.132] en: An operations level of training could also include patterns for conducting surface debris search for victims, basic stabilisation, utility control, and atmospheric monitoring.
zh: 行动层级的培训可能包括：在废墟表面搜索埋压人员的各种模式、基本加固 措施、公共设施控制和空气监测模式。

[p.132] en: It could be taught in two to three days.
zh: 行动层级的培训需要2 ～3 天的时间。

[p.132] en: A technician level course covering shoring and building stabilisation, rescue equipment, search equipment and operations, tunnelling and excavation techniques, and patient care could be taught in approximately five days.
zh: 技术员层级的培训课程涵盖：支护和建筑物加固、救援装备、搜索装备及其 操作、隧道和挖掘技术以及伤员护理。

[p.132] en: Water Rescue One of the most dangerous types of special rescue is water rescue.
zh: 专家层级的培训要求精通以下内容：各种类型的轻型和重型救援技术的使 用、危险建筑加固和减轻风险以及城市搜索与救援技术的组成部分。

[p.133] en: There are several different specialties within the field of water rescue.
zh: 水域救援领域包括多个不同的专业。

[p.133] en: Rescuers may face incidents involving calm water, swift water, ice, or even surf conditions.
zh: 救援人员可能会遇到涉及静水、急流、结冰甚至海浪环境的事故。

[p.133] en: Dive rescue is a specialty within itself and is not discussed in this manual.
zh: 潜水救援本就 是一个救援专业，本手册不对其进行介绍。

[p.133] en: Courses in each training level could be designed to address all types of water rescue or individual types (e.g. swift water rescue only).
zh: 每个培训级别的课程可能包括所有类型的水域救援或个别类型的水域救援 （如只涉及急流救援）。

[p.133] en: A basic awareness of water hazards, safety, and shore-based rescue techniques can be taught in a few hours.
zh: 认知层级的培训需要数个小时，包括水域危险、安全 及岸上救援技术。

[p.133] en: Different types of water rescue may share similar techniques but pose different dangers.
zh: 不同类型的水域救援可能采用相似的技术，但会面临不同的 危险。

[p.133] en: Operations level training could cover techniques for in-water or ice rescue.
zh: 行动层级的培训可能涵盖水域或冰域救援技术。

[p.133] en: Rescuers could become familiar with different types of water rescue techniques, ice and current hazards, hypothermia and EMS considerations, ice rescue equipment, and shore-based swift water rescue techniques.
zh: 救援人员可以掌握的技能包 括：各种类型的水域救援技术、冰域和水流危险、失温症和紧急医疗救助注意事 项、冰域救援装备以及岸基急流救援技术。

[p.133] en: This course could be taught in about one week but would require personnel to be able to swim.
zh: 这门课程大约需要7 天的时间，但要 求学员具备游泳能力。

[p.133] en: The technician level could require knowledge in all facets of water rescue and how to perform special rescue techniques such as victim retrieval using boats or a helicopter.
zh: 技术员层级的培训可能包括：水域救援各个方面的知识，以及运用特殊救 援技术的方法，如使用船只或直升机营救受困人员。

[p.133] en: This course too could be taught in about one week.
zh: 这门课程也需要大约7 天的 时间。

[p.134] en: The specialist level could require in-depth knowledge of all types of water rescue techniques and hazards as well as practical and training experience.
zh: 119 第二卷 准备和响应 专家层级的培训可能包括：深入掌握所有类型的水域救援技术和危险，以及 实践和培训经验。

[p.134] en: Must be available on short notice to mobilise within ten hours of request and be personally self- sufficient for at least 72 hours for a response assignment of up to ten days in austere environments.
zh: 必须在接到请求后的10 小时内立即动身执行任务，并能够在至少72 小时内实现自给自足，确保在严峻的环境中可以执行长达10 天的响 应任务。

[p.134] en: Must be capable of improvising and functioning for long hours under adverse conditions.
zh: 必须能够在不利条件下进行灵活应对，并长时间开展救援行动。

[p.134] en: Must be able to function safely at heights and on or around rubble.
zh: 必须能够在高空、废墟或其周围安全地开展救援。

[p.135] en: Must understand and adhere to safe working practices and procedures as required in the urban disaster environment.
zh: 120 （6） 必须了解并遵守城市灾害环境中所需的安全工作惯例和程序。

[p.135] en: Must have first aid training.
zh: 必须受过急救相关技能的培训。

[p.135] en: Must understand the needs of and provide support to their counterparts within the INSARAG community for specific operations, techniques and application of tools and equipment.
zh: 针对具体救援行动、技术以及工具和装备应用，必须了解国际搜索与 救援咨询团体系内同行的需求，并为其提供支持。

[p.135] en: Hazmat First Responder Training in:  Hazmat incidents.  Hazmat recognition.  Use of the Emergency Response Guide (ERG).  Safety and health.  Initial control and incident management.
zh: ③运用应急响应指南（ERG）；

[p.135] en: Incident Command System (ICS) Training in:  ICS principles and structure.  Expansion and contraction of ICS structure.  Facilities.  Resources.  Action plan.  Activation, demobilisation and operational closure.
zh: 事故指挥系统（ICS） 培训内容：①事故指挥系统原理和架构；

[p.136] en: INSARAG Guidelines and principles Training in:  Protocols.  Guidelines.  Procedures.  UCC.
zh: 国际搜索与救援指南和原则 培训内容：①协议；

[p.136] en: Planning Officer Position Prerequisites:  Occupy an existing senior management position in organisation.  Understanding of INSARAG Methodology.  Registered user of the VOSOCC and a functional understanding of its utilisation.  Computer literacy.  Functional English.
zh: 轻型、中型和重型城市搜索与救援队的最低培训标准 1. 管理 1）队长/ 副队长 岗位要求： （1） 在机构中担任高级管理岗位。

[p.136] en:  Cultural awareness.  Completion of the online UN BSAFE security awareness course.  GIS applications including use of GPS.
zh: 完成联合国在线 BSAFE 安全认知课程。

[p.137] en: Operations Officer Position Prerequisites:  Occupy an existing senior management position in organisation.  Understanding of INSARAG Methodology.  Registered user of the VOSOCC and a functional understanding of its utilisation.
zh: 规划官 岗位要求： （1） 在机构中担任高级管理岗位。

[p.137] en:  Functional English.  Cultural awareness.  Completion of the online UN BSAFE security awareness course.  Documented experience in USAR operations.
zh: 完成联合国在线 BSAFE 安全认知课程。

[p.138] en: Position Prerequisites:  Occupy an existing logistics management position in home organisation.
zh: 行动官 岗位要求： （1） 在机构中担任高级管理岗位。

[p.138] en: Communications/IT Specialist Position Prerequisites:  Occupy an existing communications/IT position in home organisation.  Functional experience with communications/IT equipment.  Understanding of INSARAG Methodology.  Registered user of the VOSOCC.  Computer literacy.  Functional English.  Completion of the online UN BSAFE security awareness course.
zh: 掌握现有技术的实际应用（包括测绘）。

[p.138] en: Roles and Responsibilities:  Understanding of all team functions.
zh: 掌握人事管理技巧：①沟通；

[p.139] en: RESCUE Rescue Team Officer/Rescue Technician (Those in bold are applicable only to the Rescue Team Officer).
zh: （d）给予员工福利，包括队员的休整与恢复。

[p.139] en: Position Prerequisites:  Occupy an existing operational management position in home organisation.  Serve at home in an operational management position.  Must possess all certifications and fulfil all requirements of a Rescue Technician within home organisation.  Understanding of INSARAG Methodology.  Completion of the online UN BSAFE security awareness course.
zh: 解决战术问题：①对于任务区域的行动控制；

[p.139] en: Rigging Specialist Position Prerequisites:  Knowledge of the operational characteristics and capability of heavy construction equipment.  Understanding of the methods of construction and the demolition of structures.
zh: 结构工程师 岗位要求： （1） 获得土木/ 建筑工程学位（参见本文件末尾有关结构工程师的描述） 并受过工程救援培训。

[p.141] en: It must also have support of its national government to engage in international humanitarian relief activities, especially regarding USAR.
zh: 借调到联合国灾害评估与协调队后的作用和职责： （1） 掌握联合国灾害评估与协调方法的实用知识。

[p.142] en: Position Training Performance Criteria Equipment Team Leader and Deputy Team Leader Light, Medium and Heavy  USAR methodology at national level.  Understanding of INSARAG methodology including OSOCC methodology.  Ability to implement and follow recognised incident command protocols.
zh: 人事管理技巧：①沟通；

[p.142] en: Team at the level of classification.  Personal protective equipment.
zh: 对任务区域进行安全控制：①对所有角色进行评估，始终确保安全和 伤害预防的最佳效果；

[p.142] en: Safety and Security Officer Light, Medium and Heavy  Occupational health and safety.  Field hygiene procedures.  Risk assessment procedures.  Situation, risk and needs assessments.  Rehabilitation and crew rotation.
zh: ③建 立安全和风险评估文档；

[p.142] en: Light, Medium and Heavy  Administrative tools and supplies required to provide safety and security for the USAR Team at the level of classification.  Personal protective equipment.
zh: ⑥工具和装备运用的知识。

[p.142] en: Liaison Officer Heavy  Liaison function as referenced in the INSARAG Guidelines.  Development of a Plan of Action.
zh: 制定并实施行动计划的安全层面：①分析与安全注意事项相关的数 据；

[p.143] en: Light, Medium and Heavy  Administrative tools and supplies required to interact with the media for the USAR Team at the level of classification.
zh: 在工作区域内进行以下内部协作：①确保工具和装备的管理、保养及 维修责任；

[p.143] en: Light, Medium and Heavy  Facilitate meetings, documentation of events and development of short- and long-range plans of action.  Coordination with local Incident Commander, Operations and OSOCC.
zh: 制定与后勤相关的行动计划：①行动基地以及工具和装备库存的控 制；

[p.143] en: Position Training Performance Criteria Equipment personnel to incident site.  Completion of equipment manifest and declaration of hazardous goods.
zh: ④将装备和救援 人员运送到事故现场；

[p.143] en: Communications Specialist Light, Medium and Heavy  Installation, operation and maintenance of communications and IT equipment and UHF/VHF radio systems  Geospatial technologies.
zh: 具有通信/ 信息技术装备的工作经验。

[p.144] en: Light, Medium and Heavy  Ensure communications equipment is operational in accordance with the INSARAG Guidelines.
zh: 安装、操作和维护：①通信和信息技术装备；

[p.144] en: Light, Medium and Heavy  Communications equipment including hand-held radios, satellite telephones, computers, facsimile machines and internet connectivity for the USAR Team at the level of classification.
zh: ②超高频/ 甚高频无线 电；

[p.145] en: Medium or Heavy  Tools, supplies and equipment required to monitor building stability and design shoring systems.
zh: ⑨工 具和装备运用的知识；

[p.146] en: Position Training Performance Criteria Equipment  Management of search operations including application of grid systems, mapping and land navigation.  Search (hailing and physical).  INSARAG marking and signalling systems.  Management of a coordinated search theory utilising either technical or canine search and rescue resources.
zh: ③理解并能熟练运用索具和起重相关战术问题 的实用解决方案；

[p.146] en: Heavy  Management of a coordinated search theory utilising both electronic and canine search and rescue resources.  Administrative tools and supplies required to manage search operations for the USAR Team at the level of classification.  Signalling devices.  Building marking supplies.
zh: 搜索 技术搜索/ 搜救犬训导员 岗位要求： （1） 必须拥有各种相关资质，满足国内机构中搜索技术员或搜救犬训导员 的所有要求。

[p.147] en: Light, Medium and Heavy  Management equipment to achieve a high state of deployment readiness.  Compliment rescue operations and be effective in the field.
zh: ③确定救 援现场的组织和后勤需求；

[p.147] en: Light, Medium and Heavy  Technical equipment used to detect and/or locate victims including specialised cameras and acoustic/seismic devices.
zh: （d）利用 摄像头和监听装备启动受困人员定位阶段；

[p.147] en: Canine Search Specialist/Dog Handler Light, Medium and Heavy  Canine search operations including check/recheck procedures and observer responsibilities.  Search pattern selection criteria including terrain; structures; and wind, weather and air circulation characteristics.  Awareness of the hazards to the canine associated with various disaster environments.
zh: ⑦掌握救援工具（包括搜 救犬）和装备的知识和维护；

[p.148] en: Light, Medium and Heavy  Search canines trained in air-scenting to detect entrapped victims.
zh: 在动员、行动和撤离期间，与搜救犬训导员合作，为城市搜索与救援 队搜救犬提供紧急兽医护理。

[p.150] en: Medium  Break, breach, lift and remove building components.  Assemble vertical and window/door shoring systems.  Cut and/or penetrate concrete up to 300 mm thick and timber up to 300 mm.  Stabilise building components.
zh: 中型队必须能够在由重型木质结构、 钢筋砖石结构、轻质钢结构、木框架和其他轻质建筑物倒塌或损坏灾害事件中进 行搜救行动。

[p.150] en: Heavy  Cut and/or penetrate concrete up to 450 mm thick and timber up to 300 mm.  Cut and/or burn metal, structural steel or steel bar up to 20 mm.
zh: 重型 除了具备中型救援行动级别的能力外，重型队还应当有能力在倒塌或损坏的 钢筋混凝土或钢质框架结构中（在两个不同的地点）进行搜救行动。

[p.155] en: Heavy  Hydraulic, pneumatic and mechanical equipment for cutting and burning metal, structural steel or steel bar up to 20 mm.  Hydraulic, pneumatic and mechanical equipment to cut and/or penetrate concrete up to
zh: ③结构、材 料和损坏类型；

[p.155] en: Position Training Performance Criteria Equipment 450 mm thick and timber up to 300 mm.  Equipment for assembling raker and other required shoring systems such as box, sloped and custom shoring.
zh: ⑤装备、工具和 配件的运用；

[p.158] en: Though there may be extremely rare situations in which these two procedures are indicated as a last resort, the better course of action is to avoid these, if possible.
zh: 尽管截肢和肢解被认为是最 后手段的情况极少发生，但更好的方案是尽可能避免这样的情况。

[p.158] en: There are multiple considerations:  Amputations  There are multiple limb salvage score criteria in use around the world.
zh: 截肢和肢解需要考虑以下注意事项： 1） 截肢 （1） 世界各地采用多种保肢评分标准。

[p.158] en: These are intended for use in the controlled environment of the operating theatre with full access to the victim and even these are often questioned when applied.
zh: 这些标准适用于手术室的受控环境中，其中的 伤员有完备的治疗条件，但即使在这样的环境中，保肢评分标准的应用也经常受 到质疑。

[p.159] en: After completing a certified degree programme the engineer must satisfy a range of requirements (including work experience and exam requirements) before being certified.
zh: 完成认证学位课程后，工程师必须满足相关要求， 包括工作经验和考试要求，才能获得专业认证。

[p.159] en: Once certified, the engineer is designated the title of Professional Engineer (in the United States, Canada and South Africa), Chartered Engineer (in most Commonwealth countries), Chartered Professional Engineer (in Australia and New Zealand), or European Engineer (in much of the European Union).
zh: 获得专业认证后，工程师将被指 定为专业工程师（在美国、加拿大和南非）、特许工程师（在大多数英联邦国家）、 特许专业工程师（在澳大利亚和新西兰）或欧洲工程师（在欧盟中的许多国家） 的资质。

[p.159] en: There are international engineering agreements between relevant professional bodies which are designed to allow engineers to practice across international borders.
zh: 相关专业机构之间签订了国际工程协议，根据这类协议，工程师可以跨 （续）

[p.160] en: The advantages of certification vary depending upon location.
zh: 认证的作用因不同的国家而存在差异。

[p.160] en: For example, in the United States and Canada only a licensed engineer may prepare, sign and seal, and submit engineering plans and drawings to a public authority for approval, or seal engineering work for public and private clients.
zh: 例如，在美国和加拿大，只有获得执 照的工程师才能准备、签署和盖章确认向主管部门提交的工程计划和图纸以供批 准，或为公共部门的客户和私人客户工程资料盖章。

[p.160] en: This requirement is enforced by state and provincial legislation such as Quebec's Engineers Act.
zh: 这一要求是国家和地方立法 的规定，如魁北克工程师法，而在其他国家却没有这样的立法。

[p.160] en: In Australia, for example, state licensing of engineers is limited to the state of Queensland.
zh: 例如，在澳大利 亚，国家颁发的工程师执照仅限于昆士兰州。

[p.160] en: Practically all certifying bodies maintain a code of ethics that they expect all members to abide by or risk expulsion.
zh: 实际上，所有认证机构都约定了一 套道德准则，希望所有成员都遵守，否则将面临取消资格的风险。

[p.160] en: In this way, these organisations play an important role in maintaining ethical standards for the profession.
zh: 在维护职业道 德规范方面，这些组织通过这种方式发挥着重要作用。

[p.160] en: Even in jurisdictions where certification has little or no legal bearing on work, engineers are subject to contract law.
zh: 即使在认证对工作没有法 律影响或只有很小影响的地区，工程师也必须遵守合同法。

[p.160] en: In cases where an engineer's work fails, he or she may be subject to the tort of negligence and, in extreme cases, the charge of criminal negligence.
zh: 如果工程师的工作造 成事故，那么这位工程师可能会受到过失侵权的指控，在极端情况下，可能会受 到过失犯罪的指控。

[p.160] en: An engineer's work must also comply with numerous other rules and regulations such as building codes and legislation pertaining to environmental law.
zh: 工程师的工作还必须遵守许多其他规章和法规，如建筑规范 和有关环境的立法。

[p.160] en: Annex D: Glossary of Terms The following terminologies are cited mainly from 2009 United Nations International Strategy for Disaster Reduction (UNISDR) Terminology on Disaster Risk Reduction.
zh: 附件D 术语表 以下术语主要引自2009 年版的《联合国国际减灾策略（UNISDR）减轻灾 害风险术语》，其中一些术语源自现场行动协调中心和国际搜索与救援指南。

[p.160] en: Acceptable risk: The level of potential losses that a society or community considers acceptable given existing social, economic, political, cultural, technical and environmental conditions.
zh: 可接受风险：在现有社会、经济、政治、文化、技术和环境条件下， 某个社会或社区认为可以接受的潜在损失水平。

[p.160] en: Comment: In engineering terms, acceptable risk is also used to assess and define the structural and non- structural measures that are needed in order to reduce possible harm to people, property, services and systems to a chosen tolerated level, according to codes or “accepted practice” which are based on known probabilities of hazards and other factors.
zh: 说明：在工程术语中，可接受风险还用于评估和确定所需的结构性和非结 构性措施，从而根据规范或“公认做法”将对人员、财产、服务和系统可能造 成的伤害减少到所选的可容忍水平。

[p.160] en: Biological hazard: Process or phenomenon of organic origin or conveyed by biological vectors, including exposure to pathogenic micro-organisms, toxins and bioactive substances that may cause loss of life, injury, illness or other health impacts, property damage, loss of livelihoods and services, social and economic disruption, or environmental damage.
zh: 生物致灾因子：起源于有机体或是通过生物媒介传染的过程或现象， 包括接触病原微生物、毒素和生物活性物质，可能造成人员死亡、身体损害、疾 病或其他健康影响、财产损失、生活状况和服务质量受损、社会和经济不稳定或 环境破坏。

[p.161] en: Comment: Examples of biological hazards include outbreaks of epidemic diseases, plant or animal contagion, insect or other animal plagues and infestations.
zh: 146 说明：生物致灾因子的示例包括流行病的暴发、植物或动物传染病、昆虫 或其他动物瘟疫和病虫侵扰。

[p.161] en: Building code: A set of ordinances or regulations and associated standards intended to control aspects of the design, construction, materials, alteration and occupancy of structures that are necessary to ensure human safety and welfare, including resistance to collapse and damage.
zh: 建筑法规：相关的一套法令或法规及标准，旨在控制建筑物的设计、施 工、材料、改造和结构用途等方面的规定，以确保使用者的安全和福祉，包括建 筑物的抗倒塌和抗损坏能力。

[p.161] en: Comment: Building codes can include both technical and functional standards.
zh: 说明：建筑法规可以包括技术性和功能性的标准。

[p.161] en: They should incorporate the lessons of international experience and should be tailored to national and local circumstances.
zh: 这些规范应吸取国际层 面的经验教训，并应根据本国和当地情况进行调整。

[p.161] en: A systematic regime of enforcement is a critical supporting requirement for effective implementation of building codes.
zh: 系统性的法律制度是有效 实施建筑规范的关键保障。

[p.161] en: Capacity: The combination of all the strengths, attributes and resources available within a community, society or organisation that can be used to achieve agreed goals.
zh: 能力：社区、社会或组织内可用于实现既定目标的所有力量、软实力 和资源的总合。

[p.161] en: Comment: Capacity may include infrastructure and physical means, institutions, societal coping abilities, as well as human knowledge, skills and collective attributes such as social relationships, leadership and management.
zh: 说明：能力可能包括基础设施和物理手段、机构、社会应对能力，以及人 类知识、技能和集体属性，如社会关系、领导力和管理能力。

[p.161] en: Capacity also may be described as capability.
zh: 能力也可以描述 为人的才能。

[p.161] en: Capacity assessment is a term for the process by which the capacity of a group is reviewed against desired goals, and the capacity gaps are identified for further action.
zh: 能力评估是一个关于特定流程的术语，在这个流程中，根据预期 目标审查某支队伍的能力并确定其能力短板，以采取进一步行动。

[p.161] en: Capacity development: The process by which people, organisations and society systematically stimulate and develop their capacities over time to achieve social and economic goals, including through improvement of knowledge, skills, systems, and institutions.
zh: 能力培养：个人、组织和社会在一段时间内系统地激发和发展其能力 以实现社会和经济目标的过程，包括知识、技能、系统和机构层面的改进。

[p.161] en: Comment: Capacity development is a concept that extends the term of capacity building to encompass all aspects of creating and sustaining capacity growth over time.
zh: 说明：能力培养这一概念将能力建设期限延伸以涵盖各个方面，在一段时 间内逐渐创造和维持能力的增长。

[p.161] en: It involves learning and various types of training, but also continuous efforts to develop institutions, political awareness, financial resources, technology systems, and the wider social and cultural enabling environment.
zh: 能力培养涉及学习和各种类型的培训，还包 括持续努力以发展机构、政治意识、财政资源、技术体系以及更全面的社会和 文化有利环境。

[p.161] en: Coping capacity: The ability of people, organisations and systems, using available skills and resources to face and manage adverse conditions, emergencies or disasters.
zh: 应对能力：人员、组织和系统利用现有技能和资源以应对和管理不利 局面、紧急情况或灾难的能力。

[p.162] en: Comment: The capacity to cope requires continuing awareness, resources and good management, both in normal times as well as during crises or adverse conditions.
zh: 147 第二卷 准备和响应 说明：无论是在正常时期还是在危机或不利情况下，应对能力都需要持续 的救灾意识、资源和良好的管理。

[p.162] en: Coping capacities contribute to the reduction of disaster risks.
zh: 应对能力有助于减轻灾害风险。

[p.162] en: Critical facilities: The primary physical structures, technical facilities and systems which are socially, economically or operationally essential to the functioning of a society or community, both in routine circumstances and in the extreme circumstances of an emergency.
zh: 关键设施：在常规情况下和突发事件的极端情况下，对社会或社区的 运转方面至关重要的主要实体结构、技术设施和系统。

[p.162] en: Comment: Critical facilities are elements of the infrastructure that support essential services in a society.
zh: 说明：关键设施是社会中支持基本服务的基础设施要素。

[p.162] en: They include such things as transport systems, air and seaports, electricity, water and communications systems, hospitals and health clinics, and centres for fire, police and public administration services.
zh: 关键设施包括运 输系统、空港和海港、电力、水和通信系统、医院和诊所以及消防、警察和公 共管理服务中心。

[p.162] en: Disaster risk: The potential disaster losses, in lives, health status, livelihoods, assets and services, which could occur to a particular community or a society over some specified future time period.
zh: 灾害风险：在未来某个特定时期内，特定社区或社会可能发生的生命、 健康状况、生计、资产和服务方面的潜在灾害损失。

[p.162] en: Comment: The definition of disaster risk reflects the concept of disasters as the outcome of continuously present conditions of risk.
zh: 说明：灾害风险这一概念的定义反映了灾害作为持续存在风险条件的后 果。

[p.162] en: Disaster risk comprises different types of potential losses, which are often difficult to quantify.
zh: 灾害风险包括不同类型的潜在损失，这些损失通常难以量化。

[p.162] en: Nevertheless, with knowledge of the prevailing hazards and the patterns of population and socio-economic development, disaster risks can be assessed and mapped, in broad terms at least.
zh: 然而，基于 对现存危险以及人口和社会经济发展模式的知识，至少可以从广义层面评估和 绘制灾害风险图。

[p.162] en: Disaster risk management: The systematic process of using administrative directives, organisations, and operational skills and capacities to implement strategies, policies and improved coping capacities in order to lessen the adverse impacts of hazards and the possibility of disaster.
zh: 灾害风险管理：利用行政指令、组织机构以及操作技能和能力以实施 战略、政策并提高救灾应对能力的系统过程，从而减少危险的不利影响和发生灾 害的可能性。

[p.162] en: Comment: This term is an extension of the more general term “risk management” to address the specific issue of disaster risks.
zh: 说明：该术语是对于通用术语“风险管理”（本附录第38 项）的延伸， 用于解决灾害风险的具体问题。

[p.162] en: Disaster risk management aims to avoid, lessen or transfer the adverse effects of hazards through activities and measures for prevention, mitigation and preparedness.
zh: 灾害风险管理旨在通过防灾、减灾和备灾活动 和措施以避免、减轻或转移灾害的不利影响。

[p.162] en: Disaster risk reduction: The concept and practice of reducing disaster risks through systematic efforts to analyse and manage the causal factors of disasters, including through reduced exposure to hazards, lessened vulnerability of people and property, wise management of land and the environment, and improved preparedness for adverse events.
zh: 减轻灾害风险：通过系统地分析和控制灾害的诱发因素从而减轻灾害 风险的理念和实践，包括减少风险敞口，减小人员和财产的脆弱性，妥善管理土 地和环境，以及提高人员对不利事件的准备程度。

[p.163] en: Note that while the term “disaster reduction” is sometimes used, the term “disaster risk reduction” provides a better recognition of the ongoing nature of disaster risks and the ongoing potential to reduce these risks.
zh: 请注意，虽然有时使用“减少灾害”这一术语，但“减轻灾害风险”这 一术语可以更好地反映灾害风险的持续性质，以及减轻灾害风险的持续可能性。

[p.163] en: Disaster risk reduction plan: A document prepared by an authority, sector, organisation or enterprise that sets out goals and specific objectives for reducing disaster risks together with related actions to accomplish these objectives.
zh: 减轻灾害风险计划：由主管部门、行业、机构或企业编制的文件，规 定了减轻灾害风险的总体目标和具体目标，以及实现这些目标的相关行动。

[p.163] en: Comment: Disaster risk reduction plans should be guided by the Hyogo Framework and considered and coordinated within relevant development plans, resource allocations and programme activities.
zh: 说明：减轻灾害风险计划应以兵库行动框架为指导，在相关发展计划、资 源分配和项目活动范围内考虑和协调相关内容。

[p.163] en: National level plans needs to be specific to each level of administrative responsibility and adapted to the different social and geographical circumstances that are present.
zh: 国家层面的计划需要明确各级 机构的管理责任，并适应当前不同的社会和地域环境。

[p.163] en: The time frame and responsibilities for implementation and the sources of funding should be specified in the plan.
zh: 计划应当明确实施各项 措施的时间范围、责任和资金来源。

[p.163] en: Linkages to climate change adaptation plans should be made where possible.
zh: 应尽可能与气候变化适应计划建立联系。

[p.163] en: Emergency management: The organisation and management of resources and responsibilities for addressing all aspects of emergencies, in particular preparedness, response and initial recovery steps.
zh: 应急管理：组织和管理救灾资源并明确相关责任，以解决突发事件的 各方面问题，特别是备灾、响应和灾后早期恢复阶段。

[p.163] en: Comment: A crisis or emergency is a threatening condition that requires urgent action.
zh: 说明：危机或突发事件是需要采取紧急行动的危险情况。

[p.163] en: Effective emergency action can avoid the escalation of an event into a disaster.
zh: 有效的应急行动 可以避免事件加剧为灾难。

[p.163] en: Emergency management involves plans and institutional arrangements to engage and guide the efforts of government, non-government, voluntary and private agencies in comprehensive and coordinated ways to respond to the entire spectrum of emergency needs.
zh: 应急管理涉及计划和制度性安排，采取全面且协调 一致的方式，参与和指导政府、非政府、志愿人员和私人机构的救援行动，以 满足各种紧急情况的需求。

[p.163] en: The expression “disaster management” is sometimes used instead of emergency management.
zh: 有时使用“灾害管理”这一术语来代替应急管理。

[p.163] en: Emergency services: The set of specialised agencies that have specific responsibilities and objectives in serving and protecting people and property in emergency situations.
zh: 应急服务部门：具有特定责任和目标的专门机构，在紧急情况下提供 人员和财产的服务和保护。

[p.163] en: Comment: Emergency services include agencies such as civil protection authorities, police, fire, ambulance, paramedic and emergency medicine services, Red Cross and Red Crescent societies, and specialised emergency units of electricity, transportation, communications and other related services organisations.
zh: 说明：应急服务部门包括民防主管部门、警察、消防、救护车、护理人员 和紧急医疗救助机构、红十字会和红新月会等机构，以及电力、运输、通信和 其他相关服务机构的专门应急相关单位。

[p.164] en: Environmental impact assessment: Process by which the environmental consequences of a proposed project or programme are evaluated, undertaken as an integral part of planning and decision-making processes with a view to limiting or reducing the adverse impacts of the project or programme.
zh: 149 第二卷 准备和响应 （14）环境影响评估：评估一个申报项目或方案环境影响结果的过程，作为 规划和决策过程的一个组成部分，以限制或减少项目或方案的不利影响。

[p.164] en: Comment: Environmental impact assessment is a policy tool that provides evidence and analysis of environmental impacts of activities from conception to decision-making.
zh: 说明：环境影响评估是一种政策工具，为从形成概念到形成决策的各阶段 活动环境影响提供证据和分析依据。

[p.164] en: It is utilised extensively in national programming and project approval processes and for international development assistance projects.
zh: 这一工具广泛用于国家规划和项目审批流 程，以及国际发展援助项目。

[p.164] en: Environmental impact assessments should include detailed risk assessments and provide alternatives, solutions or options to deal with identified problems.
zh: 环境影响评估应包括详细的风险评估，并提供替 代方案、解决方案或其他选项以处理已发现的问题。

[p.164] en: Exposure: People, property, systems, or other elements present in hazard zones that are thereby subject to potential losses.
zh: 暴露：人员、财产、系统或其他要素处在危险地区，因此可能会受到 损害。

[p.164] en: Comment: Measures of exposure can include the number of people or types of assets in an area.
zh: 说明：可以用来衡量暴露程度的标准包括某个地区的人数或资产类型。

[p.164] en: These can be combined with the specific vulnerability of the exposed elements to any particular hazard to estimate the quantitative risks associated with that hazard in the area of interest.
zh: 这 些因素可以与风险敞口元素对任何特定危险的具体脆弱性相结合，以估计与所 关注区域中的具体危险相关的定量风险。

[p.164] en: Extensive risk: The widespread risk associated with the exposure of dispersed populations to repeated or persistent hazard conditions of low or moderate intensity, often of a highly localised nature, which can lead to debilitating cumulative disaster impacts.
zh: 广布型风险：分散人口暴露于低度或中等强度重复或持续灾害状况相 关的普遍风险，通常具有明显的区域特性，可能导致破坏性的累积灾害影响。

[p.164] en: Comment: Extensive risk is mainly a characteristic of rural areas and urban margins where communities are exposed to, and vulnerable to, recurring localised floods, landslides storms or drought.
zh: 说明：广布型风险主要是农村地区和城市郊区的一种风险特征，这些地区的 社区容易遭受反复发生的局部洪水、山体滑坡、风暴或干旱的影响。

[p.164] en: Extensive risk is often associated with poverty, urbanisation and environmental degradation.
zh: 广布型风险 往往与贫困、城市化和环境退化有关。

[p.164] en: See also “Intensive risk.” Geological hazard: Geological process or phenomenon that may cause loss of life, injury or other health impacts, property damage, loss of livelihoods and services, social and economic disruption, or environmental damage.
zh: 地质致灾因子：可能导致人员伤亡或其他健康影响、财产损失、生计 方式和服务质量受损、社会和经济不稳定或环境破坏的各种地质变化过程或现象。

[p.164] en: Comment: Geological hazards include internal earth processes, such as earthquakes, volcanic activity and emissions, and related geophysical processes such as mass movements, landslides, rockslides, surface collapses, and debris or mud flows.
zh: 说明：地质致灾因子包括地球内部地质活动过程，如地震、火山活动和火 山喷发，以及相关的地球物理过程，如大规模地块移动、山体滑坡、岩石滑坡、 地表塌方以及碎屑流或泥浆流。

[p.164] en: Tsunamis are difficult to categorise; although they are triggered by undersea earthquakes and
zh: 海啸很难分类：尽管海啸是由海底地震与其他地质事件引发的，海啸本 质上是一种海洋变化过程，表现为与沿海水域有关的灾害。

[p.165] en: other geological events, they are essentially an oceanic process that is manifested as a coastal water- related hazard.
zh: 此类致灾因子由 多种地质、气象、水文、海洋、生物和技术活动引起，有时会共同起作用。

[p.165] en: Hazard: A dangerous phenomenon, substance, human activity or condition that may cause loss of life, injury or other health impacts, property damage, loss of livelihoods and services, social and economic disruption, or environmental damage.
zh: 请参见术语表中的其他危险相关术语：生物致灾因子（本附录第2 项）；

[p.165] en: Comment: The hazards of concern to disaster risk reduction as stated in footnote 3 of the Hyogo Framework are “... hazards of natural origin and related environmental and technological hazards and risks.” Such hazards arise from a variety of geological, meteorological, hydrological, oceanic, biological, and technological sources, sometimes acting in combination.
zh: 地 质致灾因子（本附录第17 项）；

[p.165] en: In technical settings, hazards are described quantitatively by the likely frequency of occurrence of different intensities for different areas, as determined from historical data or scientific analysis.
zh: 自然致 灾因子（本附录第24 项）；

[p.165] en: See other hazard-related terms in the Glossary of Terms: Biological hazard; Geological hazard; Hydrometeorological hazard; Natural hazard; Socio-natural hazard; Technological hazard.
zh: 社会自然致灾因子（本附录第40 项）；

[p.165] en: Hydrometeorological hazard: Process or phenomenon of atmospheric, hydrological or oceanographic nature that may cause loss of life, injury or other health impacts, property damage, loss of livelihoods and services, social and economic disruption, or environmental damage.
zh: 水文气象致灾因子：大气、水文或海洋变化过程或现象，可能导致人 员伤亡或其他健康影响、财产损失、生计方式和服务质量受损、社会和经济不稳 定或环境破坏。

[p.165] en: Comment: Hydrometeorological hazards include tropical cyclones (also known as typhoons and hurricanes), thunderstorms, hailstorms, tornados, blizzards, heavy snowfall, avalanches, coastal storm surges, floods including flash floods, drought, heatwaves and cold spells.
zh: 说明：水文气象致灾因子包括热带气旋（又称台风和飓风）、雷暴、冰 雹、龙卷风、暴风雪、强降雪、雪崩、海岸风暴潮、洪水（包括山洪）、干旱、 热浪和寒潮。

[p.165] en: Hydrometeorological conditions also can be a factor in other hazards such as landslides, wildland fires, locust plagues, epidemics, and in the transport and dispersal of toxic substances and volcanic eruption material.
zh: 水文气象条件也可能是其他灾害的一个因素，如山体滑坡、荒地 火灾、蝗灾、瘟疫以及有毒物质和火山喷发物质的传播和扩散。

[p.165] en: Intensive risk: The risk associated with the exposure of large concentrations of people and economic activities to intense hazard events, which can lead to potentially catastrophic disaster impacts involving high mortality and asset loss.
zh: 密集型风险：大量人员和聚集的经济活动暴露于严重灾害事件的相关 风险，可能导致潜在的重大灾害影响，包括高死亡率和严重的资产损失。

[p.165] en: Comment: Intensive risk is mainly a characteristic of large cities or densely populated areas that are not only exposed to intense hazards such as strong earthquakes, active volcanoes, heavy floods, tsunamis, or major storms but also have high levels of vulnerability to these hazards.
zh: 说明：密集型风险主要是大城市或人口稠密地区的风险特点，这些城市或 人口稠密地区不仅面临强烈地震、活火山、特大洪水、海啸或剧烈风暴等严重 危险，而且其面对这些灾害的脆弱性也很明显。

[p.166] en: Comment: Land-use planning is an important contributor to sustainable development.
zh: 说明：土地利用规划是可持续发展的重要支柱。

[p.166] en: It involves studies and mapping; analysis of economic, environmental and hazard data; formulation of alternative land-use decisions; and design of long-range plans for different geographical and administrative scales.
zh: 经济、环境和危险相关数据分析；

[p.166] en: Land-use planning can help to mitigate disasters and reduce risks by discouraging settlements and construction of key installations in hazard-prone areas, including consideration of service routes for transport, power, water, sewage and other critical facilities.
zh: 通过阻止在灾害易发地区进行定居点 和关键设施的建设，土地利用规划可以帮助减轻灾害和降低风险，包括规划运 输、电力、水源、污水和其他重要设施的服务路线。

[p.166] en: Mitigation: The lessening or limitation of the adverse impacts of hazards and related disasters.
zh: 减灾：减轻或限制各类致灾因子和相关灾害的不利影响。

[p.166] en: Comment: The adverse impacts of hazards often cannot be prevented fully, but their scale or severity can be substantially lessened by various strategies and actions.
zh: 说明：各类致灾因子的不利影响通常无法完全预防，但可以通过各种策略 和行动显著减轻其规模或严重程度。

[p.166] en: techniques and hazard-resistant construction as well as improved environmental policies and public awareness.
zh: 减灾措施包括工程技术和防灾建筑，以及 完善的环境政策和普及的公众意识。

[p.166] en: It should be noted that in climate change policy, “mitigation” is defined differently, being the term used for the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions that are the source of climate change.
zh: 值得注意的是，在气候变化政策中，“减 排”的定义有所不同，指的是减少导致气候变化的温室气体排放。

[p.166] en: National platform for disaster risk reduction: A generic term for national mechanisms for coordination and policy guidance on disaster risk reduction that are multi-sectoral and inter-disciplinary in nature, with public, private and civil society participation involving all concerned entities within a country.
zh: 国家减轻灾害风险平台：减轻灾害风险国家协调和政策指导机制的一 个通用术语，本质上是多部门和跨专业的平台，公共部门、私人部门和民间社团 参与其中，涉及国内所有相关机构。

[p.166] en: Comment: This definition is derived from footnote 10 of the Hyogo Framework.
zh: 说明：该定义源自兵库行动框架脚注⑩。

[p.166] en: Disaster risk reduction requires the knowledge, capacities and inputs of a wide range of sectors and organisations, including United Nations agencies present at the national level, as appropriate.
zh: 减轻灾害风险这项工作涉及众多 部门和机构的专业知识、能力和投入，包括根据具体情况在国家层面设立的联 合国机构。

[p.166] en: Most sectors are affected directly or indirectly by disasters and many have specific responsibilities that impinge upon disaster risks.
zh: 多数部门都直接或间接受到灾害影响，许多部门担负着减轻灾害风 险的具体责任。

[p.166] en: National platforms provide a means to enhance national action to reduce disaster risks, and they represent the national mechanism for the ISDR.
zh: 国家的各种平台提供了加强国家减轻灾害风险行动的手段，这 些平台代表了国际减灾战略的国家机制。

[p.166] en: Natural hazard: Natural process or phenomenon that may cause loss of life, injury or other health impacts, property damage, loss of livelihoods and services, social and economic disruption, or environmental damage.
zh: 自然致灾因子：可能导致人员伤亡或其他健康影响、财产损失、生 计方式和服务质量受损、社会和经济不稳定或环境破坏的各种自然变化过程或 现象。

[p.167] en: Comment: Natural hazards are a sub-set of all hazards.
zh: 152 说明：自然致灾因子是所有危险集合中的一个子集。

[p.167] en: The term is used to describe actual hazard events as well as the latent hazard conditions that may give rise to future events.
zh: 这一术语用于描述实 际的危险事件，以及可能引起未来事件的潜在危险情况。

[p.167] en: Natural hazard events can be characterised by their magnitude or intensity, speed of onset, duration, and area of extent.
zh: 通过事件规模或强度、 发生速度、持续时间和影响范围，可以表征自然灾难事件。

[p.167] en: For example, earthquakes have short durations and usually affect a relatively small region, whereas droughts are slow to develop and fade away and often affect large regions.
zh: 例如，地震持续时 间较短，通常影响相对较小的区域，而干旱的形成和消失缓慢，通常影响较大 的区域。

[p.167] en: In some cases, hazards may be coupled, as in the flood caused by a hurricane or the tsunami that is created by an earthquake.
zh: 在某些情况下，危险可能是相互关联的，如飓风引发的洪水或地震引 发的海啸。

[p.167] en: Operational work zones: The support zone (or cold zone) is the area of a site that is free from incident hazards and may be safely used as a planning and staging area.
zh: 行动作业区：支持区（或冷区）是指远离事件危险并可安全用作规划 和集结区的场地。

[p.167] en: OSOCC: The OSOCC is intended to serve as a conduit for information exchange between the Government of the affected country and various relief providers in a disaster receiving international assistance, and to provide a platform for coordination amongst actors who do not normally work in close collaboration.
zh: 现场行动协调中心：现场行动协调中心旨在作为一个交流信息的渠道， 改善受灾国政府与国际援助各提供方之间的沟通，并为通常缺乏密切合作的援助 人员提供一个协调平台。

[p.167] en: The OSOCC facility support on-site coordination and information exchange, and facilitates a broader coordination platform that extends well beyond the physical OSOCC.
zh: 现场行动协调中心支持现场协调和信息交流，并促进其 他各种的协调机制，其范围远远超出了现场行动协调中心的地理区域。

[p.167] en: Comment: To optimise its effectiveness, the OSOCC should be established in the immediate aftermath of a disaster requiring international assistance or when indicated by a change in situation of an existing emergency.
zh: 说明：为了最大限度地发挥其效力，应在需要国际援助的灾害发生后或在 现有紧急情况出现恶化迹象时，立即成立现场行动协调中心。

[p.167] en: This is critical in sudden-onset disasters to ensure optimal rescue efforts.
zh: 在突发灾害的情 况下，这对于确保最佳救援工作而言至关重要。

[p.167] en: Preparedness: The knowledge and capacities developed by governments, professional response and recovery organisations, communities and individuals to effectively anticipate, respond to, and recover from, the impacts of likely, imminent or current hazard events or conditions.
zh: 备灾：政府、专业灾害响应和灾后重建机构、社区和个人具备的救灾 知识和能力，以有效预测、应对可能的、迫在眉睫的或正在发生的灾害事件或状 况，并在灾害产生影响后进行恢复重建。

[p.168] en: Comment: Preparedness action is carried out within the context of disaster risk management and aims to build the capacities needed to efficiently manage all types of emergencies and achieve orderly transitions from response through to sustained recovery.
zh: 153 第二卷 准备和响应 说明：备灾行动是在灾害风险管理的大背景下开展的，旨在形成有效管理 各类紧急情况所需的能力，并实现从应对到持续恢复的有序过渡。

[p.168] en: Preparedness is based on a sound analysis of disaster risks and good linkages with early warning systems, and includes such activities as contingency planning, stockpiling of equipment and supplies, the development of arrangements for coordination, evacuation and public information, and associated training and field exercises.
zh: 备灾工作的 基础在于对灾害风险的合理分析以及与早期预警系统的良好衔接，包括应急预 案的制定、装备和物资的储备、协调安排、疏散和公共信息披露以及相关培训 和实地演练等活动。

[p.168] en: These must be supported by formal institutional, legal and budgetary capacities.
zh: 上述活动必须得到正式机构、相关法律和预算安排的支持。

[p.168] en: The related term “readiness” describes the ability to quickly and appropriately respond when required.
zh: 相关术语“准备就绪”描述了在救灾需要时进行快速适当响应的能力。

[p.168] en: Prevention: The outright avoidance of adverse impacts of hazards and related disasters.
zh: 防灾：全面防止致灾因子和相关灾害的不利影响。

[p.168] en: Comment: Prevention (i.e. disaster prevention) expresses the concept and intention to completely avoid potential adverse impacts through action taken in advance.
zh: 说明：防灾（灾害预防）表达了通过提前采取行动，完全避免潜在不利影 响的灾害应对理念和意图。

[p.168] en: Examples include dams or embankments that eliminate flood risks, land-use regulations that do not permit any settlement in high risk zones, and seismic engineering designs that ensure the survival and function of a critical building in any likely earthquake.
zh: 例如，消除洪水风险的水坝或堤坝、禁止在高风险 区域建立定居点的土地使用法规，以及确保重要建筑物在可能的地震中完好和 正常使用的抗震工程设计。

[p.168] en: Very often the complete avoidance of losses is not feasible and the task transforms to that of mitigation.
zh: 很多时候，完全避免损失是不可行的，防灾的任务 实际上是减轻损失。

[p.168] en: Partly for this reason, the terms prevention and mitigation are sometimes used interchangeably in casual use.
zh: 部分出于这个原因，防灾和减灾这两个术语有时在非正式 场合可以互换使用。

[p.168] en: Prospective disaster risk management: Management activities that address and seek to avoid the development of new or increased disaster risks.
zh: 前瞻性灾害风险管理：处理灾害风险并寻求避免新增灾害风险的管理 活动。

[p.168] en: Comment: This concept focuses on addressing risks that may develop in future if risk reduction policies are not put in place, rather than on the risks that are already present and which can be managed and reduced now.
zh: 说明：这一概念的重点是解决或减轻在灾害风险政策不到位的情况下未来 可能出现的风险，而不是关注已经存在且现在可以控制和减轻的风险。

[p.168] en: Public awareness: The extent of common knowledge about disaster risks, the factors that lead to disasters and the actions that can be taken individually and collectively to reduce exposure and vulnerability to hazards.
zh: 公众意识：关于灾害风险、导致灾害的因素以及为减轻灾害风险和脆 弱性而可以单独和集体采取的行动的各类常识。

[p.168] en: Comment: Public awareness is a key factor in effective disaster risk reduction.
zh: 说明：公众意识是有效减轻灾害风险的一个重要因素。

[p.168] en: Its development is pursued, for example, through the development and dissemination of information through media and educational channels, the establishment of information centres, networks, and community or participation actions, and advocacy by senior public officials and community leaders.
zh: 例如，通过开发媒 体和教育渠道并传播信息、建立信息中心和网络、社区或参与行动，以及政府 高级官员和社区领导人的宣传，可以实现形成关于灾害应对的公众意识。

[p.169] en: RDC (Reception Departure Centre): The RDC serves as the central intake hub for the international relief traffic and is often the first OSOCC component established in the affected country.
zh: 154 （31）接待和撤离中心：接待和撤离中心是国际救援资源运输的中心接收枢 纽，通常是在受灾国家建立的第一个现场行动协调中心的组成部分。

[p.169] en: The RDC must be prepared to facilitate the basic services of an OSOCC including delivering situational and operational briefings, providing basic logistical support, facility the operational activities of response teams and tracking recourses.
zh: 在最初的几 个小时或几天里，接待和撤离中心必须做好准备，推动现场行动协调中心的基本 服务，包括提供情况和行动简报，提供基本的后勤支持，促进应急响应队伍的救 灾行动，并跟踪资源配置。

[p.169] en: The extent to which these services are conducted will shift as the OSOCC becomes established and/or the affected country gains the means to facilitate incoming/outgoing international resources.
zh: 随着现场行动协调中心的成立，和/ 或受灾国家有能 力增强国际救灾资源流入/ 流出，这些服务的范围也将发生变化。

[p.169] en: Recovery: The restoration, and improvement where appropriate, of facilities, livelihoods and living conditions of disaster-affected communities, including efforts to reduce disaster risk factors.
zh: 灾后恢复：恢复并根据情况完善受灾社区的设施、生计方式和生活条 件，包括努力减轻与灾害风险有关的各种因素。

[p.169] en: Comment: The recovery task of rehabilitation and reconstruction begins soon after the emergency phase has ended, and should be based on pre-existing strategies and policies that facilitate clear institutional responsibilities for recovery action and enable public participation.
zh: 说明：在应急响应阶段结束后，立即开始灾后恢复和重建任务，并遵循现 有的战略和政策，以明确灾后恢复行动机构的责任，并促进公众参与。

[p.169] en: Recovery programmes, coupled with the heightened public awareness and engagement after a disaster, afford a valuable opportunity to develop and implement disaster risk reduction measures and to apply the “build back better” principle.
zh: 灾后恢 复计划以及灾后公众意识和参与度的提高，为制定和实施减轻灾害风险措施以 及遵循“重建更好未来”这一原则提供了宝贵的机会。

[p.169] en: Residual risk: The risk that remains in unmanaged form, even when effective disaster risk reduction measures are in place, and for which emergency response and recovery capacities must be maintained.
zh: 残余风险：即使采取了有效的减轻灾害风险的措施，风险仍然处于未 受完全控制的状态，并且必须保持应急响应和灾后恢复能力。

[p.169] en: Comment: The presence of residual risk implies a continuing need to develop and support effective capacities for emergency services, preparedness, response and recovery together with socio-economic policies such as safety nets and risk transfer mechanisms.
zh: 说明：因为存在残余风险，所以需要持续发展和支持应急服务、救灾准备、 响应和灾后恢复的有效能力，并建立安全网和风险转移机制等社会经济政策。

[p.169] en: Resilience: The ability of a system, community or society exposed to hazards to resist, absorb, accommodate to and recover from the effects of a hazard in a timely and efficient manner, including through the preservation and restoration of its essential basic structures and functions.
zh: 御灾力：遭受危险的系统、社区或社会迅速有效地抵御、承受、适应 危险影响并从中恢复的能力，包括通过保存和恢复重要的基本架构和功能。

[p.169] en: Comment: Resilience means the ability to “spring back from” a shock.
zh: 说明：御灾力是指从灾害冲击中“恢复”的能力。

[p.169] en: The resilience of a community in respect to potential hazard events is determined by the degree to which the community has the necessary resources and is capable of organising itself both prior to and during times of need.
zh: 社区对潜在危险事件的 恢复能力，取决于社区拥有必要资源的数量，以及在有需求之前和期间自我组 织救灾的能力。

[p.169] en: Response: The provision of emergency services and public assistance during or immediately after a disaster in order to save lives, reduce health impacts, ensure public safety and meet the basic subsistence needs of the people affected.
zh: 灾害响应：在灾害期间或灾害发生后立即提供紧急服务和公共援助， 以拯救生命、减少灾害对人员健康的影响、确保公共安全并满足受灾群体的基本 生存需求。

[p.170] en: Comment: Disaster response is predominantly focused on immediate and short-term needs and is sometimes called “disaster relief”.
zh: 155 第二卷 准备和响应 说明：灾害响应主要关注当前需求和短期需求，有时被称为“救灾”。

[p.170] en: The division between this response stage and the subsequent recovery stage is not clear-cut.
zh: 灾 害响应阶段和灾后恢复阶段之间的划分并非泾渭分明。

[p.170] en: Some response actions, such as the supply of temporary housing and water supplies, may extend well into the recovery stage.
zh: 某些灾害响应行动，如 提供临时住所和供水，可能会持续到灾后恢复阶段。

[p.170] en: Risk: The combination of the probability of an event and its negative consequences.
zh: 风险：灾害事件发生的概率及其负面后果的共同影响。

[p.170] en: Comment: This definition closely follows the definition of the ISO/IEC Guide 73.
zh: 说明：这一定义严格遵循ISO/IEC Guide 73 中的定义。

[p.170] en: The word “risk” has two distinctive connotations: in popular usage the emphasis is usually placed on the concept of chance or possibility, such as in “the risk of an accident”; whereas in technical settings the emphasis is usually placed on the consequences, in terms of “potential losses” for some particular cause, place and period.
zh: “风险”一词有两 个独特的含义：在普通用法中，重点通常在于表达机会或可能性的概念，如“事 故的风险”；

[p.170] en: It can be noted that people do not necessarily share the same perceptions of the significance and underlying causes of different risks.
zh: 值得注意的是，对于不同风险的影 响和根本原因，人们不一定有相同的看法。

[p.170] en: Risk assessment: A methodology to determine the nature and extent of risk by analysing potential hazards and evaluating existing conditions of vulnerability that together could potentially harm exposed people, property, services, livelihoods and the environment on which they depend.
zh: 风险评估：通过分析潜在致灾因子和评估现有脆弱性状况以确定风险 性质和程度的一种方法，潜在危险和脆弱性状况共同决定了风险对受影响人员、 财产、服务、生计方式及其所依赖环境造成的损害。

[p.170] en: This series of activities is sometimes known as a risk analysis process.
zh: 这一系列活动有时称为风险分析过程。

[p.170] en: Risk management: The systematic approach and practice of managing uncertainty to minimise potential harm and loss.
zh: 风险管理：管理不确定性的系统性方法和做法，以最大限度地减少潜 在危害和损失。

[p.170] en: Comment: Risk management comprises risk assessment and analysis, and the implementation of strategies and specific actions to control, reduce and transfer risks.
zh: 说明：风险管理包括风险评估和分析，以及控制、降低和转移风险策略和 具体行动的实施。

[p.170] en: It is widely practiced by organisations to minimise risk in investment decisions and to address operational risks such as those of business disruption, production failure, environmental damage, social impacts and damage from fire and natural
zh: 风险管理广泛应用于各种机构，以尽量减少投资决策的风险 并应对运营风险，如业务中断、生产流程故障、环境破坏、社会影响以及火灾 和自然灾害造成的损失。

[p.170] en: Risk management is a core issue for sectors such as water supply, energy and agriculture whose production is directly affected by extremes of weather and climate.
zh: 风险管理是供水、能源和农业等行业的一个核心管理 事项，这些行业的生产受到极端天气和气候的直接影响。

[p.171] en: Risk transfer: The process of formally or informally shifting the financial consequences of particular risks from one party to another whereby a household, community, enterprise or state authority will obtain resources from the other party after a disaster occurs, in exchange for ongoing or compensatory social or financial benefits provided to that other party.
zh: 156 （39）风险转移：将特定风险的财务损失后果正式或非正式地从一方转移到 另一方的过程；

[p.171] en: Comment: Insurance is a well-known form of risk transfer, where coverage of a risk is obtained from an insurer in exchange for ongoing premiums paid to the insurer.
zh: 说明：保险是一种众所周知的风险转移形式，投保人从保险公司获得风险 承保，作为交换，持续向保险公司支付保费。

[p.171] en: Risk transfer can occur informally within family and community networks where there are reciprocal expectations of mutual aid by means of gifts or credit, as well as formally where governments, insurers, multi-lateral banks and other large risk-bearing entities establish mechanisms to help cope with losses in major events.
zh: 非正式的风险转移可以发生在家 庭和社区网络中，人们期望通过赠予或信用借款的方式相互援助；

[p.171] en: Such mechanisms include insurance and re-insurance contracts, catastrophe bonds, contingent credit facilities and reserve funds, where the costs are covered by premiums, investor contributions, interest rates and past savings, respectively.
zh: 这些机制包括 保险和再保险合同、巨灾债券或有信贷机制的储备基金，其费用分别由保费、 投资者缴款、利息和以往的储备金来承担。

[p.171] en: Socio-natural hazard: The phenomenon of increased occurrence of certain geophysical and hydro- meteorological hazard events, such as landslides, flooding, land subsidence and drought that arise from the interaction of natural hazards with overexploited or degraded land and environmental resources.
zh: 社会自然致灾因子：由于自然灾害与过度开发或退化土地和环境资源 的相互作用，而导致某些地球物理和水文气象灾害事件发生情况增多，这类现象 包括山体滑坡、洪水、地面沉降和干旱。

[p.171] en: Comment: This term is used for the circumstances where human activity is increasing the occurrence of certain hazards beyond their natural probabilities.
zh: 说明：这一术语用于描述人类活动导致某些危险的、超出其自然发生概率 的情况。

[p.171] en: Evidence points to a growing disaster burden from such hazards.
zh: 有证据表明，此类危险造成的灾害应对负担日益增加。

[p.171] en: Socio-natural hazards can be reduced and avoided through wise management of land and environmental resources.
zh: 通过妥善管理 土地和环境资源，可以减少和避免社会自然危险。

[p.171] en: Comment: Common structural measures for disaster risk reduction include dams, flood levies, ocean wave barriers, earthquake-resistant construction, and evacuation shelters.
zh: 说明：减轻灾害风险的常见结构性措施包括水坝、防洪堤、海浪堤防、抗 震建筑和疏散临时安置场所。

[p.171] en: Common non-structural measures include building codes, land use planning laws and their enforcement, research and assessment, information resources, and public awareness programmes.
zh: 常见的非结构性措施包括建筑规范、土地使用规 划法及其执行、研究和评估、信息资源和公众意识项目。

[p.172] en: Note that in civil and structural engineering, the term “structural” is used in a more restricted sense to mean just the load-bearing structure, with other parts such as wall cladding and interior fittings being termed non-structural.
zh: 157 第二卷 准备和响应 构工程中，术语“结构”的使用基于其狭义层面，仅表示承重结构，而其他部 分（如墙面覆盖层和内部装修部分）则称为非结构部分。

[p.172] en: Technological hazard: A hazard originating from technological or industrial conditions, including accidents, dangerous procedures, infrastructure failures or specific human activities, that may cause loss of life, injury, illness or other health impacts, property damage, loss of livelihoods and services, social and economic disruption, or environmental damage.
zh: 技术致灾因子：源于技术或工业条件下的致灾因子，包括事故、危险 程序、基础设施故障或特定人类活动，可能造成人员死亡、身体损害、疾病或其 他健康影响、财产损失、生活状况和服务质量受损、社会和经济不稳定或环境破坏。

[p.172] en: Comment: Examples of technological hazards include industrial pollution, nuclear radiation, toxic wastes, dam failures, transport accidents, factory explosions, fires, and chemical spills.
zh: 说明：技术致灾因子的示例包括工业污染、核辐射、有毒废物、溃坝、交 通事故、工厂爆炸、火灾和化学品泄漏。

[p.172] en: Technological hazards also may arise directly as a result of the impacts of a natural hazard event.
zh: 同样地，也可能直接因自然灾害事件 的影响而产生技术危险。

[p.172] en: Training Levels: Awareness Level: This level represents the minimum capability of organisations that provide response to technical search and rescue incidents.
zh: 培训层级：①认知层级，这一层级代表了对技术搜救事件进行响应的 各类机构的最低能力；

[p.172] en: Operations Level: This level represents the capability of organisations to respond to technical search and rescue incidents and to identify hazards, use
zh: ②行动层级，这一层级代表各类机构在响应技术搜救事件， 识别危险，使用救援装备，应用本标准规定的有限技术以支持和参与技术搜救事 件这几个方面的能力；

[p.172] en: Technician Level: This level represents the capability of organisations to respond to technical search and rescue, and/or USAR incidents and to identify hazards use rescue equipment, and apply advanced techniques specified in this standard necessary to coordinate, perform and supervise technical search and rescue incidents.
zh: ③技术员层级，这一层级代表了救援组织在响应技术搜救 和/ 或城市搜索与救援事件，识别危险，使用救援装备，应用本标准中规定的所 需先进技术以协调、执行和监督技术搜救事件这几个方面的能力。

[p.172] en: Vulnerability: The characteristics and circumstances of a community, system or asset that make it susceptible to the damaging effects of a hazard.
zh: 脆弱性：社区、系统或资产易于受到某种致灾因子的破坏性影响的特 点和环境。

[p.172] en: Comment: There are many aspects of vulnerability, arising from various physical, social, economic, and environmental factors.
zh: 说明：脆弱性表现在很多方面，由各种物理、社会、经济和环境因素引 起。

[p.172] en: Examples may include poor design and construction of buildings, inadequate protection of assets, lack of public information and awareness, limited official recognition of risks and preparedness measures, and disregard for wise environmental management.
zh: 例如，建筑物的设计和施工不当、资产保护不足、缺乏公共信息和公众意 识、主管部门对风险和备灾措施的认识有限，以及忽视妥善的环境管理。

[p.172] en: Vulnerability varies significantly within a community and over time.
zh: 随着 时间的推移，某个社区的脆弱性可能会出现很大变化。

[p.172] en: This definition identifies vulnerability as a characteristic of the element of interest (community, system or asset) which is independent of its exposure.
zh: 通过这一定义，将脆弱 性确认为独立于其风险敞口指标的评估对象（社区、系统或资产）特征。

[p.172] en: However, in common use the word is often used more broadly to include the element’s exposure.
zh: 然而， 在日常使用中，这一术语的使用范围通常更广泛，其含义包括了评估对象的风 险敞口指标。

[p.173] en: Comment: Worksites will typically be one building where one USAR Team or squad is working because of a potential live rescue.
zh: 说明：由于可能需要现场救援，工作场地通常是城市搜索与救援队或搜 救分队正在开展救援行动的一栋建筑物。

[p.173] en: But a worksite could be much larger or much smaller.
zh: 工作场地可能比一栋建筑物更大或更 小。

[p.173] en: A large building or complex of buildings e.g. a hospital may be identified as a single worksite.
zh: 大型建筑物或建筑物群，如医院，也可以被视为一个单一的工作场地。

[p.173] en: Alternatively, the site of a single rescue in an area of only a few square metres would also be identified as a Worksite.
zh: 另 一种情况下，面积仅数平方米的单个救援现场也可以被视为一个工作场地。
