[p.235] en: 1 Introduction The International Search and Rescue Advisory Group (INSARAG) Guidelines are divided into three volumes: 1.
zh: 220 1 简 介 《国际搜索与救援指南》分为三卷： 1. 第一卷：政策 2. 第二卷：准备和响应 ■ 手册 A： 能力建设。

[p.235] en: Volume II: Preparedness and Response: a.
zh: ■ 手册 B：救援行动。

[p.235] en: Manual C: INSARAG External Classification and Reclassification (IEC/IER).
zh: ■ 手册 C：国际搜索与救援咨询团分级测评与复测（IEC/IER）。

[p.235] en: This manual is targeted at the INSARAG Operational Focal Point, the Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) Team Management and Focal Point, and the INSARAG Secretariat with the purpose of providing guidance in the training, preparations and coordination of a USAR Team for national and/or international operations.
zh: 第三卷：现场行动指南 本手册的适用对象包括：国际搜索与救援咨询团行动联络人、城市搜索与救 援（USAR）队管理层和联络人以及国际搜索与救援咨询团秘书处，针对国内和 （或）国际救援行动，为城市搜索与救援队的培训、筹备和协调提供指导。

[p.235] en: It is based on the minimal standards and it describes the required capabilities for coordinated operations.
zh: 本手 册基于最低标准，描述了协调行动所需的各种能力。

[p.235] en: Tactical and technical details are described in Volume II - Manual A: Capacity Building, Volume II - Manual C: IEC/R, Volume III: Operational Field Guide and in the Guidance Notes.
zh: 策略和技术细节，请参见《第二卷 手册A：能力建设》《第二卷 手册C： 国际搜索与救援咨询团分级测评与复测》《第三卷：现场行动指南》，以及指南 说明。

[p.235] en: Note: The Guidelines can be downloaded from www.insarag.org.
zh: 说明：指南文件可以从www.insarag.org 网站下载。

[p.235] en: Hard copies in English (and translated versions, where available) can be requested from the INSARAG Secretariat by email on insarag@un.org.
zh: 英文版纸质文件以及 译本（如果能提供），可通过电子邮件insarag@un.org 向国际搜索与救援咨询 团秘书处索取。

[p.235] en: This document has been endorsed by the INSARAG Steering Group.
zh: 这份文件已得到国际搜索与救援咨询团指导委员会的认可。

[p.235] en: This manual describes the five components of USAR capability (Management, Search, Rescue, Medical and Logistics) within the USAR Response Cycle.
zh: 本手册介绍了在响应周期的时间范围内，城市搜索与救援能力的五个组成部 分（管理、搜索、营救、医疗和后勤）。

[p.235] en: It also outlines the USAR coordination structures and methods, including the INSARAG Marking and Signalling System and the link to the On-Site Operations and Coordination (OSOCC) Guidelines.
zh: 本手册还介绍了城市搜索与救援队的协 调架构和方法，包括国际搜索与救援咨询团的标记和信号系统，以及与现场行动 协调中心（OSOCC）指南的链接。

[p.236] en: Please refer to the VOSOCC Guidelines under Manuals  UCC Virtual OSOCC tabs of the Guidance Notes at www.insarag.org for more information on on-site coordination.
zh: 关于现场协调的更 多信息，请参见www.insarag.org 指南说明中“Manuals—OSOCC”选项卡下的虚 拟现场行动协调中心指南。

[p.236] en: 2 International USAR Response Cycle An international USAR response has the following phases: Figure 1: The International USAR Response Cycle.
zh: 2 国际城市搜索与救援响应周期 国际城市搜索与救援响应（图1）分为以下五个阶段：准备、动员、行动、 撤离和总结。

[p.236] en: 2.1 Preparedness The preparedness phase is the period between disaster responses.
zh: 准备 国际城市搜索与救援 响应周期 行动 动员 撤离 总结 图1 国际城市搜索与救援响应周期 2.1 准备阶段 准备阶段处于两次救灾响应之间的平静时期。

[p.236] en: In this phase USAR Teams undertake preparatory measures to ensure that they are at the highest level of readiness for deployment as possible.
zh: 在这一阶段，城市搜索与救援 队采取准备措施，确保队伍处于尽可能高的部署准备状态。

[p.236] en: Teams will conduct training and exercises, review lessons-learnt from previous experiences, update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as required, and plan future responses.
zh: 队伍将进行培训和演 练，回顾从以前行动中吸取的经验教训，根据需要更新标准行动程序（SOP）， 并计划未来的应对措施。

[p.236] en: 2.2 Mobilisation The mobilisation phase is the period immediately following the occurrence of a disaster.
zh: 2 动员阶段 动员阶段处于灾难发生后的最初时期。

[p.236] en: International USAR Teams prepare to respond and travel to assist the affected country.
zh: 国际城市搜索与救援队准备做出响应， 前往部署地区，并协助请求国际援助的受灾国。

[p.237] en: 2.3 Operations The operations phase is the period when international USAR Teams are performing USAR operations in the affected country.
zh: 222 2.3 行动阶段 行动阶段处于国际城市搜索与救援队在受灾国执行搜索与救援行动的时期。

[p.237] en: It starts with arrival of a USAR Team at the Reception/Departure Centre (RDC) in the affected country, registration with the UCC/OSOCC, reporting to the Local Emergency Management Agency (LEMA) (or National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)), and performing of USAR operations.
zh: 首先，城市搜索与救援队抵达受灾国的接待和撤离中心（RDC），在现场行动协 调中心登记，向地方应急管理机构（LEMA）或国家灾害管理机构（NDMA）报告， 并执行城市搜索与救援行动。

[p.237] en: The phase ends when the USAR Team is instructed to cease operations.
zh: 如果城市搜索与救援接到停止行动的指示，这一阶 段即告结束。

[p.237] en: 2.5 Post-Mission The post-mission phase is the period immediately after a USAR Team has returned home.
zh: 5 总结阶段 总结阶段处于城市搜索与救援队返回原驻国后的时期。

[p.237] en: In this phase the USAR Team is required to complete and submit a post-mission report and conduct a lessons-learnt review to improve the overall effectiveness and efficiency for response to future disasters.
zh: 在此阶段，城市搜索 与救援队需要完成并提交任务后的总结报告，开展经验教训总结，提高应对未来 灾害的整体有效性和效率。

[p.237] en: The post-mission phase continuously merges into the preparedness phase.
zh: 总结阶段的后续为准备阶段。

[p.237] en: 3 Roles and Responsibilities in International USAR Response This chapter lists those involved in the international USAR response cycle and what is to be expected of each party, including the parties from the affected country.
zh: 3 国际城市搜索与救援响应的作用和责任 本章列出了参与国际城市搜索与救援响应周期的各类机构，以及对相关机构 的期望，包括来自受灾国的相关机构。

[p.237] en: 3.1 international assistance in disasters and humanitarian crises exceeding the capacity of the affected country.
zh: 1 联合国人道主义事务协调办公室 联合国人道主义事务协调办公室（OCHA）的任务是协调在灾害和人道主义 危机超出受灾国能力情况下提供的国际援助。

[p.237] en: Many organisations, such as governments, non-governmental organisations (NGOs), UN agencies and individuals, respond to disasters and humanitarian crises.
zh: 各类组织，包括政府组织、非政府组织、联合国机构和个人，都会对灾难和 人道主义危机做出响应。

[p.237] en: OCHA works with all participants and responds to disasters to assist the government of the affected country in an effort to ensure the most effective use of all international resources.
zh: 联合国人道主义事务协调办公室与所有救援参与方合作， 应对灾害，协助受灾国政府努力确保最有效地利用所有国际救灾资源。

[p.238] en: The INSARAG Secretariat is situated in the Response Support Branch in OCHA-Geneva, Switzerland.
zh: 国际搜 索与救援咨询团秘书处设在联合国人道主义事务协调办公室瑞士日内瓦总部响应 支持处。

[p.238] en: More on OCHA and the mechanisms OCHA offers for emergency response can be found at 3.2 UN Disaster Assessment and Coordination teams The United Nations Disaster Assessment and Coordination (UNDAC) team is an OCHA tool used for deployment to sudden-onset emergencies.
zh: 2 联合国灾害评估与协调队 联合国灾害评估与协调（UNDAC）队是联合国人道主义事务协调办公室的 一项工具，用于突发紧急情况下的援助部署。

[p.238] en: OCHA dispatches an UNDAC team when requested to do so by the affected government or the UN Resident Coordinator in the affected country.
zh: 根据受灾国政府或联合国驻地协调 员的要求，联合国人道主义事务协调办公室向受灾国派遣联合国灾害评估与协调 队。

[p.238] en: UNDAC team personnel are available around the clock and are able to respond at very short notice.
zh: 联合国灾害评估与协调队人员昼夜待命，能够在很短的时间内做出响应。

[p.238] en: The UNDAC team is provided as in-kind help to the affected country.
zh: 联 合国灾害评估与协调队是帮助受灾国的一支专家团队。

[p.238] en: UNDAC team members consist of trained emergency managers from countries, international organisations and OCHA.
zh: 联合国灾害评估与协调队的队员，包括来自各国、国际组织和人道主义事务 协调办公室的经过培训的应急管理人员。

[p.238] en: The UNDAC team is managed by Response Support Branch (RSB), which sits within OCHA, and works under the umbrella authority of the Resident Coordinator and in support of and in close cooperation with the LEMA.
zh: 联合国灾害评估与协调队由响应支持处 管理，该机构设在联合国人道主义事务协调办公室内，在驻地协调员的牵头领导 下工作，支持地方应急管理机构并与之密切合作。

[p.238] en: The UNDAC team assists the LEMA with the coordination of international response, including USAR, assessments of priority needs, and information management, by establishing an OSOCC, if one has not already been established, or assumes control of the OSOCC.
zh: 联合国灾害评估与协调队，帮 助地方应急管理机构协调国际应急响应，包括城市搜索与救援，优先需求的评估 和信息管理，如果尚未建立现场行动协调中心，则建立这一机构，或是接管现场 行动协调中心的控制权。

[p.238] en: 3.3 INSARAG Secretariat The INSARAG Secretariat is situated in the Emergency Response Section of the Response Support Branch in OCHA-Geneva, Switzerland.
zh: 3 国际搜索与救援咨询团秘书处 国际搜索与救援咨询团秘书处设在联合国人道主义事务协调办公室瑞士日内 瓦总部响应支持处的应急响应科。

[p.238] en: The task of the INSARAG Secretariat is to help organise INSARAG meetings, workshops, INSARAG IEC/Rs and training events in cooperation with host countries.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团秘书处的任务是与东道 国合作，帮助组织国际搜索与救援咨询团会议、研讨会、国际搜索与救援咨询团 分级测评/ 复测和培训活动。

[p.238] en: The INSARAG Secretariat is responsible for the management and maintenance of the INSARAG website (www.insarag.org) and the USAR Directory included in this site.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团秘书处负责管理和维护国际搜索与救援咨询团网站 （www.insarag.org）以及网站所载的城市搜索与救援队名录。

[p.239] en: Preparedness  Advocate and promote international USAR preparedness.  Facilitate and coordinate the development of internationally accepted USAR methodology and description of the minimal standards for international USAR operations.  Act as point of contact for INSARAG related issues within the UN.  Maintain the international USAR directory on the INSARAG website.
zh: 在联合国体系内，充当国际搜索与救援咨询团相关事务的联络人。

[p.239] en: Operations  Moderate the VOSOCC and post regular situation updates.  If not already done by the affected country/USAR Teams, advocate to establish and maintain an RDC and UCC.  Provide support to the UNDAC team as required.  Request additional UNDAC Support Modules as required.
zh: 在必要时，部署联合国灾害评估与协调队，并根据需要请求联合国灾 害评估与协调队支持单元。

[p.240] en: Demobilisation  Moderate the VOSOCC and post regular situation updates.  Provide support to UNDAC as required.
zh: 225 第二卷 准备和响应 4. 撤离阶段 （1） 管理虚拟现场行动协调中心，并定期发布情况更新。

[p.240] en: 3.4 United Nations Monitoring and Disaster Alert Systems 3.4.1 Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System The Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (GDACS) at www.gdacs.org, provides the international disaster response community with near real-time alerts about disasters around the world and tools to facilitate the coordination of response.
zh: 4 联合国监测和灾害警报系统 3.4.1 全球灾害预警与协调系统 全球灾害预警与协调系统（GDACS）设置在www.gdacs.org 网站，为国际救 灾机构提供了关于世界各地灾害的、近乎实时警报以及促进救灾响应协调的工具。

[p.240] en: GDACS is activated in major disasters that overwhelm the affected country’s response capacity and require international assistance.
zh: 如果重大灾害造成受灾国的应对能力不堪重负，并需要国际援助，则会启动 全球灾害预警与协调系统。

[p.240] en: 3.4.2 The Virtual On-Site Operations Coordination Centre The VOSOCC is a web-based information management tool at http://VOSOCC.unocha.org.
zh: 虚拟现场行动协调中心 虚拟现场行动协调中心是一个基于网络的信息管理工具，其网站为http:// VOSOCC.unocha.org。

[p.240] en: The VOSOCC is an information portal for information exchange between international responders and the affected country after disasters.
zh: 虚拟现场行动 协调中心是灾后国际救灾响应机构与受灾国之间信息交流的门户。

[p.240] en: Access to the VOSOCC is restricted (requires a password) to disaster managers from governments and disaster response organisations.
zh: 虚拟现场行动 协调中心的访问仅限于政府和救灾响应组织的灾难管理人员（需要密码）。

[p.240] en: The VOSOCC is managed by the Coordination Platforms Unit in RSB, Geneva.
zh: 虚拟 现场行动协调中心由日内瓦响应支持处的协调平台单元管理。

[p.240] en: The manual for use can be found at this link.
zh: 相应手册可在此链 接查阅。

[p.241] en: 3.5 Affected Countries Affected countries are those that experience the sudden-onset disaster.
zh: 226 3.5 受灾国 受灾国是那些遭受突发灾害的国家。

[p.241] en: UN General Assembly Resolution 57/150 recognises the important role of affected countries in streamlining processes to ensure the timely response of responding international teams as well as ensuring safety of the teams.
zh: 联合国大会第57/150 号决议明确了受 灾国在简化救灾流程中的重要性，可以确保国际应急响应机构的及时响应，以及 救援队的安全。

[p.242] en: Mobilisation  When required, make the request for international assistance as soon as possible.
zh: 动员阶段 （1） 根据灾情需要，尽快提出国际援助请求。

[p.242] en: The priority needs of international assistance should be identified and the information passed to the international community as soon as possible through OCHA and the VOSOCC.
zh: 应确定国际援助的优先需求，并通过联 合国人道主义事务协调办公室和虚拟现场行动协调中心尽快向国际社 会提供信息。

[p.242] en: Operations  Maintain representation at the RDC and the UCC/OSOCC to ensure a coordinated response and that national priorities are met.  Utilise international coordination mechanisms provided by UNDAC teams, and the RDC and UCC structures.  Establish mechanisms to integrate international USAR Teams into ongoing national operations.
zh: 利用各方提供的国际协调机制，包括联合国灾害评估与协调队、接待 和撤离中心和城市搜索与救援协调单元等协调架构。

[p.243] en: Demobilisation  Declare the end of the USAR operations phase.
zh: 228 4. 撤离阶段 （1） 宣布城市搜索与救援行动阶段的结束。

[p.243] en: This is a political decision that can be very sensitive because of its consequences.
zh: 这是由受灾国政府做出的一项 决定，原因是受灾国对灾区救援的影响可能受到各方高度关注。

[p.243] en: Indicators can be: meteorological circumstances, degree of damage, last life victims rescued.  Provide logistical support to assist the withdrawal of international teams.  Facilitate (as required) USAR Team’s transition into other humanitarian operations.  Facilitate donation of USAR Team equipment left for the affected government.
zh: 决定 撤离的依据可以包括：气象条件，建筑物破坏程度，最后获救的幸存 受困人员。

[p.243] en: This shall be coordinated by the RDC.
zh: 这一过程应由接待和撤离中心协调。

[p.243] en: The teams should be briefed and deployed to the disaster site(s) by the UCC.
zh: 城市搜索与救援协调单元应向各队伍简 要介绍情况，并将队伍部署到受灾现场。

[p.243] en: 3.7 Assisting Countries: Bilateral Responders Assisting countries are those with USAR Teams or other technical capacities who are deploying cross- border(s) into the affected country, to provide USAR capabilities or other capabilities as defined by the teams.
zh: 7 援助国：双边响应机构 援助国是拥有城市搜索与救援队或其他技术能力的国家，这些国家正在向 受灾国跨境部署救灾资源，提供城市搜索与救援能力或救援队伍具备的其他能 力。

[p.243] en: This is mainly done on a bilateral and/or (sub-)regional basis.
zh: 这类援助主要是基于双边救援机制和/ 或（次区域）区域救灾合作机制。

[p.244] en: Mobilisation  Once the decision is taken to deploy an international USAR Team, make an entry into the VOSOCC by adding the Team Fact Sheet in the ‘Add Relief Team’ section.  Identify and maintain an Operational Focal Point at the back-office for the duration of the mission.
zh: 动员阶段 （1） 一旦决定部署国际城市搜索与救援队，进入虚拟现场行动协调中心， 在“新增援助队伍”栏目中添加队伍概况表。

[p.244] en: Add this data to the Team Fact Sheet.  Provide regular information updates during all phases of the operation via the VOSOCC.  If necessary, to transit through another country, be responsible for transit arrangements.
zh: 将这一 信息添加到队伍概况表中。

[p.244] en: The transit country should facilitate quick transit for international USAR Teams.
zh: 过境国应为国际城市 搜索与救援队的快速过境提供便利。

[p.244] en: Operations  Provide all logistical and administrative support that may be required by the USAR Team while it is on mission and be able to provide a liaison officer as required.  Continue to assist the affected country as required where possible (engineering and medical assessments).
zh: 如果条件允许，则继续根据需要向受灾国提供援助（包括工程和医疗 状况评估）。

[p.244] en: Demobilisation  Continue to update relevant information on the VOSOCC.  Once USAR Teams are no longer required as advised by the affected country, provide transportation home.
zh: 根据受灾国的建议，一旦不再需要城市搜索与救援队，向队伍提供回 国的便利交通方式。

[p.244] en: Additional Capabilities The deployment methodologies applicable to USAR Teams can also be applied to the provision of other disaster assistance capabilities.
zh: 其他能力 适用于城市搜索与救援队的部署方法也可以用于提供其他救灾援助能力。

[p.244] en: Countries with deployable teams are encouraged to modulate their teams to increase their capabilities into other areas of humanitarian assistance.
zh: 鼓 励拥有可部署队伍的国家调整其队伍能力建设方式，提高队伍进入其他人道主义 援助领域的能力。

[p.244] en: If teams do have additional capabilities, they are encouraged to register this capability on the VOSOCC as early as possible prior to deployment.
zh: 如果队伍确实有其他能力，则鼓励队伍在部署之前尽早在虚拟

[p.245] en: Affected countries are encouraged to review the VOSOCC and invite classified teams to respond with capabilities that meet their immediate needs.
zh: 鼓励受灾国在虚拟现场行动协调中心对救援能力进行检查，并邀请经过分级 测评的队伍提供相应的救援能力，以满足国内当前的救援需求。

[p.245] en: If a deployed USAR Team is requested to leave capabilities in the affected country past the demobilisation time of the main team, this is to be registered on the VOSOCC as a new deployment detailing the capability that is being provided.
zh: 在队伍主要人员撤离之后，如果部署的城市搜索与救援队将其部分能力留在 受灾国，那么该队伍应在虚拟现场行动协调中心上注册新的部署任务，详细说明 其所提供的救援能力。

[p.245] en: The deploying team is responsible for entering all new information on the VOSOCC and providing a deployment management team that will liaise with the affected country as needed.
zh: 在虚拟现场行动协调中心，部署队伍负责输入所有新信息 并建立一个部署管理小组，该小组将根据需要与受灾国进行联络。

[p.247] en: Post-Mission  Ensure that USAR Team Post-Mission Report is provided to the INSARAG Secretariat within 45 days.  Analyse deployment performance and update SOPs as required.
zh: 总结阶段 （1） 在结束任务后的 45 天内，确保向国际搜索与救援咨询团秘书处提供 城市搜索与救援队的总结报告。

[p.247] en: 3.9 USAR Functions During Deployment Figure 2: USAR functions during deployment.
zh: 分析部署行动的表现，并根据需要更新标准行动程序。

[p.248] en: INSARAG operates in accordance with the Humanitarian Principles, which form the core of humanitarian action.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团按照人道主义原则开展行动，这些原则构成了人道主 义行动的核心。

[p.248] en: USAR Teams should always aim to be a well-organised, highly-trained group of specialists who have been assembled to help communities in need of specialist assistance.
zh: 城市搜索与救援队应始终致力于成为一支组织良好、训练有素的专家团队， 这些专家聚集在一起以帮助需要其援助的社区。

[p.248] en: At the end of a mission, USAR Teams should have performed positively, and should be remembered for the outstanding way they conducted themselves in the work environment as well as socially.
zh: 在任务结束时，城市搜索与救援 队应当已经做出积极的救灾响应，并且在工作环境和社交方面有令人难忘的出色 表现。

[p.248] en: Ethical considerations include human rights, legal, gender, moral and cultural issues, and also concern the relationship between USAR Team members and the community of the affected country.
zh: 职业伦理包括人权、法律、性别、道德和文化问题，也涉及城市搜索与救援 队队员与受灾国社区之间的关系。

[p.248] en: They should practice inclusiveness in their approach.
zh: 城市搜索与救援队队员应当在工作方法中践行 包容性原则。

[p.248] en: Any violation of principles or behaviour unbecoming by team members is viewed as unprofessional.
zh: 如果队员违反相关原则或存在行 为不当，均被视为违反职业伦理。

[p.248] en: Any inappropriate behaviour may discredit the good work of the USAR Team and reflects poorly on the entire team's performance and their home country, as well as the wider INSARAG community.
zh: 任何不当行为都可能损害城市搜索与救援队的 工作成效，并给整支队伍的表现抹黑，损害队伍所在国以及全球国际搜索与救援 咨询团体系的形象。

[p.248] en: At no time during a mission should USAR Team members take advantage of or exploit any situation or opportunity, and it is the responsibility of all team members to conduct themselves in a professional manner always.
zh: 在执行任务期间，城市搜索与救援队队员不应利用任何情况趁机为自身谋求 利益，所有队员都有责任始终以专业的方式行事。

[p.248] en: USAR Teams that deploy internationally must be self-sufficient to ensure they are at no time a burden to the already overwhelmed country they are trying to assist.
zh: 执行国际任务的城市搜索与救援队必须自给自足，确保队伍永远不会成为负 担，因为接受援助的国家已经不堪重负。

[p.249] en: INSARAG) and being active on the VOSOCC.  Ensure the readiness of the USAR Team all the times, and that a mobilisation organisation maintains an up-to-date immediate call-up system.  Responsible for the registration of the USAR Team in the INSARAG USAR Directory.
zh: 负责与国家主管部门（队伍的管理机构）和国际利益相关方（国际搜 索与救援咨询团）保持协作，并在虚拟现场行动协调中心保持可用状 态。

[p.252] en: USAR Team Search  Ensure that the readiness of physical search, technical and/or canines (health, fitness, hygiene, diet, etc.) for travel, including all specialised gear and equipment (including microchips), are ready for USAR operation (respect international standards and procedures).
zh: 237 第二卷 准备和响应 2. 城市搜索与救援队搜索 确保做好人工搜索、技术搜索和/ 或搜救犬的国际部署准备（健康状况、适 应能力、卫生、饮食等），包括所有专用器材和装备（包括微芯片），做好准备 进行城市搜索与救援行动（遵守国际标准和程序）。

[p.252] en: USAR Team Rescue  Ensure readiness of equipment cache and necessary documentations for restricted items.
zh: 城市搜索与救援队救援 确保将装备打包好，并准备好入境限制性物品的必要文件。

[p.253] en: 4.3 Operation USAR Team Management  The LEMA of the affected country is the overall responsible authority for the disaster response: USAR Teams must adhere with the policies and procedures of the affected country regarding incident operations.  Team management is responsible for managing all aspects of team operations and ensuring all functional areas within the team coordinate operations.
zh: 238 4.3 行动阶段 1. 城市搜索与救援队管理 （1） 受灾国的地方应急管理机构是救灾的总负责机构：城市搜索与救援队 必须遵守受灾国/ 地区有关救灾行动的政策和程序。

[p.253] en: They are also responsible to assess the progress of operations.
zh: 管理层还负责评估救灾行动进展。

[p.253] en:  Establish an information cycle to brief home base, USAR Team members, UCC and the LEMA.  Keep a detailed operations log.  Assess and respect permanently the safety and security situation and procedures.  Establish and enforce rules and regulations for safety and security on worksite(s) and BoO.  Managing and coordinating the media together with the LEMA/UCC.
zh: 制定信息通报周期，定期向总部基地、城市搜索与救援队队员、城 市搜索与救援协调单元和地方应急管理机构简要通报情况。

[p.256] en: 4.4 Demobilisation USAR Team Management  Demobilisation must be planned and coordinated from the beginning of the operation.
zh: 4 撤离阶段 1. 城市搜索与救援队管理 （1） 从行动一开始，就必须进行撤离工作的规划和协调。

[p.256] en: USAR Team Search  Cease work and prepare handover to the organisation taking over the tasks.  Prepare canines and equipment for return transportation.
zh: 准备搜救犬和装备的回程运输。

[p.257] en: USAR Team Rescue  Cease work and prepare handover to the organisation taking over the tasks.  Prepare and pack equipment for demobilisation and departure.
zh: 进行准备和撤离打包装备，离境出发。

[p.257] en:  Coordinate demobilisation with local relevant health authorities (i.e. through UCC/Health Cluster) Healthcare infrastructure assessments (USAR is often in country early in the post-impact phase and/or may have more mobility to assess remote outlying locations.
zh: 城市搜索与救援队医疗 （1） 与当地相关卫生主管部门协调撤离工作，包括城市搜索与救援协调单 元/ 医疗组群，根据需要进行医疗基础设施评估（在灾害发生后的早 期，城市搜索与救援队通常已部署到受灾国和/ 或可能具备抵达偏远 灾区，以评估医疗基础设施的能力。

[p.258] en: 4.5 Post-Mission USAR Team Management  The after-action process includes compiling a Post Mission Report documenting administrative issues and operational concerns which should be forwarded to OCHA within 45 days of returning home.  Lessons-learnt must be included in planning and training.
zh: 243 第二卷 准备和响应 4.5 总结阶段 1. 城市搜索与救援队管理 （1） 救援总结的流程包括：编写一份总结报告，记录队伍管理问题和救援 行动重要事项，应在返回原驻国后 45 天内提交给联合国人道主义事 务协调办公室。

[p.258] en: USAR Team Search  The canine group prepares and delivers a report on the mission to their USAR Team.
zh: 城市搜索与救援队搜索 搜救犬小组应准备资料，并向其所属城市搜索与救援队提交任务报告。

[p.258] en: USAR Team Rescue  Provide inputs to the team report and identify lessons-learnt.
zh: 城市搜索与救援队营救 为队伍报告提供信息并总结经验教训。

[p.258] en: USAR Team Logistics  Safety equipment and supplies must be restored and restocked for next deployment.
zh: 城市搜索与救援队后勤 必须恢复和补充安全装备和用品，为下一次部署做好准备。

[p.258] en: 5 USAR Coordination Structure 5.1 Core Coordination Elements The coordination structure of an international USAR operation can involve many different stakeholders and can differ significantly at each disaster.
zh: 5 城市搜索与救援协调架构 5.1 核心协调要素 国际城市搜索与救援行动的协调架构，可能涉及许多不同的利益相关方，并 且在每次救灾过程中存在很大差异。

[p.258] en: However, the core structure, key actors and how they should interact should be the same.
zh: 但是，核心结构、关键救援参与方及其规定

[p.259] en: In the section below, it will be explained how these tools/elements can facilitate the coordination process among international USAR Teams, an OSOCC (UNDAC team), and the LEMA.
zh: 线上协调 边境协调 现场协调 虚拟现场行动协调中心 现场行动协调中心 接待和撤离中心 城市搜索与救援协调 单元 国际城市搜索与救援队 受灾国/ 省份 地方应急管理机构 当地的城市搜索与 救援队和资源 图3 核心协调架构和主要信息流 在以下的章节中，将解释这些工具/ 元素促进相关机构协调过程的具体方式， 包括国际城市搜索与救援队、现场行动协调中心（联合国灾害评估与协调队）和 地方应急管理机构。

[p.259] en: The broken arrows in the figure represent on line information flows.
zh: 图3 中的虚线箭头表示线上信息流。

[p.259] en: The normal arrows represent information flows in any form, included on line flows.
zh: 普通箭头表示各种形式 的信息流，包含线上信息流。

[p.259] en: Besides the coordination in the field and at the borders, or entry points, the coordination takes place on the VOSOCC.
zh: 除了在现场和边境或入境点进行协调外，还在虚拟 现场行动协调中心开展协调工作。

[p.259] en: 5.2 Reception and Departure Centre A large-scale sudden onset disaster generally results in a rapid influx of assistance from the International Community to the affected country.
zh: 2 接待和撤离中心 大规模的突发灾害通常会使得国际社会提供的援助资源迅速涌入受灾国。

[p.259] en: Response teams and relief supplies will converge into the country at one or more points of entry to seek access to the disaster affected areas.
zh: 救灾响应队伍和救援物资将在受灾国的一个或多个入境点汇合，然后再设法 送至灾区。

[p.259] en: Depending on the geography of the affected country and the infrastructure damage, the point of entry may be an airport, seaport or land border.
zh: 根据受灾国的地理情况和基础设施受损情况，入境点可能是机场、海 港或陆地边界。

[p.259] en: There may be numerous RDC’s for one event, based on the need.
zh: 根据需要，一次灾害事件可能设立多个接待和撤离中心。

[p.260] en: The first arriving classified team should also expect to engage in initial USAR coordination to ensure operations are coordinated from the onset.
zh: 第一支抵达的通过分级测评的队伍，还应预计到他们需要参与最初的城市搜 索与救援队的协调工作，确保救援行动从一开始就得到妥善协调。

[p.260] en: The first arriving team should establish contact with the LEMA to obtain information about the disaster response and with the next arriving teams to ensure coordination.
zh: 第一支抵达的 队伍应与地方应急管理机构建立联系，获取有关救灾响应的信息，并与下一支抵 达的队伍建立联系，确保救灾行动的协调。

[p.260] en: As this is done, the team should also establish the USAR Coordination Cell (UCC).
zh: 在此过程中，首支抵达的队伍还应建 立城市搜索与救援协调单元（UCC）。

[p.260] en: If possible, the personnel who begin the coordination process should remain in the UCC throughout the disaster to ensure continuity.
zh: 如果可能，在整个救灾响应期间，最初参与协调过程的人员应留在 城市搜索与救援协调单元，确保工作的连续性。

[p.260] en: Proper planning is a vital component of incident management.
zh: 适当的规划是救灾事件管理的重要组成部分。

[p.260] en: It facilitates adequate and safe use of resources through proper selection of strategies and tactics.
zh: 通过战略和战术的适当选择， 可以促进资源得到充分和安全的使用。

[p.260] en: The objective of the planning process is to assign and reassign teams to prioritised worksites based on their capacities, in order to maximise the likelihood of live rescues.
zh: 规划过程的目标是根据队伍的能力将队伍 分配或重新分配到优先任务现场，最大限度地提高拯救生命的可能性。

[p.260] en: Please refer to the USAR Coordination Manual under the Manuals  UCC tabs of the Guidance Notes on www.insarag.org for more information.
zh: 更多相关信息，请参见www.insarag.org网站指南说明中“Manuals UCC”选项卡下的城市搜索与救援协调手册。

[p.260] en: 5.3 USAR Planning Process Proper planning is a vital component of incident management and facilitates adequate and safe use of resources through proper selection of strategies and tactics.
zh: 3 城市搜索与救援规划流程 适当的规划是救灾事件管理的重要组成部分；

[p.260] en: Planning principles do not differ during large- scale international incidents; therefore, USAR coordination staff must be aware of these principles and be ready to adopt them within the management process.
zh: 因此，城市搜索与救援队的协调工作人员必须了解这些原则，并准备在 队伍管理过程中采用这些原则。

[p.260] en: Please refer to the USAR Coordination Manual under the Manuals  UCC tabs of the Guidance Notes on www.insarag.org for more information on the on the USAR Planning Process.
zh: 关于城市搜索与救援协调规划流程的更多相关信 息，请参见www.insarag.org 网站指南说明中“Manuals UCC”选项卡下的城市搜 索与救援协调手册。

[p.260] en: 5.4 INSARAG Coordination and Management System The INSARAG Coordination and Management System (ICMS) is a web-based INSARAG management and coordination system.
zh: 4 国际搜索与救援咨询团协调管理系统 国际搜索与救援咨询团协调管理系统（ICMS）是一个基于网络的国际搜索

[p.261] en: It is comprised of digital forms (Survey 123 application) and an ESRI-based dashboard that displays the data collected on the forms as numbers, charts and on a map.
zh: 该系统由数字表单（Survey123 应用程序）和基 于ESRI 的数据图表组成，将表格中收集的数据显示为数字、图表和地图。

[p.261] en: INSARAG teams will be supplied with accounts to the system that they can use during training and will be provided with account information for a particular disaster at the on-set of the event through the VOSOCC.
zh: 国际 搜索与救援咨询团的每一支队伍都在该系统上拥有一个账户，可以在培训期间使 用，并在救灾行动开始时，通过虚拟现场行动协调中心账户获得有关灾害的具体 信息。

[p.261] en: The teams will fill in their Fact sheet information through Survey123, and update their status (mobilising, deployed, demobilising) on Survey123 as well.
zh: 相关队伍将通过Survey123 填写其队伍概况表，并在Survey123 上更新其 状态（包括动员、部署和撤离）。

[p.261] en: All INSARAG paper forms are being moved into ICMS, however paper forms will still be kept within the coordination system, in the event that the web-based system is not operational.
zh: 但是，如果网络系统无法运行，那么纸 质表格仍将在协调系统中继续使用。

[p.261] en: Teams will be notified directly of their assignments, but the teams and the UCC can view the assignments and the progression of the operations via the dashboard.
zh: 相关队伍将直 接收到有关其任务分配的通知，这些队伍和城市搜索与救援协调单元可以通过数 据图表查看任务分配和行动进度。

[p.261] en: Please refer to the ICMS documents under the Manuals  Information Management tabs of the Guidance Notes on www.insarag.org for more information on ICMS.
zh: 关于国际搜索与救援咨询团协调管理系统的 更多相关信息，请参见www.insarag.org 网站指南说明中“Manuals, Information Management”选项卡下的国际搜索与救援咨询团协调管理系统文件。

[p.261] en: 5.5 USAR Coordination Method 5.5.1 Why to create sectors A disaster that warrants international USAR response is inherently a large-scale event.
zh: 5 城市搜索与救援协调方法 5.5.1 创建分区的原因 需要城市搜索与救援队做出国际响应的灾害，本质上都是大规模灾害事件。

[p.261] en: The scale of destruction may just involve one city, or it may affect a large area involving numerous cities and even more than one country.
zh: 灾害破坏影响的规模可能只涉及一个城市，也可能涉及众多城市，甚至波及不止 一个国家的广阔地区。

[p.261] en: Geographical sectorisation of the affected areas can be needed to ensure effective coordination of SAR efforts by improving the span of control.
zh: 可能需要对受灾地区进行地理分区处理，确保通过提高控 制范围，更加有效地协调搜救工作。

[p.261] en: Sectorisation will improve operational planning, more effective assignment of the USAR Teams and better overall management of the incident.
zh: 分区处理可以改善行动规划，更有效地分配 城市搜索与救援队，更好地全面管理救灾事件。

[p.261] en: The size and numbers of the sectors will depend on the level of resources and the needs of the affected area, the volume of work, geographical area and features, scale of response amongst other factors.
zh: 地理分区的规模和数量将取决于 资源水平和受灾地区的需求、工作量、地理区域和特点、救灾响应规模等因素。

[p.261] en: If need be, sectors can be divided into subsectors by their respective sector coordinators.
zh: 如有必要，每个地理分区可由各自的分区协调员划分为子分区。

[p.261] en: 5.5.2 When and how to sectorise Sectorisation should be undertaken at the earliest possible stage of a disaster response to ensure its effectiveness.
zh: 创建分区的时机和方法 应在救灾的最早阶段进行地理分区，确保其有效性。

[p.261] en: It is expected that the LEMA should have a sectorisation plan in place and that international USAR Teams should follow it.
zh: 地方应急管理机构应当 制定一项地理分区计划，国际城市搜索与救援队应当遵循这项计划。

[p.261] en: The LEMA is likely to refer to local sectors such as neighbourhoods, parishes, etc. as the local government will have information organised in this format.
zh: 地方应急管 理机构可能参考当地社区、教区等本地分区，因为当地政府将以这种分区方式管 理相关信息。

[p.261] en: However, if there is no sector plan, it should be developed at the earliest possible stage of a disaster response and in close liaison with the LEMA.
zh: 但是，如果没有建立地理分区计划，则应在救灾的最早阶段制定这一计划，

[p.262] en: If the LEMA has no sector plan, then a Wide Area Assessment (ASR1) may be necessary to get the relevant information to design the sector plan.
zh: 如果地方应急管理机构没有地理分区计划，则可能需 要进行大范围评估（ASR 1 级），获取相关信息以设计地理分区计划。

[p.262] en: 5.5.3 Sector Identification The default INSARAG sector identification system is to use a simple lettering system to code each sector; A, B, C, D and so on.
zh: 地理分区的标识 国际搜索与救援咨询团默认的地理分区标识系统，采用简单的字母对每个地 理分区进行编码：A、B、C、D，以此类推。

[p.262] en: It is given into consideration not to use the letter I and O to avoid any misunderstandings with the numbers 1 and 0.
zh: 这一标识系统不使用字母I 和O， 以避免与数字1 和0 产生可能的混淆。

[p.262] en: A local name or description can also be added to ensure clarity e.g.
zh: 还可以添加本地名称或描述，确保定义清 晰，如巴东市北A 区。

[p.262] en: Sector 1, 2, 3, or Red, Blue, Green etc., it should be adopted and allow for it in any documentation or markings.
zh: 如果地方应急管理机构有自己的编码地理分区标识系统，如地理分区1、2、 3 或红色、蓝色、绿色等，则应在相关文件或标记中采用并遵循这种分区标识系统。

[p.262] en: The diagrams below are simple illustrations of how geographical sectorisation can be done.
zh: 图4 ～图6 简单说明了进行地理分区的方法。

[p.262] en: Figure 5: Sectorising an affected area using streets and city block layouts.
zh: 图5 基于街道和城市街区布局对受灾区域进行分区 图4 将受灾地区划分为较小的管理区域

[p.263] en: Figure 6: Sectorising an affected area using prominent features e.g.
zh: 248 图6 基于显著地理特征对受灾区域进行分区（如河流北部A 区，河流南部B 区） 5.5.4 工作场地及其定义 为了进行有效的协调，必须对进行城市搜索与救援重大行动的每个场地提供 唯一标识。

[p.263] en: 5.5.4 Worksite and its definition To allow effective coordination it is essential to uniquely identify every site where significant USAR operations take place.
zh: 每一种含有这类标识的救援场地都将被称为一个工作场地。

[p.263] en: Each of these sites will be known as a worksite.
zh: 工作场地可能具有不同的含义，但最简单的定义是“进行城市搜索与救援重 大行动的各类场地”。

[p.263] en: However, to avoid assigning teams to sites that only have victims to be confirmed dead, these sites may be given an identification (ID) for documentation purposes.
zh: 但是，为了避免将队伍分配到只有确认死亡受困人员 的场地，可能会为这些场地提供一个场地编码用于文档管理。

[p.263] en: Worksites will typically be one building where one USAR Team or squad is working because of a potential live rescue.
zh: 由于可能需要现场 救援，工作场地通常是城市搜索与救援队或搜救小组正在开展救援行动的一栋建 筑物，但工作场地可能比一栋建筑物更大或更小。

[p.263] en: A large building or complex of buildings, e.g. a hospital, may be identified as a single worksite.
zh: 大型建筑物或建筑物群，如医 院，可以确定为一个工作场地。

[p.263] en: Alternatively, the site of a single rescue in an area of only a few square metres would also be identified as a worksite.
zh: 另一种情况下，面积仅数平方米的单次救援现场 也可以被视为一个工作场地。

[p.263] en: 5.5.5 Worksite Identification When it is decided that a site will need USAR operations, usually rescue work, it should be given its own Worksite Identification (Worksite ID), the Worksite ID is in addition to the existing street name and building number.
zh: 工作场地编码 如果决定某个场地需要开展城市搜索与救援行动，通常是救援工作，那么应 当给予这个场地一个编码（工作场地编码），工作场地编码是对现有街道名称和 建筑物编号的补充。

[p.263] en: This can be done during ASR2 but sites may also be allocated by the LEMA.
zh: 这可以在ASR 2 级评估期间完成工作场地标识，但也可以 由地方应急管理机构进行工作场地标识。

[p.263] en: In any case, each site should be allocated its own Worksite ID using the following protocol:  The first part is the Sector letter allocated to the area the site is in e.g.
zh: 在任何情况下，都应使用以下原则为每 个工作场地分配独一无二的工作场地编码： （1）第一部分是分配给救援场地所在区域的地理分区字母，如 A。

[p.263] en: A.  As a worksite is identified a number is then sequentially allocated 1, 2, 3, etc.
zh: 在确定工作场地后，按顺序为每个工作场地分配一个数字，如 1、2、 3 等。

[p.264] en: Team 1 uses 1 to 20, Team 2 uses 21 to 40 etc.
zh: 如果多支队伍在同一地理分区，那么城市搜索与救援协调单元将规定某 支队伍所使用的具体数字，如队伍1 使用1 ～20，队伍2 使用21 ～40 等。

[p.264] en: If the LEMA uses a different sector code, e.g. numbers, then this should be used as the first part of the Worksite ID, e.g.
zh: 如果地方应急管理机构使用不同的地理分区代码，如数字，则应将其用作工 作场地编码的第一部分，如1-1 而非A-1。

[p.264] en: Note: If sectorisation has not been completed, the use of plain numerals is recommended; these numbers can subsequently be integrated into the complete Worksite ID system once established.
zh: 地理分区一旦 建立，这些数字就可以集成到完整的工作场地编码系统中。

[p.264] en: Control of number use is required to achieve this, e.g. give search teams batches of numbers 1 to 19, 20 to 39, 40 to 59 etc.
zh: 为此，需要控制号 码的使用，例如：向搜索队伍提供编号1 ～19、20 ～39、40 ～59 等。

[p.264] en: Figure 7: Sectorise the area of operation by assigning a letter to each area.
zh: 图7、图8 说明了分区代码标识的过程。

[p.264] en: Figure 8: As potential rescue sites are identified, they are numbered and added to the Sector letter to produce a unique Worksite ID for each site.
zh: 图7 通过为每个区域分配一个字母以进行地理分区 图8 确定潜在救援地点后，会对其进行编号并添加到地理分区字母 中，从而为每个场地生成唯一的工作场地编码

[p.265] en: 5.5.6 Worksites within Worksites It is probable that a relatively large worksite, e.g. a hospital, which is initially identified as a single worksite, e.g.
zh: 250 5.5.6 工作场地内的分场地 对于一个相对较大的工作场地，如医院，最初被确定为单一工作场地，如B-2， 但最终可能会针对不同的地点划分多个救援工作场地。

[p.265] en: For coordination purposes it is useful to identify each of these separately.
zh: 出于协调目的，对其中的每一个工作场地分别进行标识，这样会有帮助。

[p.265] en: B-2a, B-2b, B-2c etc. to provide a unique “address” for each.
zh: 为此， 应为每个工作场地保留原来的单一工作场地但添加后缀字母，如B-2a，B-2b，B-2c 等，从而为每个子任务现场提供唯一的“标识”。

[p.265] en: Figure 9: An example of worksites within a large initial single worksite.
zh: 大型初始单一工作场地中的分 场地示例如图9 所示。

[p.265] en: The whole site was initially identified as a worksite (B-2) with potential live rescues but when teams did a detailed search, they discovered three separate rescue sites in distinct locations.
zh: 整个场地最初被确定为具有潜在现场救援的工作场地（B-2），但当队伍进 行仔细搜索时，他们在不同的位置发现了三个独立的救援工作场地。

[p.265] en: For coordination purposes, e.g. exact location, logistics support, reporting etc., it is important that each worksite has its own “address.” Note: International USAR Teams are deployed to support the LEMA.
zh: 出于协调目 的，如了解确切位置、后勤支持、报告等，每个工作场地都需要有自己的“标识”， 这一点非常重要。

[p.265] en: Any existing mechanism in use will be adapted by the international teams to better augment national resources already deployed for rescue work.
zh: 国际队 伍可能调整正在使用的各种现有机制，更好地增强已经部署的国家资源，用于 救援工作。

[p.265] en: 5.6 USAR Team Identification Code To standardise the identification of all USAR Teams within the coordination system, a Team ID is required.
zh: 6 城市搜索与救援队标识代码 为了标准化协调系统中所有城市搜索与救援队的标识，每支队伍需要一个队 伍编码。

[p.265] en: The Team ID is composed of two parts: The three-letter Olympic code of the home country of the team; and a double-digit number to differentiate teams from the same country.
zh: 队伍编码由两部分组成：队伍所在国或地区的三字母奥林匹克代码，以 及一个两位数的数字，以区分来自同一国家或地区的队伍。

[p.266] en: NGO’s) will not use the three-letter Olympic code.
zh: 251 第二卷 准备和响应 多国队伍（如非政府组织）不会使用三字母奥林匹克国家代码，而是使用字 母“SAR”进行标识。

[p.266] en: Team designators 01 to 09 are for IEC/IER classified teams, designators 10 through 99 are to be used for non-classified teams.
zh: 数字01 ～09 用于国际搜索与救援咨询团分级测评/ 分级复测队伍，数字 10 ～99 用于未经过分级测评的队伍。

[p.266] en: The INSARAG Operational Focal Point administers the country team designators and through the Secretariat updates the USAR directory on www.insarag.org.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团的行动联络人管理 国家队伍的标识代码，并通过秘书处更新www.insarag.org 网站上的城市搜索与 救援队名录。

[p.266] en: 5.7 Assessment, Search and Rescue Levels Introduction A key element of the INSARAG coordination are the definitions of key types of work typically needed during a major USAR incident.
zh: 7 评估、搜索和营救级别 简介 国际搜索与救援咨询团协调的一个关键事项是确定在城市搜索与救援重大行 动期间通常需要明确的关键工作类型。

[p.266] en: This can range from initial assessment of the affected area to deconstructing a building to recover the last deceased victim.
zh: 工作类型可能涉及对受灾区域的初步评估， 也可能是破拆建筑物以找到最后一名遇难者。

[p.266] en: Having a clear definition of all the possible operational levels allows the coordination actors to be specific about the planning, tasking, specific USAR operations needed and the progress made.
zh: 明确定义所有可能的行动级别，确保协调人员能够具体说明规划、任务分配、 所需的城市搜索与救援具体行动和取得的进展。

[p.266] en: Information management tools (templates, forms, reports, marking system, VOSOCC etc.) used to facilitate coordination also relate to the level of USAR work being carried out.
zh: 用于促进协调的信息管理工具， 包括模板、表格、报告、标记系统、虚拟现场行动协调中心等，也与正在开展的 城市搜索与救援行动的级别有关。

[p.266] en: ICMS (INSARAG Collection and Management System) is used to facilitate coordination, it relates to the level of USAR work needed to be carried out.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团的协调管理系统（ICMS） 用于促进协调，涉及所需的城市搜索与救援行动级别。

[p.266] en: 5.7.1 The Levels USAR operations are divided into the five levels listed in the table below.
zh: 级别 在下表中，城市搜索与救援行动分为五个级别。

[p.266] en: These levels are defined as sequential activities, but, in reality, teams may receive assignments in any order.
zh: 这些级别是按照救援行动的 顺序定义的，但实际上，队伍可以按任何顺序接收任务安排。

[p.266] en: Especially in large scale operations where LEMA identifies worksites before teams arrive.
zh: 特别是在大规模救 灾行动中，地方应急管理机构在队伍到达之前对各种工作场地进行标识。

[p.266] en: Or when new areas are being opened throughout the response.
zh: 或者， 在整个响应过程中，开辟新的行动区域。

[p.266] en: Hence different levels of work are being carried out in different areas of the incident at the same moment.
zh: 因此，在同一时期，救灾事件的不同区 域正在开展不同级别的救援行动。

[p.266] en: Note: The five levels are identified as:  Level 1: Wide Area Assessment.  Level 2: Worksite Triage Assessment.  Level 3: Rapid Search and Rescue.  Level 4: Full Search and Rescue.  Level 5: Total Coverage Search and Recovery.
zh: 注释：这五个级别的定义如下：①ASR 级别1：大范围评估（表1）；

[p.267] en: Each level is explained and defined in more detail in the tables on the following pages.
zh: 252 后文中的表格对每个级别进行了更为详细的定义和解释。

[p.267] en: If it is not complete it may be beneficial to redo this.
zh: 如果评估不完整，那么重新评估可能是有益的。

[p.267] en: Can be done by members of the OSOCC/UNDAC team on their arrival.
zh: 在抵达现场时，现场行动协调中心/ 联合国灾害评估与协调队的成员可 以完成这项评估。

[p.267] en: Resource requests e.g. more teams.
zh: 建立并确定初步优先事项和计划 （5）确定资源需求，如更多队伍。

[p.267] en: Table 1: ASR Level 1 Wide Area Assessment.
zh: 旨在及时评估整个分区。

[p.268] en: It is preferably done closely behind the Level 1 Wide Area Assessment and as soon as possible after sectors have been established.
zh: 如果认为有必要，可以在后期重复ASR 2 级评估，如进行夜间评估或 利用其他搜救犬进行评估，这可能会产生不同的评估结果 执行时机 和执行人 （1） 在完成ASR 1 级大范围评估后，最好立即进行ASR 2 级工作场地优先 级评估，并确认分区。

[p.268] en: The LEMA may have sectorised and started this process prior to assistance arriving.
zh: 在援助资源到达之前，地方应急管理机构可能已经完成地理分区，并 开始工作场地优先级评估。

[p.268] en: Use of dogs or technical search equipment is optional and will depend on the situation.
zh: 搜救犬或技术搜索装备是可选项，可根据需要使用。

[p.268] en: Using these will improve the detailed results but will slow down the process; a balance is needed.
zh: 搜救犬或技术搜索装 备可以提供更详细的评估结果，但会减慢评估过程，因此需要综合考虑 国际搜索 与救援咨 询团工具 （1） 工作场地优先选择表。

[p.268] en: A map of the sector area being assessed is highly recommended and should be used to clarify the areas assessed and cleared.
zh: 绘制一份正在评估的地理分区地图，这很有必要，并将其应用于澄清 已评估区域和已搜索区域。

[p.268] en: There could also be information such as: LEMA briefings, information from local teams, GPS coordinates, photographs etc.
zh: 评估工具还可能包括以下信息：地方应急管理机构简报、当地队伍的信息、 全球定位系统坐标数据、现场照片等 产出 （1） 得到完整的工作场地优先选择表，确定需要队伍开展救援行动的现场。

[p.268] en: A completed worksite ID.
zh: 确定已完成的工作场地编码。

[p.268] en: A correctly marked worksite for triage.
zh: 得到经过分类的带有正确标识的工作场地。

[p.268] en: A map of the sector showing the area covered by the assessment.
zh: 显示评估所覆盖区域的地理分区地图。

[p.268] en: Further resource requests.
zh: 确定明确的其他资源需求。

[p.269] en: Approved data in the ICMS dashboard.
zh: 254 定义和解释 产出 （8） 获取国际搜索与救援咨询团协调管理系统数据图表中的已批准数据。

[p.269] en: However, they must ensure Level 3 work is completed for the remaining worksites assigned to them.
zh: 在该级别，队伍应确定可能需要进行ASR 4 级搜索的建筑结构或工作 场地。

[p.269] en: In case they are not able or do not complete the rescue, they should ask for additional resources.  If additional rescue sites are identified at any time, then a new Worksite ID should be created.  The SCC/UCC must keep track of all ASR3 assignments and reassign to the site for ASR4, except for those sites being reported not to need ASR4.
zh: 如果确定困在已确认深度的幸存受困人员，如果任务执行条件允许或 是已获得分区协调机构的许可，ASR 3 队伍可以升级执行ASR 4 级行 动。

[p.269] en: Victim Extrication Form.
zh: 埋压人员解救情况表。

[p.269] en: Worksite marking system.
zh: 工作场地标记系统 表2（续）

[p.270] en: Completed Worksite Reports.
zh: 255 第二卷 准备和响应 定义和解释 产出 （1）完成工作场地报告。

[p.270] en: Marking of worksites.
zh: 确认工作场地的标记。

[p.270] en: This level is normally carried out after or in conjunction with Level 3 Rapid Search and Rescue.
zh: 需要对工作场地进行全面的指挥和控制 执行时机 和执行人 （1） ASR 4 级行动通常在ASR 3 级快速搜索和救援之后进行，或与ASR 3 级快速搜索和营救一起进行。

[p.270] en: If the LEMA has identified specific sites already, a team may go straight into Level 4 operations as their first tasking.
zh: 如果地方应急管理机构已经确定了具体的场地，则救援队伍的首要任 务便是可以直接开始ASR 4 级行动。

[p.270] en: Worksite Marking system.
zh: 确定工作场地的标记。

[p.271] en: This is usually done after the rescue phase.
zh: ⑤对工作场地进行全面指挥和控制，这一点 至关重要 执行时机 和执行人 （1） ASR 5 级行动通常在救援阶段之后进行。

[p.271] en: This level is not normally carried out by international USAR Teams.
zh: 国际城市搜索与救援队通常不会执行这一级别的行动。

[p.271] en: International USAR Teams can be asked to undertake this task where area clearance and body recovery is a high priority.
zh: 可以要求国际城市搜索与救援队承担这项任务，其中区域清理和遗体 寻回是重要优先事项。

[p.271] en: Some international teams may do this and some may not, each team will make their own decision.
zh: 有些国际队伍可能会执行这项行动，另外一些可能不会，每支队伍都 有权做出自己的决定 国际搜索 与救援咨 询团工具 （1） 工作场地优先选择表。

[p.271] en: Victim Extrication Form if necessary.
zh: 这项工作可能专门用于遇难者的定位/ 遗体寻回。

[p.272] en: 5.8 Worksite Triage The objective of ASR 2 Worksite Assessment is to assess collapsed structures and identify viable sites for live rescues.
zh: 得到已清理区域的地图，作为报告成果的一部分 5.8 工作场地优先级分类 ASR 2 级工作场地优先级评估的目标是评估倒塌的结构并确定可行的现场救 援位置。

[p.272] en: The UCC will use this information to list sites in order of priority and decide which teams to assign to which sites.
zh: 利用这一评估信息，城市搜索与救援协调单元将按优先级顺序列出救援 位置，并决定将不同的队伍部署到不同的救援位置。

[p.272] en: One of the considerations for the prioritisation of worksites is the triage category.
zh: 工作场地优先级的考虑因素 之一是分类的类别。

[p.272] en: The objective of a triage process is to evaluate triage factors to compare collapsed structures and decide the order of priority.
zh: 分类过程的目标是评估分类要素，比较所有倒塌的结构，并确定优先级顺序。

[p.272] en: The key to triage is consistency in the comparison of triage factors 5.8.1 First order of priority: Triage Categories with victim information The level of prioritisation of worksites is based on victim information: number of confirmed alive victims, number of possibilities of live victims, and if there are only dead victims in the structure.
zh: 第一优先级排序：按受困人员信息分类 工作场地的优先级取决于受困人员信息：确认幸存的受困人员数量，受困人 员的幸存概率，以及结构中是否只有遇难者。

[p.272] en: All worksites with confirmed live victims are complete before the structures with possible live victims.
zh: 所有确认存在幸存受困人员的工作 场地应首先进行救援，其次是可能存在幸存受困人员的结构区域。

[p.272] en: The worksites with the greatest number of victims are the highest priority.
zh: 幸存受困人员 人数最多的工作场地具有最高优先级。

[p.272] en: Buildings with dead only may be assigned to USAR Teams as part of ASR5.
zh: 只有遇难者的建筑物可以作为ASR 5 级 行动的一部分，交由城市搜索与救援队负责。

[p.272] en: In order to assist deciding which team goes to which site, the triage teams are requested to estimate how long the operations will take.
zh: 为了帮助决定不同的队伍所负责的具体救援位置，要求分类人员评估行动所 需要的持续时间。

[p.272] en: The duration can only be estimated if the assessors have an idea of where the victim is located.
zh: 只有评估人员知道受困人员的位置，才能估算持续时间。

[p.272] en: Duration will depend on the structure, e.g., building material and size, and on equipment and expertise.
zh: 持续 时间将取决于建筑结构，如建筑材料和尺寸，以及所需救援装备和专业技能。

[p.272] en: The estimate should be based on general capability of a team and will always be a rough estimate.
zh: 持 续时间估算应基于队伍的总体能力，并且始终只是粗略的估算。

[p.272] en: Duration estimates will allow the UCC to assign the larger teams to the move difficult or larger sites that take longer to complete.
zh: 通过持续时间估 算，确保城市搜索与救援协调单元将较大规模的队伍部署到建筑构件移动困难的 救援位置，或需要更长时间才能完成行动的较大面积位置。

[p.272] en: The UCC collects information on all confirmed and possible live victims.
zh: 城市搜索与救援协调 单元收集所有幸存受困人员的信息，包括已确认的和可能的幸存受困人员。

[p.272] en: It does not collect victims on all deceased, only information that is deemed relevant.
zh: 其中 不包括所有已故受困人员的信息，只收集幸存受困人员相关的信息。

[p.273] en: Examples of possible live victims is when by-standers report missing people, or a collapse of a school that was in session.  Deceased only: Means that there are not live victims, but the LEMA may want to send teams to the site to recover the bodies.
zh: 可能存在幸存受困人员的例子是社区人员报告有人失踪，或者正在上 课期间的学校建筑发生倒塌。

[p.273] en: Figure 10: Triaging.
zh: 工作场地优先分类流程如图10 所示。

[p.273] en: 5.8.2 Second order of priority: Building information and operational constraints In cases where the UCC needs to use additional information to list the worksites in order of priority, building related and operations related information can be used.
zh: 第二优先级排序：建筑信息和行动限制 如果城市搜索与救援协调单元需要利用其他信息，以按优先级顺序排列工作 场地，则可以利用与建筑和行动相关的信息。

[p.273] en: Examples of useful information is listed below.
zh: 下面列出了有用信息的示例。

[p.273] en: This are not placed in the triage categories to avoid the triage categories becoming complicated.
zh: 这部 分内容不会放在工作场地分类中，避免工作场地分类变得复杂。

[p.274] en: The chances of survival for a victim are greater in big voids than small voids. “Big” is a relative term, i.e. a big void for a child will be considerably smaller than a big void for an adult.
zh: “大”是一个相对术语，对孩子 而言的大空隙将比对成人而言的大空隙小得多；

[p.274] en: o Small void: is where a person can hardly move and has to lie more or less still while waiting for help.
zh: ②小空隙（小空隙是 指一个人在等待援助时几乎无法移动的空间，受困人员只能在其中躺 着不动。

[p.274] en: In small voids, the chances of injury are higher as people trapped inside have less space to avoid falling objects and collapsing structural elements.
zh: 在小空隙中，受伤的概率更高，因为被困在其中的人没有什 么空间来避开掉落的物体和倒塌的结构元件）。

[p.275] en: Factors relating to the operations include:  Resource availability: the more limited resources, the longer the operation will take.  Location of site and teams: the further from the site the team is, the longer the operation will take.
zh: 260 5.8.3 与行动相关的考虑因素 （1）资源可用性（资源越有限，行动所需的持续时间就越长）。

[p.275] en: 5.9 Information Management Large, complex USAR operations result in heavy workloads for national and international teams.
zh: 9 信息管理 大规模复杂的城市搜索与救援行动造成国内和国际救援队伍任务繁重。

[p.275] en: The potential for loss of situational awareness is high if the information gathered is not managed properly.
zh: 如果 人员对于收集的信息管理不当，那么这些人员无法掌握灾情的可能性会变得很高。

[p.275] en: To assure a coordinated response of multiple international USAR Teams, information management therefore becomes a critical issue across the whole USAR coordination mechanism and at all stages of the response cycle.
zh: 为了确保多支国际城市搜索与救援队的协调响应，对于整个城市搜索与救援队 的协调机制和响应周期的所有阶段，信息管理成为一个关键因素。

[p.275] en: Such a system underpins efficient and effective collection, processing, dissemination of information and tasking of large-scale coordination efforts.
zh: 这种系统可以富有成效地收集、处理和传播信息，也是执行大规模协调任务 的基础。

[p.275] en: Responding teams want to limit the time and effort spent on information management.
zh: 在信息管理方面，救援队伍希望减少消耗的时间和精力。

[p.275] en: The requirements set on the teams in managing information have to be restricted to the absolute essential information for USAR coordination.
zh: 队伍在管理信息方 面的要求，必须限于对城市搜索与救援队的协调有重大影响的信息。

[p.275] en: Broader information is often needed for various other purposes, but this manual only covers the essential USAR coordination requirements.
zh: 出于各种其 他目的，通常需要更全面的信息，但本手册仅涵盖基本的城市搜索与救援协调所 要求的信息。

[p.275] en: All stakeholders of the INSARAG community need to part of a USAR information management system, hence the need for a standardised and systematic approach to collect and report information at all levels.
zh: 都需要成为城市搜 索与救援信息管理系统的一部分，因此需要采取标准化和系统化的办法，从而在 各个层面收集和报告相关信息。

[p.275] en: The INSARAG community has developed a management system through the years, and continues to seek to improve it.
zh: 多年来，国际搜索与救援咨询团已经制定了一套管理系统，并仍在继续寻求 改进。

[p.275] en: Later, the development of paper forms for collecting and disseminating information and assignments was introduced.
zh: 后来，引入了纸质 表格的开发，用于收集和传播任务信息。

[p.275] en: The most recent development of the INSARAG management system is a digital data collection and information display tools, which will be operational on 1 January 2020.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团管理系统的最新 开发项目是一套数字化的数据收集和信息显示工具，计划于2020 年1 月1 日投 入使用。

[p.276] en: Management is the allocation of resources towards a goal and objectives.
zh: 管理是为一个或多个目标进行资源分配的过程。

[p.276] en: The INSARAG Coordination and Management System (ICMS) therefore refers to a coordinated activity of allocating resources towards saving as many lives as possible from collapsed structures.
zh: 因此，国际搜索与救援咨询团协调管理系统 （ICMS）是指分配资源以在倒塌结构中拯救更多受困人员而进行的协调活动。

[p.276] en: The ICMS is both a web-based tool and a paper-based tool to be used in case the web-based version does not function.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团协调管理系统既是一个基于网络的工具，也是一个基 于纸质版本的工具，用于网络在线版本不起作用的情况。

[p.276] en: Both versions as based on a set of forms (either web-based or paper-based) to guide information collection from the field to the UCC, for maintaining an overview of the situation and for tasking teams.
zh: 这两个版本都基于一组 表格（网络版本或纸质版本），用以指导从现场到城市搜索与救援协调单元的信 息收集，以掌握总体情况并给队伍分配任务。

[p.276] en: The ICMS is maintained by the Information Management Working Group, which will provide user- guides and training material for the web-based version, and electronic versions of the paper forms on www.insarag.org.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团协调管理系 统由信息管理工作组维护，该工作组提供用户指南和培训材料，包括基于网络的 版本和纸质表格的电子版本，相关资料参见www.insarag.org。

[p.276] en: The forms include instructions on how to fill in each field.
zh: 这些表格附有关于 填写每个字段具体方法的说明。

[p.276] en: The web-based forms are created through Survey123, which are displayed on web-based dashboard.
zh: 基于网络的表格是通过Survey123 创建的，这类 表格显示为基于网络的数据图表。

[p.276] en: All teams will have access to both Survey123 and the dashboard, both for training purposes and during missions.
zh: 所有队伍都可以访问Survey123 表格（表7） 和数据图表，它们既可以用于培训目的，也可以用于执行现场任务。

[p.276] en: Each mission will have a unique log-on username and code, which will be provide to the teams via the VOSOCC at the beginning of the mission, and will be requested to download forms that are pertinent to that mission.
zh: 每次任务都 分配一个唯一的登录用户名和密码，在任务开始时将通过虚拟现场行动协调中心 提供给各队伍，并要求各队伍下载与本次任务有关的表格。

[p.276] en: All information put into the Survey123 forms is automatically and immediately shown on the dashboard, seen by the UCC, team management, OSOCC, and back office.
zh: Survey123 表格中的 所有信息都会立即自动显示在数据图表上，供城市搜索与救援协调单元、队伍管 理层、现场行动协调中心和后勤办公室查询。

[p.276] en: Teams will be tasked by the UCC directly (email, phone, face-to-face), and will upload the assignment information on the dashboard.
zh: 通过电子邮件、电话和现场沟通， 城市搜索与救援协调单元直接给各队伍分配任务，并将任务分配信息上传到数据 图表上。

[p.276] en: For more information, please refer to the ICMS documents and the UC Manual under the Guidance Notes.
zh: 相关更多信息，请参见指南说明中的国际搜索与救援咨询团协调管理系

[p.277] en: The main components of the ICMS is outlined below and the UC Manual provides more details about management processes.
zh: 下文概述了国际搜索与救援咨询团协调管理系统的主要组成部分，城市搜索 与救援协调手册提供了相关管理流程的更多详细信息。

[p.277] en: Fact Sheet: The Fact Sheet provides information about the capacity of the team, contact information, support needs, and status.
zh: 队伍概况表：队伍概况表提供有关队伍能力、联系信息、支持需求和队伍状 态的信息。

[p.277] en: Note that the Mobilising Form will no longer exist as a separate form, but will become part of the Fact Sheet.
zh: 需要注意的是，队伍动员表格将不再作为单独设置的表格，而是成为 队伍概况表的一部分。

[p.277] en: Entity Survey 123 form Paper form Back Office Team information filled in the Fact Sheet on Survey 123.
zh: 表7 Survey123 表格和纸质表格 机构 Survey123 表格 纸质表格 后勤办公室 将队伍信息填写在Survey123 的 队伍概况表中。

[p.277] en: Marks the team´s status as “deployed”.
zh: 将队伍的状态标 记为“已部署”。

[p.277] en: Forms for ASR Levels 1-5: The teams fill in the following forms during their assignments, depending on the ASR levels Form ASR Level Comment Wide-Area Assessment Form Used to collect general impact information and used for sectorisation.
zh: 表8 ASR 级别和相关表格 表格 ASR 级别 说明 大范围评估表 1 用于收集整体灾区信息并用于分区 工作场地优先选择表 2 用于从已确定的具有救援机会的工作场地收集信息

[p.278] en: Worksite Triage Form Used to collect information from identified worksites with rescue opportunities.
zh: 263 第二卷 准备和响应 表格 ASR 级别 说明 工作场地报告表 3，4，5 报告特定行动期间在工作场地的活动或移交任务 现场 埋压人员解救情况表 3，4 用于收集已解救受困人员基本信息的表格 伤员医疗救治表 3，4 用于收集已解救受困人员医疗信息的表格。

[p.278] en: Victim Treatment Form 3, 4 Form used to collect medical information about victims extricated.
zh: 这份表 格与伤员一起移交。

[p.278] en: Humanitarian Notification Form Any level If a USAR Team sees unattended humanitarian needs that needs to be reported, they can do so through the Humanitarian Notification form.
zh: 所有收集到的与受困人员有关 的信息都应保密 人道主义需求确认表 所有级别 如果城市搜索与救援队发现需要报告的尚未受到关 注的人道主义需求，队伍可以通过人道主义通告表 格进行报告 任务简报包（表9）：在部署队伍任务时，城市搜索与救援协调单元将填写 任务简报包，其中包括一张表格和相关附件。

[p.278] en: Entity Survey123 form Comment Main form Assignment Briefing Form Provides information on which team is being assigned, when and to where, along with assignment information and a list of the annexes.
zh: 表9 任务简报包 机构 Survey123 表格 说明 主要表格 任务简报表 提供与任务执行队伍、任务执行时间和任 务执行地点有关的信息，以及任务安排信 息和附件清单 附件A 大范围评估表 相关内容 附件B 工作场地优先选择表 相关内容 附件C 之前的工作场地报告表 相关内容 附件D 图片 相关内容 在www.insarag.org 网站上也可以查阅其他表格，例如：①受灾区域信息；

[p.278] en: Other forms are also available on www.insarag.org, such as:  Affected Area information.  RDC briefing handout.  OSOCC-LEMA briefing.  Incident/Sector Situation Report.
zh: ④灾害事件/ 地理分区情况报告。

[p.278] en: Form updates are expected to be on a six months basis and will be announced to the INSARAG network.
zh: 预计每六个月将进行一次表格更新，并向国际搜索与救援咨询团网络公布。

[p.278] en: During a mission, teams should download the latest forms.
zh: 在执行任务期间，队伍应下载最新的表格。

[p.278] en: Changes in the forms may be expected
zh: 表格可能会出现变化。

[p.278] en: Teams are especially advised to monitor the ICMS dashboard, provide information through the forms, and participate in UCC meetings.
zh: 特别建议队伍监控国际搜索与救援咨 询团协调管理系统的数据图表，通过各种表格（图11）提供相关信息，并参 加城市搜索与救援协调单元的会议。

[p.279] en: They should also be a mechanism to strengthen coordination and minimise duplication.
zh: 标记系统还应成为一种机制，以加强协 调并尽量减少重复工作。

[p.279] en: To maximise the value of using a marking system in an event it is necessary to identify and universally use a single, common method.
zh: 为了最大限度地提高在救援行动中使用标记系统的价值， 有必要确定并使成员普遍接受这种通用方法。

[p.279] en: For this method to be effective, it must be used by all responders, remain simple to apply, simple to understand, be efficient in the use of resources and time, communicate the information effectively and be consistently applied.
zh: 为了确保这种方法有效，所有救援 机构都必须使用这种方法，易于应用、理解，可促进资源和时间的高效利用，有 效地传达信息，并持续得到应用。

[p.279] en: The INSARAG Marking System strives to achieve these things and consists of three principle Marking elements, these being: Triage Marking, Victim Marking and Rapid Clearance Marking (RCM).
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团的标记系统旨在实现这些目标，由三个主要的标记要 素组成，包括：分类标记、受困人员标记和快速清理标记（RCM）。

[p.279] en: These components deliver a comprehensive suite of visual displays that capture critical information to both inform situational awareness and support planning and coordination.
zh: 这些要素 提供一套全面的可视化展示，可捕获关键信息，为掌握灾情提供信息，并支持规 划和协调。

[p.279] en: The INSARAG Marking System is used by teams as the default marking system in the absence of any national system in countries where operations are occurring.
zh: 在开展救援行动的国家没有任何标记系统的情况下，救援队伍应将国际搜索 与救援咨询团标记系统作为默认的标记系统。

[p.280] en: Countries are encouraged to use the INSARAG Marking system as their national standard which will assist in times of crisis when international teams are required to be used.
zh: 265 第二卷 准备和响应 建议各国使用国际搜索与救援咨询团标记系统作为其国家标准，这将有助于 应对需要部署国际队伍的危机。

[p.280] en: The INSARAG Marking System is designed to complement not compete with national systems.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询团的标记系统旨在补充国家 标记系统，而不是与其产生冲突。

[p.280] en: Note: The following is defined:  General Area Marking (optional).  Structure Orientation (optional).  Cordon Markings (optional).  Worksite Triage Marking (required).  Victim Marking (required).  RCM (optional).
zh: 注释：定义以下标记内容：①常规区域标记（可选）；

[p.280] en: 6.1.1 General Area Marking At times some general marking will be required to be applied to assist in navigation and coordination.
zh: 常规区域标记 有时需要应用一些常规标记用于现场导航和协调。

[p.280] en: This should be limited to essential information only and be as concise as possible.  General area marking can be applied using spray paint, builders’ crayon, stickers, waterproof card etc. as determined by the team.
zh: 常规区域标记可以使用自喷漆、建筑用蜡笔、贴纸、防水卡等工具， 由队伍确定。

[p.280] en: Figure 12: Street and number identification.
zh: 在制作地图时，主要地理标记应尽可能采用现有的街道名称和建筑物 编号。

[p.280] en: 6.1.2 Structure Orientation Structure orientation is an optional way of marking.
zh: 结构定位 结构定位是一种可选的标记方式。

[p.280] en: It includes both an exterior and interior identification:  Exterior Identification: The street address side (front) of the structure shall be defined as “1”.
zh: 外部标记：建筑结构的街道地址侧（正面）应定义为“1”。

[p.280] en: Other sides of the structure shall be assigned numerically in a clockwise manner from “1” (see Figure 12).  Interior Identification: The interior of the structure will be divided into quadrants.
zh: 建筑结构 的其他侧面应从“1”开始按顺时针方向进行数字编号（图 12）。

[p.280] en: The quadrants shall be identified alphabetically in a clockwise manner starting at the corner where Side 1 (front) and 2 meet.
zh: 象限应从前部 1（正 面）和侧面 2 相交的拐角处开始，以顺时针方向按字母顺序标记。

[p.281] en: Quadrant E (central lobby, elevators, staircases, etc) applies to buildings with multiple storeys. (See Figure 13).
zh: 266 大厅、电梯、楼梯等）适用于多层建筑（图 13）。

[p.281] en: Multi-storey structures must have each floor clearly identified.
zh: 必须清楚地标识多层结构的每层楼。

[p.281] en: If not obvious, the floors should be numbered as viewed from the exterior.
zh: 如果标识不明显，楼层应标记可以从外 部看见的编号。

[p.281] en: The ground level floor would be designated the “ground floor” and, moving upward the next floor would be “Floor 1”, etc.
zh: 底层将被指定为“地面层”，向上的一层将被指定为“第1 层”， 依此类推。

[p.281] en: Conversely, the first floor below ground level would be “Basement 1”, the second “Basement 2”, and so on. (See Figure 14).
zh: 相反，地面下一层是“地下1 层”，再下一层是“地下2 层”，依此 类推（图14）。

[p.281] en: 6.1.3 Cordon Markings Cordon markings can be used as an option to identify operational work zones as well as hazardous areas to restrict access and warn of dangers.
zh: 前部 3 象限 B 2 4 象限 C 象限 E 象限 A 象限 D 前部 1 图13 内部标记 3 楼 2 楼 1 楼 地面层 地下1 层 地下2 层 图14 多层结构的楼层标记 图12 街道名称和建筑物编号标记 6.1.3 警戒标记 警戒标记可用于标识行动作业区（图15）和禁止禁入区（图16），限制人员 进入并警告危险。

[p.281] en: Figure 16: Exclusion Zone.
zh: 图15 行动作业区标记 图16 禁止进入区标记

[p.282] en: Figure 15: Operational Work Zone.
zh: 267 第二卷 准备和响应 6.2 工作场地分类标记 工作场地分类标记最初是为了确保队伍能够与其他队伍沟通，告知其已经完 成搜救行动的建筑物，从而避免重复工作。

[p.282] en: First of all, a communication for triage teams to mark structures that they have identified as viable worksites, and secondly, the original intent of communicating which teams have completed their work in the building.
zh: 其 次，沟通旨在澄清已完成建筑物搜救行动的具体队伍。

[p.282] en: The much improved ICMS system has reduced the need for a building marking system due to better coordination and communication among teams, but is still deemed an essential part of the coordination system as it displays critical information, is simple to understand and apply, and allows Worksites to be easily recognised.
zh: 由于队伍之间协调和沟通的改善，大幅改进的国际搜索与救援咨询团的协调 管理系统减少了对建筑标记系统的需求，但该标记系统仍然被认为是协调系统的 重要组成部分，因为该标记系统显示关键信息，易于理解和应用，并确保任务现 场易于标识。

[p.282] en: The marking should be placed near the point of entry on the exterior of the collapsed structure that offers the best visibility, in the front, (or as close as possible) or main entry to the worksite.
zh: 标记应设置在倒塌结构外部的入口附近，位于结构前部（或尽可能靠近）或 工作场地的主要入口处，实现最醒目的效果。

[p.282] en: Whilst key information is required, teams can exercise discretion and adapt to environmental impacts within these boundaries whilst still maintaining a common, effective and consistent marking system.
zh: 除了关键信息必不可少，队伍还可 以根据环境情况自主使用场地标记，并适应这些区域的环境状况，同时仍然保持 通用、高效和一致的标记系统。

[p.282] en: The system should complement the LEMA/national systems and can be adapted to work alongside these as required.
zh: 这一标记系统应作为地方应急管理机构/ 国家系 统的补充，并可根据需要进行调整，与这些系统一起发挥作用。

[p.282] en: Markings can be made in any colour clearly contrasting to the structures surface, making it highly visible at any time.
zh: 标记可以采用各种颜色，与结构表面形成鲜明对比，确保其始终清晰可见， 如图17 所示。

[p.282] en: Figure 17: Example of completed worksite marking system, with all required work completed.
zh: 危险品（如果需要标注） 完成所有工作，确 定不需要在现场进 行进一步行动时， 标注水平线 石棉 工作场地优先级分类 队伍编码 ASR 级别评估已完成 日期（日/ 月 1） 箭头标记以指示工 作场地的确切方向 工作场地编码 图17 已完成所有必需工作的工作场地标记系统示例 1 月份的英文缩写。

[p.283] en: Marking Method Worksite marking should be applied during initial ASR Level 2 Sector Assessment after a site has been triaged to be a worksite.
zh: 268 标记方法 某一救援场地经过分类成为工作场地后，应在初始ASR 2 级地理分区评估 期间应用工作场地标记。

[p.283] en: The marking should be applied to the front, (or as close as possible) or main entry to the worksite.
zh: 标记应设置在工作场地的前部（或尽可能靠近）或主要 入口处。

[p.283] en: The following method should be used when applying worksite marking:
zh: 在设置工作场地标记时，应采用以下方法。

[p.283] en:  May draw a directional arrow to confirm exact location of worksite/worksite entry.  Inside box – displays: o Worksite ID (app.
zh: 可以绘制方向箭头，以指示工作场地的确切位置/ 工作场地入口。

[p.283] en: 40cm. font). o Team ID (app.
zh: ②队伍 编码（字体尺寸约为 10 厘米）；

[p.283] en: 10 cm. font). o ASR Level completed (app.
zh: ③已完成的 ASR 级别（字体尺寸约 为 10 厘米）；

[p.283] en: 10 cm. font). o Date.  Outside of box – displays: o Any hazard requiring identification e.g.
zh: 方框外应标示：①需要标识的各种危险，如石棉（标识于顶部）；

[p.283] en: If a team considers there is a need to leave critical additional information at the worksite this can be added to the worksite marking using plain language in full view when required.
zh: 根据需要，如果队伍认为有必要在工作场地留下重要的附加信息，则可以使 用通俗易懂的文字将其添加到工作场地标记中。

[p.283] en: This and all other relevant details should be recorded on the Worksite Triage or Worksite Report forms and submitted through the ICMS.
zh: 这些信息和所有其他的相关详细 信息应记录在工作场地优先选择表或工作场地报告表中，并通过国际搜索与救援 咨询团的协调管理系统提交。

[p.284] en: 6.2.1 Progressive Examples Figure 18: Charlie Sector, Worksite 5, Australia 1 completed ASR 2 Sector Assessment on the 19th of October.
zh: 269 第二卷 准备和响应 6.2.1 工作场地分类标记渐进变化示例 图18 ～ 图20 是工作场地分类标记渐进变化示例。

[p.284] en: Triage category determined as “B”.
zh: 工作场地优先 级确定为“B”。

[p.284] en: Figure 19: Here the Turkey 02 team were assigned to rescue operations on the C-5 Worksite following the Sector Assessment completed by Australia 01.
zh: 2 澳大利亚1 队完成分区评估后，土耳其2 队部署到C-5 执行救援行动。

[p.284] en: Turkey 02 completed ASR 3 Rapid SAR operations on the 19th of October.
zh: 土耳其2 队于10 月 19 日完成ASR 3 级快速搜救行动。

[p.284] en: Figure 20: Singapore 01 team have completed work at the specific Worksite C-12b within Worksite C-12.
zh: 3 新加坡1 队已经在C-12 内的C-12b 完成工作。

[p.285] en: In Figure 20, the Singapore 01 team have completed work at the specific Worksite C-12b within Worksite C-12.
zh: 270 图20 显示，新加坡1 队已经在C-12 工作场地内的C-12b 子工作场地完成工 作。

[p.285] en: An arrow has been added to the marking to make it clear that C-12b is to the right of the marking.
zh: 标记上增加了一个箭头，以清楚地表明C-12b 子工作场地在标记的右侧。

[p.285] en: A hazard warning about gas leaking into the basement has been added in plain language.
zh: 采 用通俗易懂的语言添加了危险警告：地下室存在危险气体泄漏。

[p.285] en: Operations to ASR 2 and ASR 3 were completed on the 19th of October.
zh: ASR 2 级和ASR 3 级行动于10 月19 日完成。

[p.285] en: Operations to ASR 4 Full SAR were completed on the 20th of October.
zh: ASR 4 级全面搜索与营救行动 于10 月20 日完成。

[p.285] en: No further operations are required on this worksite.
zh: 此任务现场无须其他行动。

[p.285] en: In Figure 21, Australia 01 have completed an ASR 2 Sector Assessment at the specific Worksite C-1c within Worksite C-1 on the 5th of October.
zh: 石棉 图21 澳大利亚1 队已在C-1c 子工作场地完成了ASR 2 级分区评估 图21 显示，澳大利亚1 队已于10 月5 日在C-1 工作场地内的C-1c 子工作 场地完成了ASR 2 级分区评估。

[p.285] en: An arrow has been added to the marking to make it clear that C-1c is to the left and below the marking.
zh: 标记上增加了一个箭头，以清楚地表明C-1c 子 工作场地在标记的左下侧。

zh: 以通俗易懂的语言添加了关于石棉的危险警告标识。

[p.286] en: 6.3 Victim Marking Victim marking is required to identify potential or known casualty (live or dead) locations that are not obvious to rescuers e.g. below debris/entombed.
zh: 3 受困人员标记 受困人员标记用于标识可能存在或已确认伤亡人员（幸存或遇难）的位置， 这些位置对救援人员而言并非显而易见，如在废墟下方/ 被掩埋位置。

[p.286] en: 6.3.1 Method The following method should be used when applying victim marking:  When teams (e.g.
zh: 方法 在设置受困人员标记时，应遵循以下原则： （1） 如果队伍（如搜救组）没有留在现场立即开始行动，则应做好受困人 员标记。

[p.286] en: 6.3.2 Progressive Examples Description Example Practical Examples Large “V” applied to location of all potential victims – live or deceased.
zh: 如果救援活动涉及多起伤亡灾害事件或者搜索行动可能对确认受困人 员的位置造成混淆，则应做好受困人员标记。

[p.286] en: Optional arrow from “V” to clarify location if required.
zh: 现场标记应尽可能接近被确定为伤亡人员地点的现场位置。

[p.287] en: On removal of any casualty the relevant marking is crossed out and updated (if required) below; e.g. “L-2” may be crossed out and an “L-1” applied indicating only one Live victim remaining.
zh: 受困人员标记渐进变化示例（表10） 表10 受困人员标记渐进变化示例 描述 示例 实例 大尺寸的“V”形标记适用于所有 可能存在受困人员的位置，包括 幸存受困人员或遇难者 如果需要，“V”形标记旁可设置 箭头，以标示位置 在“V”形标记下方： “L”表示已确认的幸存受困人员， 后跟一个数字（如“2”）表示 该地点的幸存受困人员人数，如 “L-2”“L-3”等。

[p.287] en: When all ‘“L” and/or “D” markings are crossed out, all known victims have been removed.
zh: “D”表示已 确认的遇难者，后跟一个数字（如 “3”）表示该地点遇难者人数， 如“D-3”“D-4”等 如果伤亡人员救援已执行，则下 方的相关标记将划掉并更新（如 果需要）；

[p.288] en: 6.3.3 Rapid Clearance Marking System The triage category and marking system is mainly used for potential live rescue sites but can also include triage category D to allow triage teams to identify buildings that the teams have reason to believe that there are only deceased remaining in the building and no rescues are possible.
zh: 273 第二卷 准备和响应 描述 示例 实例 如果所有的“L”和/ 或“D”标 记都已被划掉，那么说明所有已 知的受困人员均被转移 6.4 快速清理标记系统（RCM） 工作场地分类和标记系统主要用于可能的幸存者救援地点，但也可以设置工 作场地分类D，分类人员以此标识队伍确信建筑物中只有遇难者并且无法进行救 援的建筑物。

[p.288] en: This applies to ASR2.
zh: 这项工作适用于ASR 2 级行动。

[p.288] en: However, after having completed ASR5 where teams have established there are no live victims or “Deceased Only” it may be beneficial to mark the site accordingly.
zh: 但是，在完成ASR 5 级行动之后， 队伍已经确定没有幸存受困人员或只有遇难者，并在场地进行相应地标记，这样 做是有益的。

[p.288] en: Leaving a recognised “Clear” marking will prevent duplication and have other advantages.
zh: 留下清晰的“已清理”标记，可以避免重复工作，并带来其他好处。

[p.288] en: This type of marking is called Rapid Clearance Marking (RCM).
zh: 这种类型的标记称为快速清理标记（RCM）。

[p.289] en: Deceased Only: Indicates same level of comprehensive search has been completed but only deceased casualties remain in-situ.
zh: 274 说明 示例 实例 只有遇难者： 表示已完成ASR 5 级全 面搜索，但只有遇难者 留在原地。

[p.289] en: Note: When deceased are removed, apply “Clear” RCM adjacent to original mark.
zh: 注意：当遇难者已被移 送，应在原有标记旁添 加“已清理”标记 （1） 可应用于能够快速完成搜索的结构，或有确切证据证实没有幸存受困 人员或只有遇难者遗骸的结构。

[p.289] en: AUS-01. o Date of Search: _ _/ _ _ _ e.g.
zh: ②搜索日期：__/___，如10 月19 日（19 OCT）；

[p.289] en: 19/Oct. o Material to be used can be spray paint, builders’ crayon, stickers, waterproof card etc. at the discretion of the teams. o Size: Approximately 20 cm x 20 cm. o Colour: Bright, contrasting colour to background.
zh: ③所用的材料可能包括自喷漆、建筑用蜡笔、贴纸、 防水卡等，由队伍自行决定；

[p.289] en: 6.3.5 Progressive Examples Rapid clearance marking applied to car – indicating Level 5 ASR search complete on car only.
zh: 快速清理标记渐进变化示例（表12） 表12 快速清理标记渐进变化示例 描述 实例 在汽车上设置的快速清理 标记，表示仅在此辆汽车 上完成了ASR 5 级搜索。

[p.290] en: Completed by Singapore Operation Lionheart Contingent (SGP-01) on 12th October Rapid clearance marking applied to area indicating Level 5 ASR completed of area inside defined marked limits – paint or otherwise define edges.
zh: 275 第二卷 准备和响应 描述 实例 在设置快速清理标记的区 域，标记显示ASR 5 级行 动在明确标记范围内的区 域已完成，区域边缘采用 油漆或以其他方式划定。

[p.290] en: Rapid clearance marking indicating comprehensive search completed on object/area.
zh: 注释：这堆废墟已利用机 械进行了翻查搜索，确认 达到ASR 5 级行动标准 快速清理标记显示在此物 体/ 区域上已完成全面搜 索。

[p.290] en: Only deceased casualties remain in-situ Completed by Singapore Operation Lionheart Contingent (SGP-01) on 12th October
zh: 只有遇难者仍留在原 地。

[p.290] en: 6.4 INSARAG Signalling Effective communications underpin safe field operations, particularly in multi-agency environments.
zh: 由新加坡狮心行动特遣队 （SGP-01）于10 月12 日 完成 6.5 国际搜索与救援咨询团信号系统 有效的沟通是确保现场行动安全的基础，特别是在多机构行动的环境中。

[p.290] en: This is even more critical in international environments where language and cultural differences also exist.
zh: 在 语言和文化存在差异的国际环境中，有效沟通尤为重要。

[p.290] en: Effective emergency signalling is essential for safe operation at a disaster site.
zh: 在救灾现场，有效的紧 急信号传送对于行动安全至关重要。

[p.290] en: Having a universally understood emergency signalling system ensures that all personnel operating on a worksite know how and when to react to signals on the site to ensure safe and effective operations for rescuers and victims alike.
zh: 采用普遍约定的紧急信号系统，可确保在工 作场地上行动的所有人员知道对现场信号做出反应的方式和时机，确保救援人员 的安全有效行动，也能更好地保护受困人员的安全。

[p.291] en: Resume Operations Figure 26: Resume Operations: one long signal + one short signal.
zh: 疏散、停止行动―保持静默、恢复行动这三种不同含义的信号发送方式如图 24 ～图26 所示。

[p.291] en: 7 Hazardous Materials Operations 7.1 Introduction International USAR Teams locate, extricate, and provide emergency medical treatment to victims entrapped because of structural collapse.
zh: 图24 疏散 1 图25 停止行动—保持静默 2 图26 恢复行动 3 7 危险品处置 7.1 简介 建筑结构倒塌灾害发生后，有些人员受困其中，国际城市搜索与救援队寻找、 解救受困人员，并对其提供紧急医疗救治。

[p.291] en: Operations involving collapsed buildings normally include some form of hazmat component – examples include, broken heating oil pipes, domestic or industrial refrigerants, broken sewerage pipes, body fluids, etc.
zh: 通常，倒塌建筑物中的救援行动涉及 某种形式的危险物质成分，例如：破损的取暖油管、家用或工业制冷剂、破损的 下水道管道、伤员的体液等。

[p.292] en: In some instances, structural collapse may involve the significant release of substances that have the potential to injure and/or cause death as well as resulting in significant environmental damage.
zh: 277 第二卷 准备和响应 在某些情况下，结构倒塌可能会导致一些物质发生重大泄漏，可能造成人员 伤亡及严重的环境污染。

[p.292] en: These substances can include nuclear, biological, or industrial chemical contaminants.
zh: 这些物质可能包括核工业材料、生物制剂或工业化学污 染物。

[p.292] en: Hazmat incidents may also occur in conjunction with an explosive or incendiary device.
zh: 危险品泄漏事件也可能与爆炸物或燃烧装置事故一起发生。

[p.292] en: In these cases, a strong relationship with the LEMA and/or local first responders is considered productive.
zh: 在这些情况下， 如果能与地方应急管理机构和/ 或当地第一响应人加强联系，救援行动会更加富 有成效。

[p.292] en: Light, Medium and Heavy USAR Teams are required to have a basic capability to detect and isolate hazmat and report the situation to the UCC.
zh: 轻型、中型和重型城市搜索与救援队必须具备检测和隔离危险品的基本能力， 并向城市搜索与救援协调单元报告相关情况。

[p.292] en: Teams locating a hazmat source must cordon off the area and mark accordingly to alert other rescuers of the danger.
zh: 寻找危险品泄漏源的队伍必须封锁 该泄漏区域并进行相应标记，以提醒其他救援人员注意危险。

[p.292] en: If there is a suspicion that contamination exists, treat the site as contaminated, until proven otherwise.
zh: 如果怀疑存在污染 物，则应将该现场视为受污染区域，除非有其他可以得出相反结论的证据。

[p.292] en: 7.2 Strategic Considerations Light, Medium and Heavy international USAR Teams need to possess the inherent knowledge to recognise a hazardous environment, thus minimising the risk of harm, injury or death to its members, the affected population and the environment.
zh: 2 战略层面的注意事项 轻型、中型和重型国际城市搜索与救援队，需要具备识别危险环境的技能， 从而最大限度减少对队员、受灾人群和环境造成危害及伤亡的风险。

[p.292] en: It is also expected that teams will be able to communicate its findings regarding contamination to others.
zh: 各队伍还应 将有关污染的调查结果告知其他队伍。

[p.292] en: 7.3 Operational Considerations If a determination is made that a site is contaminated or if a site is suspected to be contaminated, no USAR operations should be conducted until an appropriate assessment has been undertaken.
zh: 3 行动层面的注意事项 如果确定某一场地受到污染或怀疑某一场地受到污染，则在进行适当评估之 前，不应进行城市搜索与救援行动。

[p.292] en: If it is within the capability of the team, the source of the contamination should be isolated.
zh: 如果针对污染区的处理工作超出队伍的能力 范围，则应隔离污染源。

[p.292] en: If it is beyond the capability of the team to isolate the source of contamination, the area should be cordoned off, marked accordingly, with the UCC being notified immediately.
zh: 如果针对污染源的隔离工作超出队伍的能力范围，则应 封锁该区域，对该区域进行相应标记，并立即通知城市搜索与救援协调单元。

[p.292] en: For operational considerations at worksite see Volume III: Operational Field Guide.
zh: 有关任务现场行动层面的注意事项，请参见《第三卷：现场行动指南》。

[p.293] en: 8 Beyond the Rubble 8.1 Context Sudden onset disasters of a scale requiring a response from USAR Teams will inevitably result in mid- and long-term impacts to the community.
zh: 278 8 废墟之外 8.1 环境 需要城市搜索与救援队做出响应的大规模突发灾害将不可避免地对社区造成 中长期影响。

[p.293] en: By their nature USAR Teams often have knowledge skills and experience that can be of assistance to the impacted community beyond SAR.
zh: 就队伍能力而言，城市搜索与救援队通常具备相关知识技能和经验， 可以在搜救工作以外为受灾社区提供帮助。

[p.293] en: This is referred to as ‘Beyond the Rubble’ assistance.
zh: 这类援助被称为“废墟之外”的援助。

[p.293] en: The term “Beyond the Rubble” refers to USAR Teams using existing capabilities to provide limited further assistance to the community.
zh: “废墟之外”这一术语是指城市搜索 与救援队利用现有能力向社区提供有限的其他援助。

[p.293] en: In this transition phase from USAR to early recovery/relief phase, deployed USAR Teams can support the LEMA using their existing capabilities, expertise and operational awareness of the situation, to smoothen the transition from the response to recovery phase of the operation and to facilitate consistent support to the victims.
zh: 在从城市搜索与救援行动到 早期恢复/ 救助行动的过渡阶段，部署在现场的城市搜索与救援队可以利用其现 有能力、专业知识和对救灾行动情况的掌握，协助地方应急管理机构，平稳地从 搜救行动响应阶段过渡到灾后恢复阶段，并促进其对受灾群体的持续支持。

[p.293] en: 8.2 Background “Beyond the Rubble” are activities offered/conducted by USAR Teams deployed after an earthquake or other sudden onset disaster to overcome the transitional phase between the USAR- and the early recovery/relief phase.
zh: 2 背景 “废墟之外”的救援是通过在地震或其他突发灾害发生后部署的城市搜索与 救援队执行/ 开展的救援活动，促进城市搜索与救援阶段与早期恢复/ 救助阶段 之间的过渡。

[p.293] en: These tasks are driven by the needs of the community as identified by the LEMA.
zh: 这些援助任务是由地方应急管理机构确定的社区需求驱动的。

[p.293] en: All activities are to have clearly defined goals, as determined by the LEMA and an end time commensurate with the demobilisation time of the team.
zh: 所有救援活动都应有明确定义的目标，由地方应急管理机构确定，救援活动的结 束时间与队伍的撤离时间相匹配。

[p.293] en: Teams, when offering this assistance should consider to be able to perform them with the same level of professionalism like their main task.
zh: 在提供此类援助时，队伍应考虑能够以与其主 要任务级别相同的专业水平提供援助。

[p.293] en: If it is determined, in consultation with LEMA, that team capabilities are required beyond the demobilisation time of the original deployment this should be considered as a humanitarian and not an additional USAR response.
zh: 在与地方应急管理机构协商后，如果确定队伍所需的行动持续时间超过原部 署计划的撤离时间，则应将其行动视为人道主义响应，而不是额外的城市搜索与 救援响应。

[p.294] en: It is noted that “Beyond the Rubble” activities are voluntary and will be determined by the existing capabilities and capacities of the deployed USAR Team.
zh: 值得注意的是，参与“废墟之外”的救援活动是自愿进行的，这取决于部署 的城市搜索与救援队的现有能力。

[p.294] en: It is not expected that “Beyond the Rubble” activities will be done by all USAR Teams and Teams are not forced to structure their teams to meet the anticipated extended capabilities. “Beyond the Rubble” activities are not assessed as part of the IEC/R process.
zh: “废墟之外”的救援活动不需要进行评估，并非分级测评/ 复测流程的一部分。

[p.294] en: It is advantageous if USAR Teams can declare their “Beyond the Rubble” capabilities on the VOSOCC prior to an international deployment.
zh: 在国际援助任务部署之前，如果城市搜索与救援队可以在虚拟现场行动协调 中心上公布其“废墟之外”的能力，则有利于行动的开展。

[p.325] en: 1 Introduction The United Nations (UN) General Assembly Resolution 57/150 of 16 December 2002 on “Strengthening the Effectiveness and Coordination of International USAR Assistance” endorses the International Search and Rescue Advisory Group (INSARAG) Guidelines as the principal reference for the coordination of international Urban Search and Rescue (USAR) response.
zh: 310 1 简 介 2002 年12 月16 日，联合国大会通过了关于“加强国际城市搜索与救援援 助效能和协调”的第57/150 号决议，确认了国际搜索与救援指南作为协调国际 城市搜索与救援响应的主要参考。

[p.325] en: The INSARAG Guidelines defines the methodology that countries affected by a sudden onset disaster can expect from the INSARAG USAR response community.
zh: 国际搜索与救援指南，确定了受突发灾害影响 的国家可以从国际搜索与救援咨询团城市搜索与救援响应体系获取援助的方法。

[p.325] en: This trained and practiced methodology is implemented by international USAR responders, to provide assistance during international USAR response operations.
zh: 这种方法包含了培训和实践环节，由国际城市搜索与救援响应机构实施，从而在 国际城市搜索与救援响应行动期间提供帮助。

[p.325] en: The goal of this manual is to define the operational minimum standard for international USAR.
zh: 本手册旨在明确国际城市搜索与救援的最低行动标准。

[p.325] en: The INSARAG Steering Group (ISG) expects USAR Teams in the INSARAG network to utilise this Minimum Standard for USAR Operations while in the preparation, response, and rehabilitation phases.
zh: 国际搜索与救援咨询 团指导委员会（ISG）要求国际搜索与救援咨询团网络中的所有城市搜索与救援 队利用这一最低标准，以指导在准备、响应和灾后恢复阶段的行动。

[p.325] en: In an effort to achieve this objective, the INSARAG network has developed two voluntary, independent, peer review-processes: the INSARAG External Classification (IEC) and INSARAG External Reclassification (IER).
zh: 为了实现这一目标，国际搜索与救援咨 询团网络制定了两套自愿参加的独立同行审查程序：国际搜索与救援咨询团分级 测评（IEC）和国际搜索与救援咨询团分级复测（IER）。

[p.325] en: The purpose of this manual is to ensure a USAR Team preparing to undergo an IEC/R has a deep understanding of the expected planning, preparation and delivery requirements.
zh: 本手册旨在确保准备 接受分级测评/ 复测的城市搜索与救援队深入了解相关要求，包括即将进行的规 划、准备和实施环节。

[p.325] en: By following these principles, a USAR Team will be prepared to offer professional services, operate in a collaborative manner, and provide timely life-saving assistance to an affected population.
zh: 通过遵循这些原则，城市搜索与救援队将可以做好准备， 以提供专业服务，开展救灾行动协作，并为受灾群众提供及时的生命拯救援助。

[p.325] en: It requires the total administrative, financial and operational commitment of the sponsoring organisation, the USAR Team, its Mentor as well as several other stakeholders to ensure success.
zh: 队伍 主管部门、城市搜索与救援队，其教练以及其他多个利益相关方，必须在全面管 理、财务和运作方面狠下功夫，才能确保认证成功。

[p.325] en: USAR Teams and their Mentors are required to familiarise themselves with the contents of the INSARAG Guidelines and this manual.
zh: 城市搜索与救援队及其教练 必须熟悉国际搜索与救援指南和本手册的内容。

[p.325] en: Any questions with regards to the content of this manual should be directed to the INSARAG Secretariat and your appointed Mentor (as appropriate).
zh: 有关本手册内容的任何问题，根据具体情况，请直接向国际搜索与救援咨询 团秘书处和队伍指定教练提出。
